title: UX/UI designer, WeTransfer
description:
WeTransfer helps millions of users share ideas and collaborate seamlessly. Now part of Bending Spoons, it plays a key role in a portfolio of outstanding digital businesses united by a shared focus on innovation and operational excellence. By applying through the WeTransfer brand, you’ll be stepping into the wider Bending Spoons team. You may work directly on WeTransfer or contribute to one of our other leading products. Either way, you’ll be part of a high-performing, collaborative environment where you can make a real impact.
   

  

 At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we operate so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* **Shape high-leverage product experiences.** 
 Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.
* **Start with an LLM.** 
 Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.
* **Prototype and build with AI.** 
 Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.
* **Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one.** 
 Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.
* **Validate and measure.** 
 Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.
* **Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog.** 
 Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.


**Commitment & contract**
 Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
   

  

 Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.
   

  

 All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**This role is based in Stockholm**
 TRATON Charging Solutions, established in 2023 as a part of the TRATON GROUP, is dedicated to providing seamless, reliable charging services for commercial vehicles. As an eMSP, it operates the largest charging network in Europe and powers services such as Scania Charging Access and MAN Charge&Go. With structural readiness in 22 European countries and a mission to cover the entire EU by the end of 2026, TRATON Charging Solutions is at the forefront of accelerating sustainable transport through strategic partnerships and innovative solutions.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 TRATON Charging Solutions is accelerating the transition to sustainable transport by delivering seamless charging services for commercial vehicles across Europe. As our business and technology landscape continue to grow, we are now seeking an
 **Engineering Manager** 
 to lead our engineering organization and drive the development of scalable, reliable, and innovative digital solutions.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an experienced engineering leader with a passion for technology, people development, and modern software engineering. As Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for leading our engineering teams, shaping the technical strategy of our platform, and ensuring that technology investments support our long-term business goals. As a member of the TCS Management Team, you will play a critical role in defining the future of our products, platform, and engineering capabilities.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop engineering and data engineering teams, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture
* Own people leadership within the technology organization, including hiring, onboarding, development, feedback, and performance management
* Define and drive the strategy for the technical platform and engineering organization
* Balance business requirements with technical sustainability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency
* Ensure platform cost awareness and manage infrastructure and platform-related spending
* Support prioritization of technical investments, platform improvements, and engineering enablers
* Collaborate closely with MD, CFO, Product Lead, & Product Managers, the Operations team, rest of TRATON digital teams and managers, as well as technical leads within own organization to align technology direction and delivery priorities
* Support teams in removing organizational blockers, managing risks, and addressing dependencies
* Drive engineering excellence through high standards for quality, reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement
* Contribute to company strategy and decision-making as a member of the TCS Management Team


**Who You Are**
* Proven leadership experience managing software engineering teams in a fast-paced environment
* Strong understanding of software development processes, modern architectures, and cloud-based platforms
* Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to execution and problem-solving
* Passion for technology and a strong interest in artificial intelligence, agent-based systems, and emerging technologies
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and delivering complex digital products
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience balancing technical priorities with business objectives and operational efficiency
* Familiarity with data engineering, analytics platforms, or large-scale digital services is an advantage
* Experience within the TRATON GROUP technology landscape or commercial vehicle software development, particularly offboard services, is highly desirable
* Fluency in English


**This Is Us**
 TRATON Charging Solutions (TCS) is a relatively new company within the TRATON Group, the commercial vehicle group of Volkswagen Group, with brands such as Scania, MAN, International, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. TCS was created to address the key challenge of providing software products that support a seamless charging experience for electrified heavy transport. It is accelerating the transition to sustainable transport by delivering seamless charging services for commercial vehicles across Europe.
   

  

 TCS is approximately 30 people, with a presence in Stockholm and Munich. It operates as an independent unit within the TRATON Group, with a startup-like setup inside a large corporate environment.
   

  

**Me as a Manager**
 “I am a visionary leader who focuses on setting a clear direction and helping teams understand where we are heading. I enjoy building multidisciplinary teams and believe that diverse skills and perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. Collaboration is very important to me, and I encourage team members to work together rather than operate in silos. I give people a high level of trust and responsibility, empowering them to take ownership of their work while contributing to our shared goals.” - Petra Sundström, Managing Director
   

  

**TRATON Charging Solutions Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in mapor a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. The group also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-22. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
   

  

 Petra Sundström, Managing Director, petra.sundstrom@se.traton.com
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**
**This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Charging Solutions**

title: IT Systems & Support Technician
description:
**\*\*YOU MUST BE A CITIZEN OF THE EU OR EEA OR HAVE VALID WORK PERMIT TO WORK IN SWEDEN.\*\*** 




**This is a full-time, onsite position based in Stockholm, Sweden.** 




  





 Do you have a passion for gaming and IT operations? As a part of my3Twelve, you will have an opportunity to join a dynamic team supporting a global enterprise client. My3Twelve is seeking a technically skilled professional who thrives in both hands-on IT support and strategic systems administration. This role is ideal for someone eager to grow into advanced responsibilities, independently drive projects, and act as a technical project manager with minimal oversight. 
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 


* Provide front-line technical support, troubleshooting hardware/software issues, and delivering desktop support across multiple platforms
* Manage onboarding/offboarding IT tasks (PC build-out, dev kit setup, etc.)
* Maintain and optimize a large fleet of test devices (Windows, Android, Chrome OS, etc.)
* Transition lab operations to cloud-hosted environments
* Develop and deploy automation scripts (PowerShell or similar)
* Set up lab infrastructure (racking, cabling, servers, provisioning)
* Own and improve processes for managing technical requests, tracking issues, and communicating status
* Deliver both tactical (day-to-day) and strategic (long-term) IT projects
* Evaluate and recommend hardware solutions for diverse technical needs
* Monitor, maintain, and secure servers, networks, and computer systems
* Implement system updates, patches, backups, and disaster recovery operations
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and enhance system performance
* Document IT procedures and system configurations
* Independently drive projects to completion, acting as a technical project manager:
* Develop project plans and timelines
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks
* Communicate project status and milestones to stakeholders
* Facilitate team meetings and stakeholder reviews
* Track KPIs and project outcomes
* Capture lessons learned and implemented best practices



  





**Qualifications** 
  
 


* 3–5 years’ experience in IT operations or similar roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, C# preferred)
* Deep knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux), as well as using and automating Azure and XML
* Experience with network administration, security, and Azure virtual machines
* Familiarity with corporate IT environments (AAD, AD, Directory Services, SharePoint, ADO)
* Experience with ITIL-based helpdesk systems and ticketing platforms (JIRA, Autotask, Kaseya, etc.)
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Service-minded, positive, can-do attitude



  





**Highly Recommended:** 
  
 


* Experience in IT operations/engineering for a game studio
* Certifications: CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
* Experience troubleshooting client issues in complex corporate environments
* Experience in technical lab environments and front-line IT operations



  





 Pay: 25 000 - 50 000 SEK per month

title: Head of Group Business Solutions
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**Role Overview**
 The Group Head – Business Solutions is a strategic, AI-forward technology leader responsible for transforming the organization into an AI-first, product-led, digitally enabled enterprise.
   

  

 Reporting to the Group CIO, this role will treat the organization as a living, evolving product — designing, building, and continuously improving a seamless digital operating model powered by intelligent automation that reduces friction for employees and delivers a world-class customer experience.
   

  

 The mandate is to shift IT from a traditional service-provider function to a strategic business enabler by productizing core business capabilities, embedding AI-led product management practices, integrating enterprise platforms, driving operational excellence, and enabling scalable digital growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Productization & AI-Led Optimization of Business Functions
* Lead the transition to an AI-enabled, Product-Led IT operating model.
* Define and establish clear Product Domains (e.g., Lead-to-Cash, Employee Lifecycle, Financial Core, Customer Care Platform).
* Create structured, AI-integrated product roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* Conduct continuous discovery with business stakeholders to identify workflow friction and opportunities for cognitive automation.
* Apply value-stream mapping enhanced by predictive AI to optimize and automate end-to-end processes.
* Embed governance models for product lifecycle management, AI model lifecycle management (MLOps), and performance tracking.
* Strategic Platform Architecture & AI Integration
* Ensure ERP, CRM, HRIS, Finance, and Customer systems operate as a unified, integrated, and AI-orchestrated enterprise platform.
* Eliminate technology silos through API-led integration, middleware, and intelligent orchestration agents.
* Drive enterprise data governance, treating corporate data as a high-quality, accessible, and AI-ready business asset.
* Build scalable, modular systems designed to support long-term business growth and emerging generative AI technologies.
* Ensure architecture and AI deployment decisions align with security, ethical AI implementation, compliance, and performance standards.
* User-Centric Operational Excellence & Intelligent Experience


**Employee Experience (EX)**
* Design internal platforms with a consumer-grade, AI-personalized user experience.
* Improve usability and adoption of HRIS and generative AI-powered productivity tools.
* Track and improve internal digital satisfaction metrics.


**Customer Experience Transformation**
* Oversee the evolution of the Customer Care platform as a strategic brand touchpoint powered by advanced agentic AI.
* Enable an AI-driven, 360-degree view of the customer across systems.
* Drive intelligent automation, conversational AI, and self-service capabilities.


**Frictionless Digital Support**
* Implement generative AI and LLM-enabled automation to reduce manual interventions.
* Improve SLA performance and reduce operational bottlenecks through predictive routing and resolution.
* Enterprise Reliability & AI Governance
* Ensure high availability and reliability of business-critical systems (24/7 environments) using AI-driven predictive maintenance.
* Establish clear SLAs, KPIs, and operational dashboards.
* Strengthen cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and compliance frameworks with built-in AI safety and risk safeguards.
* Manage system performance, scalability, and technical debt.
* Change & Intelligent Transformation Leadership
* Lead enterprise-wide digital and AI transformation initiatives.
* Drive stakeholder alignment, AI literacy, and system adoption.
* Establish structured communication, training, and change frameworks focused on human-AI collaboration.
* Foster a culture of innovation, AI experimentation, and continuous improvement.
* Vendor & Ecosystem Management
* Lead strategic negotiations with global ERP, CRM, HRIS, and enterprise AI platform vendors.
* Optimize licensing, cost structures, and vendor performance.
* Minimize vendor lock-in risks through strong contractual, architectural, and open-source model governance.
* Manage system integrators and implementation partners effectively.


**Key Competencies Required**
**Strategic & AI-Led Mindset**
 You are able to connect long-term business goals with a clear and practical technology roadmap. You understand how technology investments and AI capabilities support growth, efficiency, and competitive advantage. You naturally default to AI-led product management methodologies to solve complex enterprise challenges.
   

  

**Operational Excellence**
 You have experience managing large, business-critical systems that require high availability and reliability. You ensure platforms and intelligent models are stable, secure, and capable of running 24/7 with minimal disruption.
   

  

**Customer & Employee Focus**
 You treat internal stakeholders as valued partners and prioritize delivering a seamless experience for both employees and customers. You actively seek feedback and design solutions enhanced by intelligent personalization with the end-user in mind.
   

  

**Change Management**
 You are comfortable leading digital transformation initiatives and managing the people side of change. You drive adoption of new systems and AI workflows through communication, training, upskilling, and stakeholder alignment.
   

  

**Vendor & AI Ecosystem Mastery**
 You have strong experience managing and negotiating with global technology vendors and AI providers. You focus on maximizing value, controlling costs, and reducing long-term dependency risks.
   

  

**Experience & Qualifications**
* 12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT leadership.
* Minimum 5+ years leading large-scale business systems, digital transformation, or enterprise AI adoption initiatives.
* Proven experience applying AI-led product management frameworks to automate business processes.
* Deep expertise in ERP, CRM, HRIS, and enterprise platform integration.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, AI model deployment, and data governance.
* Proven track record of managing high-availability enterprise environments.
* Experience leading large, cross-functional technology teams.
* Strong financial acumen, ROI evaluation of AI projects, and budget management experience.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Why Join Arrive?**
* Work on global-scale payment systems impacting millions of users.
* Be part of a growing India engineering team with strong ownership.
* Collaborate with diverse, international teams.
* Opportunity to influence architecture, AI strategy, and team growth.
* Build technology that directly improves urban mobility and sustainability.


**About Arrive**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition | Remote | Sweden
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Grafana Labs is looking for a
 **Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition** 
 based in Sweden who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across the
 **Nordics** 
 . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
* Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
* Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
* Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
* Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
* Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
* Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
* Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
* Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
* Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
* You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
* Fluent in English & Swedish or Danish or Norwegian or Finnish.


**Bonus Points For**
* Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
* Experience using Salesforce
* Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal


 Compensation & Rewards
   

  

 In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 1,400,000 - SEK 1,800,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Erfaren Konsult med tekniskt djup inom Test & Kvalitetssäkring
description:
**Vilka är vi?** 




 Test Scouts är ett konsultbolag med rötterna i Göteborg – och sedan förra året även i Stockholm. Vi siktar inte på att bli störst, men vi vill gärna bli bäst. Vi är en tight grupp erfarna och juniora specialister som delar ett genuint intresse för test och kvalitet. Hos oss är test inte ett steg i processen, det är hela poängen.
 



 Vi vill vara just specialister, inte generalister som råkar testa. Vi teamar gärna upp med verktygsleverantörer och håller oss uppdaterade på marknaden – men vi är verktygsagnostiker. Vårt jobb är att rekommendera rätt lösning för kunden, inte sälja en specifik stack.
 



 Stockholmskontoret är ungt och du får vara med och bygga det från grunden – men med ett stabilt och väletablerat bolag i Göteborg i ryggen. Du är inte ensam, men du har stort utrymme att påverka.
 



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Du har minst fyra års erfarenhet av test och kvalitet och en
 **tydlig** 
 spets inom teknik, med en stark basplatta inom test. Du jobbar med modern mjukvaruutveckling och förstår koncept som pipelines, CI/CD och principerna bakom DevOps och Agil utveckling.
 



 Du ser test som något mycket större än att bocka av en kravspecifikation. Du frågar "varför", jobbar lika bekvämt med affärskrav som systemkrav, och är inte rädd för att gräva i kod, databaser eller loggar när det behövs. Du har förmodligen skaffat dig erfarenhet långt utanför det som stod i din jobbeskrivning.
 



 Du är nyfiken, frågvis och kreativ med förmågan att se detaljer likväl som helheten. Du är drivande och självgående, kommunikativ och bra på att bygga relationer på alla nivåer. Du vill bli bättre – och du vill att branschen ska bli bättre.
 



  





 Du gillar, eller är nyfiken på, konsultrollen och vad den innebär, och förstår både vad den ger och kräver av dig. Du vill jobba fokuserat med test och kvalitet - och tycker tanken på ett bolag som bara fokuserar på det är ett plus.
 



  





**Du har förmodligen några av följande på ditt CV:** 




*Det viktigaste för oss just nu är att du antingen har praktisk, flerårig, hands-on, erfarenhet av testautomation och kod, eller har en* 
***mycket stark nischprofil***
*inom till exempel implementering av standardsystem – det är där vi ser störst behov på marknaden.* 




  





 Du har antagligen arbetat praktiskt med verktyg och ramverk som Playwright, Selenium, Cypress och Robot Framework. Du har minst grundläggande kunskaper om programmeringsspråk som Python, Java eller JavaScript/TypeScript. Du förstår koncept som CI/CD och DevOps och har jobbat i antingen Jira eller Azure DevOps. Git, Jenkins och Kubernetes är bekanta begrepp. API-testning är något du förstår och har gjort, till exempel med Postman och Bruno, eller likvärdiga verktyg.
 



  





 Har du jobbat med standardsystem är det ett stort plus – det är ett område vi vill växa i och lära oss mer om. Det kan handla om Lumera, SAP, ServiceNow, IFS, Dynamics 365, Salesforce eller liknande ERP- och CRM-plattformar. Vi ser ett växande behov av testare som verkligen förstår dessa system på djupet, inte bara testar runt dem.
 



 Vi ser också mycket behov inom bank, finans, försäkring och offentlig sektor – erfarenhet därifrån är ett extra plus.
 



  





**Vad får du hos oss?** 




 Du får vara med och bygga något från grunden i Stockholm, tillsammans med kollegor som tar test på allvar. Vi investerar kontinuerligt i kompetensutveckling – genom ett personligt mentorprogram, ett brett bibliotek och kunskapsbank, kurser, konferenser och interna kompetensforum. Du formar din väg, men vi gör mycket tillsammans.
 



 Ute hos kund arbetar du verksamhetsnära och förväntas coacha och leda kvalitetsarbetet, inte bara utföra det. Du hjälper kunden att bygga upp, vidareutveckla och implementera arbetssätt och processer som faktiskt håller – på kundens villkor, med din expertis.
 



 Vi samarbetar nära med kollegorna i Göteborg och träffas så ofta vi kan för att utbyta lärdomar och bibehålla vårt DNA. Du har din bas hos oss men bidrar med din testkompetens både internt och i uppdrag hos kund.
 



  





**Låter det som rätt match? Hör av dig!**

title: IT-specialist - PI System
description:
**Om oss** 




 På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.
 



 Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.
 



 Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.
 



  





**Arbetsbeskrivning** 




 Under ledning av systemansvarig IT och i nära samarbete med övriga medarbetare inom IT-förvaltningen och pågående projekt kommer konsulterna att arbeta med systemets vidmakthållande, det vill säga felrättningar, användarstöd, daglig IT-drift och underhåll, samt vidareutveckling i form av anpassningar och förbättringar.
 



 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter och ansvar:
 


* Driva och utföra uppgraderingar och systemförbättringar.
* Installera och konfigurera systemet samt iordningställa nya miljöer för tillkommande behov.
* Vidareutveckla systemet/lösningen genom att bistå vid teknisk kravspecificering, framtagande av nya lösningar och skapande av integrationer till datakällor.
* Ge stöd och support till interna och externa parter.
* Samarbeta med andra IT-förvaltningar, driftsorganisationer och intern personal vid behov.

* Ge användarstöd vid framtagning av rapporter i PI Vision.



 Arbetet kommer att kräva samarbete med andra projekt och förvaltningsorganisationer. Det är därför viktigt att konsulten har god kommunikativ och social förmåga, är samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta i grupp.
 



  






 Preliminärt startdatum: efter godkänd säkerhetsprövning
 





 Slutdatum:
 
 2029-01-04
 




 Option:
 
 Beställaren äger rätt att förlänga avtalet med 2 + 2 + 2 år, vilket innebär en möjlig slutpunkt senast 2035-01-04.
 



  





**Skallkrav** 




 1. högskole-/universitetsutbildning omfattande minst 120p/180hp inom IT, alternativt yrkeshögskoleutbildning omfattande minst 400 yrkeshögskolepoäng inom IT, alternativt minst 4 års arbetslivserfarenhet av roller som IT-specialist, systemadministratör eller systemutvecklare.
 



 2. ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet med installationer, uppgradering, konfiguration, vidmakthållande och applikationsdrift av AVEVA PI / OSISoft PI, de senaste 5 åren.
 



 3. ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet med support, samordning och kommunikation mot externa och interna parter
 



 4. erfarenhet av arbete i eller för en stor myndighet med samhällskritisk och komplex verksamhet. Med stor myndighet menas att antalet anställda överskrider 1500 medarbetare
 



 5. Erfarenhet av arbete inom energisektorn
 



  





  





**Ansökan** 




 När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.
 



 Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

title: Senior/Lead Data Scientist -Credit & Finance Model Validation
description:
**Klarna, briefly**
 At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.
   

  

 This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Klarna runs more than 200 predictive and AI/LLM models across credit scoring, fraud detection, AML/CTF, finance, and operations — and five people are responsible for independently challenging every one of them. You'd be the sixth, joining model risk within Risk Control to own model risk policy and governance and to review and challenge the models built by teams across the business.
   

  

 The team, led by Edward McAvoy, has depth in software engineering and model development, but limited experience in credit risk and underwriting, and in provisioning, impairment, and IFRS9 modelling for finance. That's the specific gap this position closes: you'll bring hands-on model-building experience in those areas and use it to independently challenge models built by the first line.
   

  

 Given the ratio of models to reviewers, you won't have time to check every model with equal depth. You'll need to identify which parts of a model carry the most risk and concentrate your challenge there, and you'll help build the code base and AI tooling that lets the team scale its coverage rather than working through the backlog line by line.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You'll independently review and challenge predictive and AI/LLM models built by the first line, across credit scoring, fraud detection, AML/CTF, finance (including impairments), and operations.
* You'll work directly with model developers and business users to pinpoint control weaknesses in how models are built and used, and follow through until they're fixed.
* You'll extend the team's code base and AI tooling so more of Klarna's models can be challenged, and challenged more deeply, without adding headcount.
* You'll help decide which models and model risks get the team's limited validation time, prioritizing by risk rather than working through the queue in order.
* You'll draw on your own experience building models to test whether a model's assumptions, data, and methodology hold up, not just whether its documentation does.


**Who You Are**
* You've hands-on experience building predictive models for credit risk or underwriting — you've sat on the first line, not just reviewed someone else's work from the second.
* You understand provisioning, impairment, and IFRS9 modelling well enough to assess how a finance model estimates losses, not just how it's coded.
* You're proficient in Python and SQL for building, running, and interrogating models.
* You can work independently with model developers and business stakeholders, challenge their assumptions, and push back on weak controls even when that's an uncomfortable conversation.
* You can prioritize which risks in a model matter most, rather than trying to check everything with equal depth.


**Bonus points for**
* You've validated or independently challenged models before, ideally from a second-line risk function.
* You have hands-on experience with PySpark for distributed data processing.
* You've worked with cloud platforms such as AWS.


**Things you should know before applying**
* This position is open in both Stockholm and London; you'll work from whichever location you're hired into.
* Depending on your experience, this position will be leveled as Senior Data Scientist or Lead Data Scientist.
* Validation windows for individual models are tight, so you'll need to focus your challenge on a model's riskiest aspects rather than reviewing it end to end.
* Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
* Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
* Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.


 Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.
   

  

 Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site!

title: Senior RF Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Coherent is a global leader in photonics, developing advanced laser, optical and materials technologies that enable semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications and precision industrial applications worldwide.
   

  

 In Sweden, our teams operate the country’s only full-scale indium phosphide wafer fabrication facility. Here, we design, manufacture and test some of the world’s fastest optical chips under one roof, supporting AI infrastructure, data centres and global communications networks.
   

  

**The Role**
 You will be responsible for the RF evaluation and characterisation of high-speed optoelectronic and semiconductor components, working hands-on within our engineering test laboratory.
   

  

 This role combines RF measurement, device characterisation, test development and data analysis, giving you the opportunity to work closely with Product Verification, Design, Test Development and Manufacturing Engineering teams.
   

  

 You will also act as an RF technical expert within the laboratory, helping develop measurement capabilities, improve products and technologies, and share your expertise across the wider engineering organisation.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Perform hands-on RF measurements and device characterisation at wafer, chip and chip-on-carrier level.
* Lead the development, refinement and evaluation of RF measurement methods, procedures and engineering test setups.
* Design and implement dedicated RF test structures to extract device characteristics and support model development.
* Analyse measurement data, correlate practical results with simulations and provide structured technical feedback to Design teams.
* Specify, plan and coordinate test samples and prototype development in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.
* Act as an RF technical expert within the laboratory and maintain strong technical competence in RF and high-speed device characterisation.
* Develop clear technical documentation to support product development, engineering activities and knowledge transfer.
* Contribute to continuous product and technology improvements, including supporting production-related processes where required.
* Identify and promote new component technologies, measurement methodologies and engineering best practices.
* Mentor and support colleagues across Product Verification, Design and Test Development by sharing technical knowledge and expertise.


**About You**
 You are a hands-on RF engineer who enjoys working in the laboratory, developing measurement methods and using experimental data to understand and improve high-speed semiconductor and optoelectronic devices.
   

  

**You Will Ideally Bring**
* A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Physics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* At least 2 years of professional experience within optoelectronics, semiconductor devices, RF engineering, electrical engineering, engineering physics or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of RF measurements and high-speed optoelectronic or semiconductor device characterisation.
* Hands-on experience within an RF or optoelectronic test laboratory.
* Experience with test and measurement equipment, laboratory hardware and test automation for semiconductor device characterisation.
* Knowledge of data analysis, statistical analysis and Design of Experiments (DoE).
* The ability to correlate practical measurement results with theoretical simulations and modelling.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to share technical knowledge effectively.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to work across Engineering, Product Verification, Manufacturing Engineering and other technical functions.


 Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:
   

  

 🤝 Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust
   

  

 ✨ Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas
   

  

 🎯 Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome
   

  

 🌍 Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone
   

  

 🚀 Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

* A supportive, professional and international working environment.
* The opportunity to work within an innovation-driven company at the forefront of advanced photonics and semiconductor technology.
* Subsidised massage at the office.
* The possibility of quarterly or annual bonus programmes.
* A generous wellness allowance and access to health-promoting activities.


 Application & Selection
   

  

 We apply a continuous selection process, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, reference checks and alcohol and drug screening are conducted prior to employment.
   

  

 If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to kris.cairns@coherent.com. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.
   

  

**About Us**
 Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!
   

  

**Note to recruiters and employment agencies:** 
 We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Senior Network Security Engineer** 




**Location:** 
 Södertälje, Sweden – onsite with travel to Gothenburg as required
 



**Contract Rate:** 
 Up to $450 per day
 



**Contract:** 
 Initial 6-month contract
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Security Engineer to support a major enterprise network security and wireless transformation programme in Sweden.
 



  





 The position will be split approximately 70% Network Security / 30% Enterprise Wireless, making this an excellent opportunity for an engineer with strong network security expertise combined with hands-on Cisco wireless experience.
 



  





 The successful candidate will work closely with technical teams and business stakeholders, so excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences are essential.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, implement and support secure enterprise network architectures.
* Support network security initiatives across a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Configure, manage and troubleshoot enterprise firewall technologies, including Cisco and Palo Alto.
* Work with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
* Support intrusion detection/prevention, SIEM and security incident response activities.
* Work with Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions.
* Follow enterprise governance, ITSM and CMDB processes.
* Support enterprise wireless network design, implementation and troubleshooting.
* Conduct and interpret wireless site surveys and heat maps.
* Design and support multipath routing and failover solutions.
* Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organisation.
* Travel to operational sites when required.



  





**Essential Experience** 



* Strong professional background in Network Security and secure network design.
* Hands-on experience with Zscaler ZPA and ZIA.
* Strong firewall experience, ideally Cisco and/or Palo Alto.
* Experience with IDS/IPS, SIEM and security incident response.
* Strong Cisco enterprise wireless networking experience.
* Knowledge of 802.11k, 802.11v and 802.11w.
* Experience with Wi-Fi 6 or newer wireless technologies.
* Strong understanding of wireless site survey methodologies.
* Experience analysing wireless heat maps and network behaviour.
* Experience designing and supporting multipath routing with failover.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders.
* Willing and able to work onsite in Södertälje and travel to Gothenburg when required.



  





**Desirable Certifications** 




 Relevant certifications may include:
 


* Cisco CCNP / CCIE Security
* Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator
* Zscaler Zero Trust Certified Associate
* Cisco CyberOps Associate / Professional
* Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE
* Check Point CCSA / CCSE
* CISSP or CompTIA Security+



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We are particularly interested in engineers who combine enterprise network security expertise with strong Cisco wireless knowledge. Candidates should be comfortable operating within a complex enterprise environment, engaging with multiple stakeholders and providing hands-on technical expertise across both security and wireless networking.

title: SAP Senior Consultant (QM)
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. At Packaged Based Solutions (PBS) Nordics, a Capgemini unit specializing in ERP transformation, you will be part of a strong Nordic team delivering lasting value to our clients. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

**Your role**
 We are expanding our SAP practice in Sweden and are seeking experienced
 **SAP QM Consultants** 
 who want to play a key role in some of the most exciting SAP S/4HANA transformation programs on the market. As an SAP QM Consultant, you will play a key role in designing and implementing SAP Quality Management solutions within large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs. You will work closely with clients to improve quality processes across manufacturing and supply chain operations. If you are passionate about quality management, business transformation, and helping clients unlock value through SAP, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

*In this role you will play a key role in:*
* Leading design and implementation of SAP QM solutions in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across areas such as PP, MM, EWM, and Supply Chain.
* Drive end-to-end project deliveries, from requirements gathering to go-live and hypercare.
* Support clients in their digital transformation journey through industry best practices and innovation.


**Your profile**

* Experience from multiple SAP implementation or transformation projects, preferably SAP S/4HANA.
* Strong understanding of quality processes within manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Ability to lead complex workstreams and act as a senior advisor to stakeholders.
* Fluent in Swedish and English; based in Sweden.


**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* Freedom to shape your work, manage your time with hybrid flexibility, and have the space to be creative, innovate, and make a real difference.
* A variety of social and wellness activities, from sports and health programs to cultural events and art initiatives, designed to bring employees together and enrich work life.
* An inspiring environment where you can accelerate your growth through continuous learning, professional certifications, and world-class programs from Udemy, Harvard Manager Mentor, and our trusted partner learnings.
* Collaborate with a nordic and global network of experts, gain cutting-edge insights, and stay ahead in the latest technologies and business practices.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Automotive (Customer Facing)
description:
**Applications via the Infineon Portal only:** 




 https://jobs.infineon.com/careers/job/563808971893537
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer to develop and deploy AI solutions for automotive applications running on Infineon Automotive microcontrollers.
 



 In this role, you will collaborate with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, systems engineers, and embedded software teams to bring machine learning capabilities to safety-critical automotive systems. You will be responsible for designing, optimizing, and deploying machine learning models for resource-constrained environments, enabling intelligent sensing, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, driver monitoring, vehicle diagnostics, and other advanced automotive use cases.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with a solid understanding of embedded systems, automotive software development, and real-time constraints.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, train, validate, and optimize machine learning models for automotive applications on Infineon microcontrollers such as AURIX™, Traveo™ and PSOC™.
* Work with sensor, system, and application experts to identify suitable AI approaches for customer problems.
* Collect, analyze, and preprocess automotive sensor and system data, define data collection and labeling strategies, and develop validation methodologies that ensure robust machine learning model performance under real-world operating conditions.
* Support customers and internal teams in identifying and evaluating AI use cases and develop proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and customer reference implementations demonstrating the value of Edge AI in automotive systems
* Participate in customer workshops, technical presentations, and solution reviews.



  
 



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor or Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, time-series analysis, signal processing, and deep learning fundamentals.
* Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, ONNX, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience deploying machine learning models on resource-constrained devices incl. knowledge of TinyML, model quantization, model compression, feature engineering, and real-time inference optimization.
* Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts, performance profiling, and automotive-grade microcontrollers.
* Proactive self-starter who takes ownership, contributes to strategic discussions, adapts to evolving priorities, and helps shape the future of our products.
* Collaborative and independent engineer who maintains high programming standards while supporting colleagues and ensuring customer success.



  
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Understanding of automotive electronics and software architectures.
* Familiarity with AUTOSAR, ISO 26262, and automotive development processes.
* Experience integrating software in safety-critical or real-time systems is desirable.
* Experience with automotive radar, inertial sensing, acoustic sensing, motor control, battery management systems, or industrial sensing applications.



  
 



**What we offer:** 



* The opportunity to further develop our development platform, responsible for bringing deep learning to the edge
* Being a part of an excellent international team with highly motivated individuals striving for a common goal
* A chance to be a part of solving real-world problems using ML
* Competitive salary, wellness allowance, possibility to attend online-courses
* A humble and an open-minded company culture
* Opportunities to grow with the company and advance your career
* Short decision paths, we love getting things done
* An office in central Stockholm and the flexibility of working from home



  





**Applications via the Infineon Portal only:**

title: Senior Data Scientist/AI-engineer
description:
Wise IT söker för kunds räkning en senior Data Scientist/AI-ingenjör med en kombinerad verksamhetsnära och teknisk profil. Uppdraget fokuserar på att identifiera, kvalificera, prioritera och realisera AI-drivna förbättringar som skapar konkret verksamhetsnytta och samtidigt stärker organisationens långsiktiga AI-förmåga.
   

  

**OM UPPDRAGET // MAKE IMPACT WHERE IT MATTERS**
 Du arbetar nära verksamheten och IT för att föra prioriterade initiativ från identifierat behov till praktisk verifiering. Arbetet omfattar intervjuer, workshops, processgenomlysningar och analys av arbetssätt samt kartläggning av processer, informationsflöden, datakällor och tekniska förutsättningar.
   

  

**I Uppdraget Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* Identifiera verksamhetsområden, arbetsmoment och processer där AI kan skapa nytta.
* Planera och genomföra intervjuer, workshops, processgenomlysningar och analyser av arbetssätt.
* Vidareutveckla och kvalitetssäkra befintliga AI-use cases samt identifiera nya möjligheter.
* Kartlägga processer, informationsflöden, datakällor och tekniska förutsättningar.
* Bedöma verksamhetsnytta, genomförbarhet, risker och lämpliga lösningsalternativ.
* Prioritera initiativ utifrån effekt, genomförbarhet och strategisk relevans.
* Utveckla och testa prototyper, proof of concepts eller andra verifierande lösningar.
* Förbereda prioriterade och verifierade lösningar för införande, produktionssättning, överlämning och förvaltning.
* Dokumentera arbetssätt, bedömningar och lärdomar för återanvändning.
* Genomföra kunskapsöverföring till berörda delar av organisationen.


 Arbetet bedrivs verksamhetsnära och iterativt, med utgångspunkt i faktiska verksamhetsproblem och mål snarare än en förutbestämd teknisk lösning. Analys och fördjupning kombineras med snabb praktisk verifiering, tydlig förankring och löpande dokumentation.
   

  

**UPPDRAGSINFORMATION**
* Uppdragsperiod: 1 oktober 2026 till 31 mars 2027
* Omfattning: totalt 520 timmar
* Plats: Hybrid, med närvaro enligt verksamhetens behov
* Sista anbudsdag: 9 september 2026


**DIN PROFIL // YOU BRING THE EDGE**
 För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du uppfylla följande krav:
   

  

**Skallkrav**
* Erfarenhet av att leda och strukturera AI-relaterade workshops och förstudier samt omsätta resultatet till prioriterade och verksamhetsnära use cases.
* Förmåga att genom intervjuer, behovsanalys och kravfångst fördjupa förståelsen för nuläge, processer, målbild och förbättringsmöjligheter.
* Teknisk kompetens inom data och AI, exempelvis maskininlärning, generativ AI, LLM/RAG, datamodellering och data pipelines.
* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling eller lösningsdesign, exempelvis backend, frontend eller webbaserade lösningar.
* Förmåga att bedöma teknisk genomförbarhet och föreslå hållbara lösningsalternativ.
* Vana att samarbeta med IT kring helhetsbild, integrationer, plattformar, informationssäkerhet och förutsättningar för realisering i befintlig miljö.
* Erfarenhet av datakartläggning och datastrukturering, inklusive identifiering och värdering av datakällor, datakvalitet och formering av data för AI och analys.
* Förmåga att ta fram och vidareutveckla prototyper, proof of value och enklare verktyg som snabbt testar nyttan i verkliga arbetsflöden.
* Förmåga att moderera workshops, hålla avstämningar och pedagogiskt förankra idéer, risker och rekommendationer hos chefer, specialister och slutanvändare.
* Möjlighet att genomföra uppdraget under cirka sex månader med 50 procents beläggning.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet från försäkring, pension, finansiella tjänster eller annan reglerad verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av nyttorealisering, portföljprioritering eller etablering av arbetssätt för kontinuerlig förbättring.
* Erfarenhet av att bygga intern förmåga genom praktiskt lärande, dokumenterade arbetssätt och kunskapsöverföring inom AI, data eller digital verksamhetsutveckling.


**OM ORGANISATIONEN // CULTURE WITH REAL CHARACTER**
 Uppdraget genomförs hos en organisation inom pension och försäkring som har påbörjat sitt arbete med AI genom workshops, fördjupning av use cases och initiativ där AI-stöd har införts i utvalda processer.
   

  

 Organisationen befinner sig nu i nästa fas, där fokus ligger på att öka takten från idé och identifierat användningsfall till verifierad verksamhetsnytta. Målet är att skapa en tydligare prioriterad portfölj av AI-relaterade förbättringsmöjligheter, verifiera initiativ och stärka den interna förmågan att självständigt identifiera, utvärdera och driva AI-initiativ vidare.
   

  

**NÄR DU BLIR PARTNER**
 Som partnerkonsult hos Wise kliver du in i en gemenskap där samarbete är kärnan. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med några av marknadens mest intressanta uppdrag, i organisationer där både människor och teknik är i centrum. För oss är det avgörande att du känner dig trygg och värdesatt i vårt samarbete. Vi stöttar dig, coachar dig och finns med dig hela vägen genom uppdraget. Hos oss är du inte bara konsult, du blir en del av en större helhet.
   

  

**DIN ANSÖKAN // TALENT SPEAKS LOUDER**
 För att söka rollen klickar du på ”Ansök nu” och bifogar ditt CV. Notera att vi inte kan ta emot ansökningar via mejl. Sista dagen för att skicka in anbudet till kunden är den 9 september 2026. Vänta därför inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

title: ASIC SoC Verification Engineer
description:

**About this opportunity:**
 Join our ASIC Top-Level Verification team and take on some of the most challenging verification tasks in the industry. You'll ensure that our ASICs meet our high standards for performance, functionality, and security while playing a critical role in developing environments and tests across multiple platforms.
   

  

 We specialize in the top-level verification of cutting-edge ASICs that power complex high-performance systems. Our designs range from monolithic ASICs to integrated multi-chip modules containing hundreds of processor cores, DSPs, ARM cores, tailored hardware accelerator IPs, and high-speed interfaces including Ethernet, CPRI, and PCIe.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Develop SoC-level test cases with opportunities to specialize in areas such as:
* External interface traffic patterns
* ASIC internal functionality (DSPs, MCUs, CPU cores, ARM infrastructure)
* Switches, security, SerDes, DDR, Coresight, and external memory systems
* Define and document verification strategies for assigned ASIC components
* Develop and execute tests in SystemC/TLM simulation, RTL environments, and hardware emulation
* Participate in silicon-level verification activities
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure comprehensive coverage and quality


**The skills you bring:**
* Proven background in IP, SubSystem, or SoC-level verification
* Strong understanding of SoC verification methodologies and best practices
* Experience with SystemC/TLM simulation and RTL verification environments
* Familiarity with hardware emulation platforms
* Knowledge of high-speed interfaces and complex system architectures
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience with DSP, CPU, or ARM verification
* Knowledge of security verification techniques
* Exposure to SerDes, DDR, or Coresight verification
* Hardware emulation or silicon-level verification experience
* Familiarity with industry-standard verification languages and methodologies


**Success Looks Like:**
* Demonstrable growth in verification expertise and scope of responsibility
* Delivering comprehensive test coverage and catching critical design issues
* Contributing value to the overall team through effective collaboration
* Advancing technical capabilities within the verification organization

title: Säkerhetsstrateg till Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset
description:
Vill du bidra till att stärka säkerheten på ett av Europas ledande universitetssjukhus? Har du erfarenhet av strategiskt säkerhetsarbete och vill arbeta i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där ditt arbete gör skillnad – i vardag, kris och höjd beredskap? Då kan tjänsten som säkerhetsstrateg på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset vara rätt för dig.
   

  

**Du erbjuds**
* en strategisk nyckelroll där du bidrar till att utveckla och stärka säkerhetsarbetet i en samhällsviktig verksamhet
* möjlighet att leda och utveckla processer, styrdokument och arbetssätt inom säkerhetsområdet
* ett nära samarbete med engagerade kollegor och ledare i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där säkerhet och beredskap är högt prioriterat
* ett meningsfullt uppdrag där du bidrar till ökad motståndskraft för patienter, medarbetare och samhället.


 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är ett av Europas ledande universitetssjukhus och rankas internationellt som en av världens främsta vårdaktörer. Verksamheten bedrivs i en svensk och internationell kontext med uppdrag inom högspecialiserad vård, forskning och utbildning. Mot bakgrund av det säkerhetspolitiskt förändrade omvärldsläget är säkerhets- och beredskapsarbetet en viktig del av sjukhusets utveckling och motståndskraft i vardag, kris och höjd beredskap.
   

  

 Som säkerhetsstrateg arbetar du med att utveckla organisationens strategiska säkerhetsarbete inom flera delar av säkerhetsområdet, exempelvis fysisk säkerhet vid byggprojekt m.m. En viktig del av uppdraget är att ta fram, implementera och följa upp processer, styrdokument och rutiner. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även hot-, risk- och sårbarhetsbedömningar.
   

  

 Du är ett kvalificerat stöd till chefer och ledning i säkerhetsrelaterade frågor i såväl vardag som kris. Rollen kräver att du kan analysera behov, se samband och omsätta strategier till praktiskt genomförbara arbetssätt. Med ett pedagogiskt arbetssätt bidrar du till att skapa förståelse, engagemang och förankring för säkerhetsfrågor i verksamheten.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* är analytisk och har förmåga att identifiera risker, se samband och omsätta komplex information till välgrundade bedömningar och praktiska lösningar
* arbetar strukturerat och planerar, organiserar och driver ditt arbete framåt på ett metodiskt och kvalitetssäkert sätt
* är självgående, tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och driver utvecklings- och säkerhetsfrågor framåt med ett gott omdöme
* har god samarbetsförmåga och bygger förtroendefulla relationer genom ett lyhört, prestigelöst och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt
* kommunicerar tydligt och pedagogiskt samt har förmåga att anpassa ditt budskap till olika målgrupper och skapa förståelse för säkerhets- och säkerhetsskyddsfrågor
* har hög integritet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt.


 Vi lägger mycket stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* relevant akademisk examen eller annan eftergymnasial utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
* flera års erfarenhet av strategiskt säkerhetsarbete i liknande roll
* goda kunskaper om lagstiftning inom säkerhetsområdet
* erfarenhet av att utveckla, implementera och följa upp processer, styrdokument och arbetssätt
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, i både tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* erfarenhet av bedömningar av fysiskt skydd för lokaler samt kravställning av säkerhetsåtgärder vid projekt, upphandlingar eller liknande
* erfarenhet av att leda projekt och/eller samordna arbetsgrupper
* erfarenhet av samverkan med myndigheter och andra externa aktörer
* erfarenhet av internt säkerhetsarbete inom offentlig verksamhet
* erfarenhet av både strategiskt och operativt säkerhetsskyddsarbete
* hög digital mognad och förståelse för den tekniska utvecklingen inom säkerhetsområdet.


**Om rekryteringsprocessen**
 Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.
   

  

 I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.
   

  

 Befattningen som säkerhetsstrateg är inplacerad i säkerhetsklass och förutsätter en godkänd säkerhetsprövning.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!
   

  

 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
