title: Senior Product Designer - Subscriptions
description:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission brings together teams working across the subscriber experience, including awareness and acquisition, activation, retention and conversion, commerce and customer service, and our free and paid products.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape intuitive experiences that make a meaningful difference for Spotify users. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Design to understand complex problems, explore new possibilities, and create experiences that deliver value for our users and our business.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Lead design across key parts of the subscriptions experience, from early exploration through launch and iteration.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Design to understand user needs, frame problems, and shape product direction.
* Turn complex user and business needs into simple, intuitive experiences.
* Use research, data, experimentation, and design judgment to guide decisions and measure outcomes.
* Explore different approaches, build prototypes, and use feedback to develop ideas into high-quality experiences.
* Help shape longer-term product and design direction while delivering against priorities today.
* Share your thinking clearly, build alignment, and bring partners along throughout the design process.
* Strengthen the work around you by sharing knowledge, offering thoughtful feedback, and contributing to Spotify’s wider design community.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have experience designing and shipping digital products or services that solve meaningful user problems.
* You can lead complex design work and collaborate effectively with partners across disciplines.
* You’re comfortable working across the product design process, from defining problems and exploring concepts to prototyping, delivery, and iteration.
* You use qualitative and quantitative insights alongside design judgment to make informed decisions.
* You communicate the thinking behind your work clearly and know how to build alignment with partners and stakeholders.
* You care about craft and the details of an experience while keeping broader user and business outcomes in view.
* You’re curious about emerging tools and technologies, including AI and generative design, and explore practical ways to use them in your workflow.
* You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, making thoughtful trade-offs, and adapting as you learn.
* You seek out different perspectives and help create an inclusive, collaborative environment where people can do their best work.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Why Grasp**
 Grasp is an agentic AI platform for finance. The $1.4 trillion financial advisory industry relies heavily on costly and scarce cognitive labor. We conduct complex company and market research workflows end-to-end, tasks typically done manually. AI is bound to transform how the industry operates, and Grasp is the platform leading that shift in how companies find and assess M&A opportunities.
   

  

 Grasp already counts ~300 of the world's largest financial institutions among its customers, including all of the Big Four and some of Europe's leading private equity firms. We have strong product-market fit, as proven by our 4x per year growth, and are now accelerating our distribution efforts beyond Europe. Grasp is backed by globally renowned investors Octopus Ventures and Yanno Capital.
   

  

**Role**
 Our users build lists of thousands of companies, send agents out to research them, screen them down to a shortlist, and carry the result into their deal flow. On screen that means dense tables, agents that run for minutes, a chat interface which needs to be able to back up where every number came from, and a lot of information competing for attention at once. Power users spend hours on end every week in the platform, often under time pressure. The experience needs to feel fast, simple, and trustworthy, which is a real design problem.
   

  

 We already have a coded component library and an engineering team that ships quickly with coding agents. What we don't have is the layer above it: an information architecture that holds as the product grows, a visual language that is unmistakably ours, and a system good enough that an engineer with a coding agent produces a delightful experience that is on-brand without a designer in the room.
   

  

 Expect roughly 70% of your first six months to go into design system, information architecture, visual language, and brand, and the balance to shift toward feature design once the foundation holds. You'll be our second designer and own the system, IA, and visual language whereas our current designer owns flows and features.
   

  

 Product sets product direction. Design owns the experience. Engineering owns implementation and performance. Dedicated specialists called “Finance AI specialist” own the quality of data and agent workflows. We ship fast, collaborate closely but also expect everyone to contribute with their unique craft and ideas.
   

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* Owning the information architecture of the product, and keeping it coherent as we add surfaces
* Taking our design system from functional to distinct, in Figma and / or in the shadcn library such that coding agents produce on-brand UI by default, through components, tokens, patterns, and the rules our engineers build against
* Setting the visual language for Grasp and holding the bar on what ships
* Extending the brand consistently across product, website, and sales material
* Independently spotting new opportunities for better experiences and how the product can deliver more value to users
* Doing deep research and discovery on customers' needs and preferences to inform workflow and feature design


**Skills And Requirements**
 We're considering candidates at Mid, Senior and Staff level and will calibrate on demonstrated scope and craft.
   

  

**For this role you should:**
* Have a proven track record of delivering impact from spotting opportunities to finished product
* Be exceptional at visual craft, with a point of view on typography, density, motion, and brand
* Have owned the information architecture of a product that grew, not just the screens inside it
* Have built or substantially evolved a design system that engineers used daily
* Prototype beyond static Figma files, in code or with AI tools, and demonstrate curiosity and agency with AI tooling and methods
* Be able to set direction on your own, without a design organisation behind you


**Additionally, we think you will thrive in this role if you:**
* Hold a higher bar for your own work than anyone around you is asking for, and are relentless about improving your craft and the product for customers
* Enjoy complexity and can get excited about building product for expert users deep in a problem space
* Like to move fast, with a high sense of urgency in getting things done
* Have the courage to advocate for what you believe is right, and the humility to change your mind when someone shows you better
* Enjoy working next to engineers with no handoff, shaping decisions while things are being built


**What We Offer**
* A unique opportunity to join a fast-growing startup scaling globally
* The chance to work with a team that is pushing the boundaries of what AI can do, both for our customers and for how we build product
* Lots of responsibility from day one and an opportunity to flex your design craft from user research to brand design
* A competitive compensation package, incl. stock options

title: Design Director
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**The Role**
 As Design Director for our Engagement Tools and Insights area, you will own parts of the core experience that hundreds of millions of people rely on to turn passive audiences into active participants. This is a role for a design leader who sets direction by shaping the work, not only by managing it.
   

  

 You will join a product company at a pivotal moment. As Mentimeter evolves from a single tool into an integrated Engagement Suite, the hardest and most valuable design problems now live at the seams, where journeys span areas and coherence is a competitive advantage. You will operate in two primary contexts: within your Product Area Leadership, where the work happens alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director, and within the Design Leadership Team, partnering the Chief Design Officer and fellow Design leaders. You will define the experience direction for your areas and make sure design decisions translate into measurable customer and business impact.
   

  

 You will report to the Chief Design Officer.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for a design leader who leads through the work. Someone with the judgment to set a clear experience direction and the hands-on capability to raise the quality bar by shaping, critiquing, and making alongside the team.
   

  

 You have led designers in fast-moving, product-led environments, and you have earned your credibility through the impact and quality of your work. You are as comfortable owning experience strategy for a product area as you are getting into the detail of a flow that isn't good enough yet. You operate as a true peer to product and engineering leaders, and you believe design is at its best when it drives outcomes, not when it decorates them.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Set the experience direction: Define a clear experience vision and architecture for your product areas, and hold the quality bar that makes it real.
* Shape what doesn't exist yet: Lead the design of new AI powered products, navigating the ambiguity and complexity of finding product-market fit where there is no established path to follow.
* Drive product impact through design: Own the link between design decisions and the metrics that matter, including activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Lead as a peer in the area: Work alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director to shape area strategy and roadmap, driving user and experience thinking into the decisions that set direction.
* Own coherence across the Engagement Suite: Take responsibility for experience quality at the boundaries with adjacent areas, so journeys that span the product feel like one product.
* Develop the craft and the team: Recruit, coach, and grow Product Designers primarily through the work itself, calibrating performance honestly and having the direct conversations that help people grow.
* Raise the bar with your peers: Work with fellow design leaders to hold shared experience principles and a shared quality standard across the craft, giving and taking critique at leadership level.
* Evolve practice through AI: Push how design understands, explores, prototypes, and delivers with AI, increasing speed and quality while protecting product thinking and craft.


**Requirements**
* 8+ years in design, including mid-to-senior management experience leading designers in fast-moving, product-led organisations.
* Proven track record of creating impactful product outcomes through design leadership and delivery.
* High personal design capability, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft judgment and range.
* A player-coach leadership style: credible with senior designers, and effective at developing them through the work.
* Track record of setting experience direction and connecting design decisions to measurable product outcomes.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to hold your own as a peer to product and engineering leadership.
* Exceptional communication skills, able to align teams and stakeholders around a clear direction.
* Practical experience applying AI to design exploration, prototyping, and delivery.


**Not Required**
 You don’t have to know Swedish. Daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!
   

  

**Compensation**
*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.*
*The salary range for this role is SEK88,000 - SEK102,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role. Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.*
*We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager and build skills, contribute to our mission and have meaningful impact.*
*In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm*
**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Digital Content & Web Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
*This is a fixed term, 9-month assignment.*
**Shape And Improve The Electrolux Home Web Experience**
 At Electrolux, we have been improving everyday life for more than 100 years. Today, digital experiences play an important role in how we engage consumers, support our partners and drive growth across our channels.
   

  

 We are now looking for a hands-on Digital Content & Web Specialist to join the Electrolux Home marketing team on a 9-month assignment. In this role, you will help improve the Electrolux Home website by working with content, customer journeys, navigation, web performance and data-driven optimization.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong web management experience with a commercial mindset and enjoys turning insights into concrete improvements that strengthen the customer experience and support business performance.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As Digital Content & Web Specialist, you will support the day-to-day development and optimisation of the Electrolux Home website, with a focus on content quality, user experience, conversion and operational excellence.
   

  

**You will:**
* Manage and optimize website content, landing pages and navigation to improve the customer journey.
* Use web analytics, customer behavior data and performance insights to identify improvement opportunities.
* Identify and help resolve friction points, UX issues and conversion barriers across the website.
* Support campaign launches by ensuring that web content, landing pages and customer journeys are ready and effective.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, tech teams, agencies and external partners to prioritize and implement improvements.
* Track key website KPIs such as traffic, engagement, conversion and commercial performance.
* Contribute to improving web processes, governance and ways of working to ensure a high-quality digital experience.


**What You Bring**
 You are a hands-on web and content specialist with a strong commercial mindset. You understand how content, UX, navigation and data work together to improve the customer journey and drive digital performance. You are structured, proactive and comfortable working with several stakeholders to get things done.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in web management, digital content, e-commerce or website optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience working with CMS platforms and managing website content.
* Good understanding of digital customer journeys, UX principles and conversion optimization.
* Experience using web analytics tools, such as GA4, to identify issues and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to translate insights into concrete actions that improve engagement, conversion and commercial performance.
* Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product, tech teams and/or external partners.
* Fluent in Swedish is a must.


**Nice to have**
* Experience from D2C or e-commerce environments.
* Knowledge of SEO best practices.
* Experience with CRO, A/B testing or landing page optimization.
* Experience supporting digital campaigns or coordinating agencies and external partners.


**Why join us?**
 This is an opportunity to make a visible impact on one of Electrolux Home’s key consumer-facing digital platforms. You will be part of a collaborative and international environment where your expertise and actions will help improve the digital experience for consumers and support commercial growth.
   

  

 Screening of applications will start in August, after the summer vacation break.

title: Senior Visual Designer - Brand & Product
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Senior Brand Designer** 
 focused on
 **Product Marketing!** 
 You'll own the visual output that makes our product tangible and compelling, from key visuals and decks to product shoots and videos in the brand studio. You'll join the Brand team and work closely with the Product Marketing team, Copywriter, Web Designer and other Brand Designers, translating product stories into work that looks and feels unmistakably Legora. A Project Manager across web and product will work side-by-side with you to keep things moving.This is a hands-on execution and craft role. You're not just executing briefs, you bring a strong point of view on what will make product marketing stand out, and you take ownership of the work from concept to final output.
   

  

**The Responsibilities**
**Key product visuals.** 
 Design the visual assets that carry our product marketing: campaign visuals, feature launches, social and web assets, with a consistently high bar for craft.
   

  

**Product shoots and videos.** 
 Own product-related photo and video shoots end-to-end, whether shot in the brand studio or on location in market. Work closely with the Project Manager and Product Marketing to plan and resource shoots.
   

  

**Decks and sales enablement.** 
 Own the design of decks and sales enablement materials used across product marketing and growth, turning dense content into visually clear, well-structured, on-brand output.
   

  

**Agency & partner network.** 
 Bring a strong point of view and network of photographers, videographers and other creative partners. Source external agencies and freelancers to elevate output where needed.
   

  

**Cross-functional collaboration.** 
 Work closely with Product Marketing, Copywriters, Web Designer and the Project Manager to ensure visual and written narratives land together and execution stays on track. Partner with Brand Designers to keep output consistent with the wider brand system.
   

  

**Creative quality bar.** 
 Push the craft and originality of product marketing output, without sacrificing speed. Know when work meets the bar, when it needs another round, and when good enough is genuinely enough to keep momentum.
   

  

**AI-enabled workflows.** 
 Use AI tools to speed up ideation, iteration and production, while keeping a sharp eye on quality and taste.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* You have a strong portfolio spanning key visuals, decks and photo/video production, and a track record of bringing product stories to life visually.
* You have experience from product design, with a deep technical understanding of and interest in how products work.
* You have strong opinions on creative direction and a network of agencies and freelance partners you can pull in when needed.
* You have a sharp eye for craft and detail, and you know the difference between good and great, even under time pressure.
* You're comfortable owning a shoot end-to-end, from creative concept to execution, working closely with the Project Manager to make it happen.
* You collaborate naturally with writers, marketers and other designers, and you're able to take a brief and elevate it.
* You use AI tools as part of your daily workflow and look for ways to work faster without cutting corners on quality.


**Experience And Background**
* Experience. 5-8+ years in brand or product design, ideally within a Tech, SaaS or high-growth environment.
* Product design background. Experience working within or closely alongside product design, with a genuine technical understanding of how products are built.
* Visual craft. Strong skills across key visual design, with an eye for layout, typography and hierarchy.
* Production experience. Hands-on experience planning and running photo or video shoots, including studio setups.
* AI-native. You use AI tools as a matter of course to speed up ideation and production.
* Collaboration. Easy to work with across Product Marketing, Copy and Design, you bring people along rather than working in isolation.
* Ownership. You take a brief and run with it, spotting what's needed without waiting to be asked.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Nordic Product Owner at Carglass
description:
We are looking for a Nordic Product Owner for our websites and digital online booking services. In this role, you will manage and prioritise the development of customer-facing digital services across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland.
   

  





 As Nordic Product Owner, you will manage the product backlog, coordinate external development partners and translate the shared Nordic roadmap into clear priorities and development work.
   

  





 The role requires a strong ability to balance business needs, customer experience and technical dependencies across multiple platforms, integrations and stakeholders. You will work closely with local business units across the Nordics, external partners and Belron® Group teams in the UK.
   

  





 You do not need to be a developer, but a good technical understanding and experience working with digital platforms and development teams is important. This will help you make informed prioritisation decisions and collaborate effectively with both developers and business stakeholders.
   

  









**About the team**




 You will be part of the Nordic Digital team within the Nordic IT organisation and report to the Nordic Digital Manager. The team includes specialists within UX, analytics, CRO/growth and development, and acts as a shared Nordic competence centre supporting local business units across the region.
   

  





 The team works closely with both IT and the local business units to ensure that digital development is technically sound, customer-focused and clearly connected to business priorities.
   

  





 Our purpose is to build and continuously improve digital services that make it easy for customers to interact with Carglass® while enabling local markets to benefit from specialist competences that would be difficult to build and maintain independently.
   

  









**Key responsibilities**



* Manage the day-to-day product priorities for websites and online booking services, supporting clear prioritisation decisions and ensuring that development work is aligned with the shared roadmap and agreed business value.
* Contribute to the shared Nordic roadmap by bringing together customer needs, business priorities, data insights and technical dependencies
* Prioritise data-driven development initiatives based on customer value, business impact, technical dependencies and available budget.
* Coordinate and manage the relationship with our external development team and development partners.
* Ensure that digital solutions are robust, scalable and aligned with both customer needs and business priorities.
* Understand and coordinate dependencies between websites, CMS platforms, online booking journeys, backend integrations and other connected systems.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements and user stories for developers and digital specialists.
* Support continuous improvement of customer journeys, conversion and customer delight.
* Drive structured follow-up, documentation and communication around priorities, progress and decisions.
* Collaborate closely with local stakeholders across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland, as well as with Belron® Group teams and specialists.
* Ensure that available development capacity is used effectively and delivers maximum value for customers, local markets and the Nordic business.







**Technology landscape**




 Our digital platforms are built using modern technologies including Next.js, Storyblok CMS, Microsoft Azure and .NET/C#. Experience from similar technology environments is an advantage, although hands-on development experience is not required.
   

  









**We believe you are**



* A structured and well-organised Product Owner, Digital Product Manager or project leader with experience from websites, online services, e-commerce or other customer-facing digital platforms.
* Someone with several years of experience working with backlog management, prioritisation and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable working in a technical environment where multiple systems, integrations and stakeholders need to connect.
* Able to understand complex structures and turn them into clear priorities, requirements and next steps.
* A strong communicator who can bridge business needs and technical development.
* Curious, pragmatic and solution-oriented.
* Experienced in agile ways of working.
* Interested in customer experience, conversion and digital optimisation.
* Ideally familiar with CMS platforms, online booking flows, APIs, integrations or basic coding.
* Fluent in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish).







**Location and travel**




 The preferred location for this role is Stockholm, although other Nordic locations may be considered for the right candidate.
   

  





 The team works in a hybrid setup, typically spending around 50% of the time in the office and 50% remotely. For Stockholm-based employees, our office is located at Gärdet.
   

  





 The role includes occasional travel within the Nordics and periodic visits to Belron® Group headquarters in the UK.
   

  









**About Belron® and Carglass®**




 Carglass® Nordics is part of Belron®, the world's leading vehicle glass repair, replacement and recalibration group, operating in more than 35 countries and serving millions of customers every year.
   

  





 Being part of Belron® gives us access to global expertise, innovation and best practices, while still allowing us to focus on the specific needs of customers and businesses across the Nordic markets.
   

  









**What we offer**



* An important role in improving digital customer journeys across four Nordic markets.
* The opportunity to work with highly skilled specialists in UX, analytics, CRO/growth and development.
* Close collaboration with Belron® experts and international teams.
* A flexible hybrid working environment.
* Local employee benefits.
* The opportunity to be part of Spirit of Belron® - a culture built on caring, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* An important role in helping create digital experiences that make life easier for customers across the Nordics.

title: Consumer Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?
   

  

 At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.
   

  

 Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
* Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
* Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
* Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
* Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
* Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
* Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


**Your profile**
 You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.
   

  

**Experience & Mindset**
* Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
* Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
* Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
* Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
* Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


**Analytical toolkit**
* Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
* Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
* Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
* Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
* AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
* Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
* Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


**What You'll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Product Owner - Vitamin Well Group
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.*
 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business. We work across e-commerce, internal tools and data, with AI integrated into how we build products, improve workflows and create better user experiences.
   

  

 Whether it is making the shopping experience on our sites genuinely personal, building agentic analytics that make data more accessible and actionable across the business, or replacing manual internal workflows with agents that just get the job done, our focus is on building solutions that solve real problems and create long-term value.
   

  

 We combine product and engineering capabilities with a pragmatic, ship-focused approach, and we set the direction for how the digital business operates going forward.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Owner** 
 to take end-to-end ownership of the digital experience across our direct-to-consumer (DTC) sites. Working alongside another Product Owner in the team, you will collaborate closely on priorities and direction while taking clear ownership of the DTC experience.
   

  

 You set the direction for what we build, why it matters, and in what order, and turn that direction into products and experiences that create measurable customer and business value.
   

  

 You lead product development hand in hand with engineering and design, moving from discovery to delivery in tight loops rather than big-bang releases. You work across both our in-house team and our external agency, keeping everyone aligned on outcomes and driving progress without compromising on quality.
   

  

 Because both the team and the platform are new, you will have real influence over what we build, how we build it and what the DTC experience looks like for years ahead.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the digital experience and product roadmap across our DTC e-commerce sites, end to end
* Run iterative, outcome-driven product development together with engineering and design
* Translate business goals and customer insights into a clear, prioritized backlog that guides delivery
* Coordinate delivery across both the in-house team and our external agency, keeping quality high and momentum steady
* Define success metrics and use data and experimentation to guide priorities and product decisions
* Use AI to improve discovery, personalization and customer experiences, identifying where it can create meaningful value across the DTC journey


 Who are you
   

  

 You are a pragmatic problem solver who enjoys building and shipping products that make an impact. You have worked in scale-ups or smaller companies where the platform was new, the team was small, and you had to figure things out as you went.
   

  

 You understand where AI creates real value and how to apply it in practical ways across products, workflows and user experiences. You are comfortable using AI tools as a natural part of how you work, think and move quickly.
   

  

 You combine strong product judgment with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move things forward independently, and you are just as comfortable in a backlog refinement with engineers as you are steering an agency or aligning stakeholders across the business.
   

  

 What you will bring
   

  

* 5+ years of experience in product ownership or product management, ideally for DTC e-commerce or digital consumer products
* A track record of leading iterative product development together with engineering and design, from discovery through to launch
* Hands-on experience working with both in-house teams and external agencies, and getting the best out of each
* Strong understanding of e-commerce and the modern web, with hands-on Shopify experience and a solid understanding of how technical and design choices shape the customer experience
* A data-informed approach, comfortable with metrics, KPIs, web analytics and experimentation (A/B testing) to drive decisions
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to turn ambiguity into a clear plan


 How to apply
   

  

*Application deadline: 16th October 2026*
 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
   

  

**Life at Vitamin Well Group**
 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
   

  

 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
   

  

 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
   

  

*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.*

title: Join our People & Culture team as an HR Business Partner
description:
*At Clas Ohlson, we are team players who genuinely care about our customers, each other, and the results of our business. We have a strong, customer centric, culture which is firmly rooted in our 100-year history, and an outspoken goal to take leadership in sustainability. If you share our ambition to achieve more, we can offer you great opportunities for professional and personal growth. We believe in you.*
**Let's grow together!**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **HR Business Partner** 
 to join our People & Culture Operations team.
   

  

 You will become part of an engaged and collaborative team with high energy, a strong team spirit and a genuine desire to make a difference. We work hard, support each other and believe that having fun along the way helps us deliver the best possible support to our managers and employees.
   

  

 You will report to the
 **People & Culture Operations Manager** 
 and be based in Stockholm.
   

  

 As an HR Business Partner, you will work close to the business, supporting, challenging and coaching managers across a broad range of people-related matters.
   

  

 You will be a trusted partner to our leaders, helping them navigate everything from day-to-day HR matters to change, leadership and organizational development. By combining your HR expertise with a strong understanding of the business, you help turn our People & Culture strategy into action.
   

  

 A key part of your role is to enable our managers to lead their teams in a way that strengthens our culture, supports our strategic direction and creates the conditions for both people and business to grow.
   

  

 You will also use HR data and insights to identify opportunities, support better decisions and help us stay
 **one step ahead** 
 .
   

  

 Your key responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with, support and coach managers in a broad range of HR-related matters.
* Ensure that our People & Culture processes, policies and guidelines are understood and applied throughout the organization.
* Support managers through change and organizational development.
* Contribute to a positive, inclusive and sustainable work environment.
* Use relevant HR data and insights to support fact-based business decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Work proactively – anticipating needs and helping managers stay one step ahead.
* Ensure compliance with relevant labour legislation and collective agreements.
* Contribute to the continuous development of our People & Culture practices and ways of working.


 Who are you?
   

  

 To succeed in this role, we believe you combine solid HR experience with strong business understanding. You enjoy working close to managers and the business and are comfortable moving between operational HR matters and more strategic discussions.
   

  

 You build trust easily and have the confidence to both
 **support and challenge** 
 when needed. You are curious, solution-oriented and motivated by turning insights into actions that create real impact.
   

  

**We Also Believe You Are**
* Relationship-oriented – you build trust and create strong partnerships with managers and other stakeholders.
* A natural coach – you guide, challenge and develop managers through constructive dialogue and advice.
* Analytical and data-driven – you use HR data and insights to identify needs and turn them into meaningful actions.
* Business-minded – you understand the needs of the business and how People & Culture can contribute to achieving our goals.
* A strong communicator – you make complex HR matters easy to understand and communicate clearly with different audiences.
* Structured and self-driven – you take ownership, prioritize effectively and move things forward.
* Proactive and solution-oriented – you look ahead, identify opportunities and act before challenges become problems.


 You have experience in HR Business Partnering or a similar broad HR role, as well as knowledge of
 **change management, organizational development, labour law and collective agreements** 
 .
   

  

 Relevant higher education within HR, behavioural science or a related field is desirable. You communicate confidently in both spoken and written English.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 The role is based in
 **Stockholm** 
 and includes some travel. With good planning, you will have flexibility to manage both the timing and frequency of your travel.
   

  

 Welcome home
   

  

 At Clas Ohlson, we offer an inclusive and encouraging workplace where everyone is expected to dare to try new things, take initiative and contribute to our development.
   

  

 Your drive, curiosity and willingness to make a difference are what help us stay
 **one step ahead** 
 .
   

  

 We believe that diversity makes us stronger and that the different backgrounds, personalities, experiences and skills of our co-workers are an important part of our success.
   

  

 In addition to the opportunity to grow together with us, we offer a market-competitive salary, pension, bonus, staff discount, health and wellness benefits, and the security of a collective agreement.
   

  

**Ready to grow with us? We look forward to hearing from you!**
*To learn more about what it's like to work with us, click on the following* 
*link* 
*and take part our employees' stories.*
**Application**
 Questions about the position are answered by recruiting manager via e-mail: anette.hansen@clasohlson.se
   

  

 Applications are processed on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 Ready to grow with us? We’d love to hear from you! Send us your application no later than September 18.
   

  

**Welcome with your application!**
 Clas Ohlson grundades 1918 som en postorderfirma i Insjön, Dalarna. Idag är vi ett detaljhandelsbolag med kunder i Sverige, Norge och Finland.
   

  

 Mycket har hänt sedan starten, men en sak har varit densamma genom alla år: att vi vill hjälpa människor att fixa sina hem med praktiska och hållbara lösningar till attraktiva priser.

title: Workforce Management Expert
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**




 As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
   

  





 You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
   

  





 You will:
   

  




* Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
* Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
* Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
* Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
* Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
* Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
* Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
* Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
* Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
* Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
* Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
* Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance



**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**




 You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
   

  





 We are looking for people with:
   

  




* Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
* Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
* Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
* Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
* Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
* Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
* Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
* Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken



**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





 An example of our benefits:
   

  




* 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
* H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.



**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





 This is a
 **permanent position** 
 based in
 **Stockholm** 
 , please send your
 **CV in English** 
 as soon as possible.
   

  

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: SE-Technical Specialist
description:
**Summary**
 Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. At Apple, we believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.
   

  

 As a Technical Specialist, you offer technical support and skilled troubleshooting for all customers while also generating excitement for Apple’s products and services. You deliver exceptional service and empower customers to get the most out of their Apple products.
   

  

 A Technical Specialist also makes sure customers are educated about repair options and Apple products and services.
   

  

**Description**
 Develop knowledge and stay up to date on Apple products, services, and Genius Bar repair processes to support efficient and high-quality repairs.
   

  

 Support customers having Apple product or software issues with care and empathy, using all tools and resources provided by Apple.
   

  

 Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve service concerns for select Apple hardware and software.
   

  

 Work with team leaders to identify recurring repair problems and other service concerns, and make sure that feedback is provided to Apple.
   

  

 Provide excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting product and service recommendations, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy.
   

  

 Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to supporting customer-facing activities on or off the sales floor.
   

  

 Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.
   

  

 Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
* You should also be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* You can:
* Demonstrate technical expertise of Apple products and services.
* Follow troubleshooting steps to identify the root cause of a technical issue in a customer service environment.
* Navigate customer service issues with care and strong interpersonal skills.
* Consistently learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services and third party products to enhance the customer experience.
* Work in a fast-paced environment and balance multiple tasks at the same time.
* Work well in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
* Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apple’s core values.
* Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.


 At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.
   

  

 At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
   

  

 Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: Digital Partner Activation Manager – 12-month Consultant Assignment
description:
**About Soundtrack**
 Soundtrack is a B2B scale-up company providing music streaming services for businesses. We serve small customers like the café around the corner, and much bigger brands like Joe & the Juice, Toni & Guy and TAG Heuer. On the inside, we're a bunch of talented, motivated and humble designers, engineers and music experts. We believe in product-led growth, where the product is the primary driver of customer acquisition, conversion and expansion
   

  

**The Assignment**
 We are now looking for a Digital Partner Activation Manager for an 80–100% consultant assignment of approximately 12 months, covering parental leave. The preferred start is in October 2026.
   

  

 You will step into an existing role within our Partnerships team and take ownership of CRM-driven initiatives related to partner segmentation, activation and engagement, primarily using HubSpot.
   

  

 The focus of the assignment is to help us scale how we activate and support our partner base through data, CRM, automation and digital communication. You will work hands-on with partner data and digital processes, while collaborating closely with the Partnerships team and other stakeholders across Soundtrack.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can quickly get up to speed, work independently and drive the area forward throughout the assignment.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Map, analyze and optimize the partner funnel using CRM and other data sources
* Build and improve scalable processes and automations for partner activation and growth
* Segment partners and develop targeted activation strategies
* Create digital campaigns, communication flows and content to drive adoption and engagement
* Build dashboards and reports to track partner performance
* Identify opportunities to improve partner activation through digital tools, automation and AI

**About you**
 You are analytical, structured and proactive, with a strong interest in digital processes, automation and scalable ways of working.
   

  

 You are comfortable working independently, taking initiative and driving projects forward, while also collaborating closely with different stakeholders.
   

  

**You Likely Have**
* 2+ years of experience working with CRM, data analysis, digital activation or similar areas
* Hands-on experience working in CRM systems – HubSpot is highly beneficial
* Experience building automated workflows, segmentation or digital communication flows
* Experience from a B2B environment, preferably within SaaS, tech or a partner-driven business
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into actionable initiatives
* Strong communication skills in English
* Experience independently driving projects from start to finish


**It is a plus if you have:**

**Practical details**
* Scope: 80-100% of full-time

title: Customer Success Coordinator
description:
**Om företaget** 




 Gardeco är ett svenskt företag som i över 35 år har specialiserat sig på att erbjuda förstklassiga affärs- och kassasystem anpassade för modebranschen. Med en helintegrerad administrativ programvara för orderhantering, lager, fakturering och redovisning, samt ett branschanpassat butikssystem, förenklar Gardeco affärsprocesserna för modeföretag och stärker relationen mellan företag och kund.
 



  





 Företaget har etablerat långvariga samarbeten med välkända varumärken och är omtalade för sitt orubbliga engagemang för kundvård och service. Och framgångarna bara fortsätter! Tillväxten är stark och nya kunder fortsätter att komma in i Gardeco-familjen. Efter en expansiv fas senaste året med installation och onboarding av NK-varuhusen i Stockholm och Göteborg förbereder Gardeco sig för nästa steg. Framtiden ser riktigt spännande ut!
 



  





 Nu ska Gardeco stärka upp teamet i och med sin tillväxt- och framgångsresa! Därför söker vi nu en Customer Success Coordinator till deras huvudkontor i Hammarby sjöstad, Stockholm. Här blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat gäng på nio medarbetare som blivit kända för sin Customer success-funktion av yppersta klass där kundnöjdhet och kundrelation står i första rummet. Du kommer få äran att ansvara för onboardingen och löpande rådgivning och support för flera av bolagets nya kunder. Välkommen in med din ansökan!
 



  





 Du erbjuds:
 


* En kundnära nyckelroll i ett stabilt och växande bolag
* En gedigen och genomarbetad introduktionsplan när du är ny i din roll
* En närvarande chef och en prestigelös och familjär företagskultur
* Fast lön och goda förmåner



  





  





  





**Om rollen** 




 I rollen som Customer Success Coordinator tar du dig an ett brett ansvar för Gardecos löpande kundupplevelse och rådgivning/support i allmänhet samt för onboardingen av bolagets nya kunder. Du kommer i den här rollen bli projektansvarig för att de nya kunderna får en smidig introduktion i Gardecos affärs- och kassasystem och vara deras långsiktiga partner. På så vis är du en nyckelspelare i att systemet uppfyller de önskemål som kunden har. Du arbetar nära tre ytterligare medarbetare i supportfunktion och har löpande kontakt även med IT, ekonomifunktion och såklart: kunderna. Arbetet utförs delvis på plats på kontoret (via teams och mail), men delvis också på plats ute hos kund.
 



  





***Du kommer bland annat att:***



* Onboarda nya kunder i affärs- och kassasystemet
* Projektleda arbetet med att onboarda kunder till NKs e-handel, NK.se. Här använder man sig av Gardecos ”Product Information Management”-system (PIM) och samarbetar med kundens PIM-avdelning och NKs PIM-avdelning
* I löpande dialog med kund se till att systemet utvecklas så att kundens önskemål tillgodoses på bästa sätt
* Hantera kundärenden kopplat den dagliga driften där det kan handla om kassan med tillhörande betalningar, lager, orderhantering, fakturering, utveckling av rapporter
* Ansvara för löpande och förvaltande support gentemot kunderna och ge dem service i världsklass



  





  





  





**Kvalifikationer** 



* Högskoleexamen i ekonomi eller motsvarande
* Minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet från butik
* God system- och datavana
* Obehindrad svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift



  





  





**Personliga egenskaper** 




 Vi ser gärna att du är kommunikativ, noggrann, service-minded och besitter det man på Gardeco benämner fulfillment, vilket innebär: kraft och vilja att genomföra och slutföra din uppgift! Dessutom värdesätter vi att du är eftertänksam, ödmjuk och prestigelös.
 



  





  





  





**Övrig information** 




 Anställningsform: Fast med provanställning
 



 Start: Enligt överenskommelse med hänsyn till uppsägningstid
