title: Account Technology Strategist
description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft’s Enterprise Account Team focuses on empowering customers on their AI Transformation journey. This team is responsible for envisioning new possibilities for our customers, delivering solutions that result in targeted business outcomes and driving revenue growth for Microsoft.


As an Enterprise Account Technology Strategist, you will take the lead in translating the customer’s business priorities into a viable technology strategy and roadmap encompassing Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions.


In collaboration with an Enterprise Account Executive, you will orchestrate the Microsoft and partner team to develop technology leadership and excellence to your customers. You will bring industry-relevant solutions to help the customers to securely adopt and embrace AI technologies. With a proven history of innovating technical solutions to achieve customers’ business objectives and achieving account growth targets, this role will give you the opportunity to combine your technology and industry knowledge to deliver on secure AI solutions to accelerate your customers’ AI vision and to ultimately become their trusted technology advisor


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities*** Customer AI and Security Strategy Leadership - Document and articulate the customer’s business objectives, technology landscape and AI and Security strategy to lead and drive security and AI conversations.
* Customer Technology Leadership - Develop and nurture trusted relationships with C-level technology executives across the business.
* Drive Operational and Commercial Excellence- Lead technical decision maker conversations and governance with the customer and the v team to ensure the customer is using and getting value from Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions.
* Engage deeply with the customers using consultative selling skills and challenge customers’ assumptions with constructive dialogue about their business and technology.
* Industry Knowledge Articulate and understand specific industry-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry.
 **Qualifications*** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience
* OR equivalent experience
* Proven experience in relevant customer industry
* Proven experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes
  

  

  

Account Technology IC5 - The typical base pay range for this role across Sweden is kr 750,000.00 - kr 1,421,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.


Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/sweden-corporate-pay.html

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Be a part of the next big thing**
 Do you thrive on tackling complex challenges? Are you passionate about creating impactful solutions that drive commerce forward? Are you someone who believes in encouraging and elevating those around you?
   

  

**About Us**
 Kustom, formerly known as Klarna Checkout (KCO), is the Nordic market leader in digital checkout solutions. Today, we support over 24,000 merchants across more than 170 countries, providing a streamlined checkout experience. We offer localized solutions in 18 markets, tailored to specific languages, currencies, and payment methods. No matter where your business operates, we deliver a checkout experience that meets the needs of both merchants and shoppers - driving growth globally. 🌍
   

  

**The role**
 We are looking to hire a Backend Engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing robust server-side solutions using modern technologies and frameworks. You will work closely with product managers and fellow engineers to deliver high-performance, scalable applications that power our core business infrastructure.
   

  

 As an integral part of our development team, you'll play a crucial role in developing and maintaining our essential backend infrastructure. We need a detailed oriented person who can design and implement efficient, future-proof solutions for complex business problems. Your knowledge and vision will be instrumental in building a solid technical foundation that ensures our product remains reliable and performant as we grow.
   

  

 Here at Kustom, you'll get to drive innovation, and leave your mark on our technical architecture. As part of our cross-functional Agile team, you'll collaborate with talented peers to create digital products that revolutionize how merchants worldwide conduct their business.
   

  

 Our engineering teams are based in Stockholm, where we prioritize in-person collaboration at our office to foster strong team dynamics.
   

  

**Things you'll be doing**
* Implement scalable, high-performance backend services that power our global payment infrastructure
* Lead technical discussions and mentor junior team members while contributing to architectural decisions
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, best practices, and technical documentation
* Work closely with Product and Design to implement robust technical solutions
* Contribute to our technical roadmap and help shape the future of our platform


**Skills And Experience You'll Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of professional experience in Backend development, with deep expertise in Java
* Strong track record of designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems
* Advanced knowledge of Spring Framework and Spring Boot
* Extensive experience with AWS cloud services and microservices architecture
* Expert-level understanding of database design, optimization, and various storage solutions
* Proven experience with Git and Github for version control and team collaboration
* Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, API security, and performance optimization


**We believe you'll thrive in this role if you have**
* Strong technical leadership skills with a track record of mentoring junior engineers
* Passion for solving complex engineering challenges and driving technical innovation
* Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems is a plus
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly
* Track record of driving technical initiatives and improving system architecture
* Strong commitment to code quality, testing, and technical documentation
* Ability to balance technical excellence with practical business needs


**Benefits**
* Secure your future with a competitive pension package, including both national and occupational pension contributions.
* Comprehensive health coverage with extensive health insurance, long-term illness protection, and flexible salary exchange options.
* Invest in your wellbeing with an annual wellness allowance of 3,000 SEK to spend on the activities that keep you healthy and energized.
* More time to enjoy life with an extra day off when major holidays, such as Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, fall on a weekend.


**A place to grow**
 At Kustom, you’re not going to be just another face in the crowd. This is a place where we elevate each other and celebrate success as a team. We believe in our ability to create excellence — and have fun doing it!
   

  

 And we know we set high expectations, but we also know that the road to success isn’t a straight line. We support and encourage each other to try, to fail, to try again. Because that’s how we grow, individually and together.
   

  

 Does this sound like the place for you?
   

  

**About Your Application**

title: Senior Cloud Architect
description:
**Is there a way to shape the future of cloud technology while accelerating the energy transition?**
 As a
 **Cloud Architect** 
 , you will play a key role in designing the digital foundations that help power a more sustainable energy system. At
 **Vattenfall** 
 , we believe
 *there is a way* 
 to create a future where technology, innovation and sustainability go hand in hand. By driving cloud transformation across our international business, you will help enable scalable, secure and future-ready solutions that support our long-term ambition of building a cleaner energy future.
   

  

**Your role**
 As
 **Cloud Architect** 
 at Vattenfall, you will guide the design and evolution of cloud and infrastructure solutions, with a strong focus on
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 . You will help shape enterprise-wide cloud standards, governance frameworks and architecture principles while supporting both
 **cloud-native development** 
 and the
 **migration of existing applications** 
 .
   

  

 This is an opportunity to influence
 **cloud adoption** 
 at scale, work with modern enterprise technologies and contribute directly to Vattenfall's digital transformation journey.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities:****
* Designing, developing and governing enterprise-grade cloud platforms and infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure
* Defining architecture standards, reference architectures and best practices for cloud adoption
* Supporting the migration of business-critical applications to Azure using modern architectural principles
* Designing and implementing Azure Landing Zones, management group structures and policy-based governance
* Collaborating with application teams, security specialists and external partners to ensure scalable and secure solutions
* Driving cloud security initiatives based on Zero Trust principles and Microsoft security frameworks
* Contributing to hybrid platform architectures integrating Azure, SAP ERP, Kafka and other business-critical technologies
* Advising stakeholders on cloud strategy, technology choices and long-term architectural roadmaps
* Promoting operational excellence, automation and continuous improvement across the cloud landscape


**Location**
 Stockholm, Amsterdam, Berlin and Katowice
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Who are you?**
 You are an experienced
 **cloud professional** 
 who enjoys collaborating across teams and transforming complex technical challenges into practical and sustainable solutions. You combine
 **deep technical expertise** 
 with strong
 **communication skills** 
 and can explain cloud concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
   

  

****Next To This We Believe You Bring:****
* At least 7 years of experience designing and implementing cloud infrastructure solutions
* Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure
* A curious mindset and enthusiasm for exploring new technologies and innovative solutions
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups


**Cloud Security Expertise**
* Strong understanding of Azure networking, identity management and cloud security
* Experience guiding enterprise-scale application migrations to Azure
* Experience implementing Azure Security Baselines and secure-by-design architectures
* Experience applying Zero Trust Architecture principles
* Practical knowledge of Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Conditional Access
* Understanding of cloud compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001/27002, GDPR and the EU AI Act


**Frameworks & Standards**
* Experience working with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
* Solid knowledge of Azure governance, management groups, policies and landing zones
* Knowledge of Azure Well-Architected Framework (WAF), especially Security and Operational Excellence
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (MCSB) and Microsoft Defender for Cloud


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our offer**
 A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!
   

  

 At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.
   

  

**More Information**
 This position is primarily intended for internal candidates within Vattenfall. In case of equal qualifications, preference will be given to colleagues from
 **Business Unit IT (YI)** 
 . We value internal growth and encourage you to apply.”
   

  

**We welcome your application in English, no later than,** 
**15th of September 2026** 
 . We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.
   

  

 For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our
 **Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de)** 
 .
   

  

**Trade union representatives in Sweden (IT)** 
 are Sofi Wadström (Akademikerna), Patricia Ek (Unionen), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.

Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.
   

  

 The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.

title: Fullstackutvecklare till Nordea Liv & Pension Sverige
description:
**Job ID: 3685**
 Nordea Liv & Pension Sverige är ett dotterbolag till Nordea Bank och har en egen IT-organisation. Vi ansvarar för att utveckla moderna, stabila och kundnära tjänster och plattformar för både rådgivare och kunder.
   

  

 Vi söker nu en fullstackutvecklare till teamen bakom Nordeas digitala rådgivnings- och pensionstjänster. Här får du arbeta end-to-end med moderna gränssnitt, API:er och backendlogik, kombinera tekniskt djup med verksamhetsnära utveckling och vara med och forma affärskritiska lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för våra kunder, rådgivare och för verksamheten.
   

  

**Om teamet**
 Du kommer att arbeta i ett Stockholmsbaserat team med nära samarbete med produktägare, kravställare och verksamhetsrepresentanter. Tillsammans vidareutvecklar ni rådgivningsverktyg, försäkringshanteringssystem, användarflöden och ett stort antal integrationsapplikationer. Vår kultur är samarbetsinriktad och pragmatisk, med stort utrymme för tekniskt ägarskap och professionell utveckling. Vi tror att de bästa lösningarna skapas genom tydlig kommunikation, gemensamt ansvar, teknisk kvalitet och starkt kundfokus.
   

  

 Kontoret ligger i centrala Stockholm och vi arbetar enligt Nordeas hybridmodell för kontorsnärvaro.
   

  

**Vad du kommer att göra:**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla moderna frontendlösningar, backendtjänster och API:er för våra rådgivar- och kundtjänster.
* Arbeta nära verksamheten, produktägare och andra utvecklare för att omsätta behov och idéer till robusta, användbara lösningar.
* Ta tekniskt ägarskap över hela kedjan från användargränssnitt och API:er till integrationer och produktionssättning.


 Vi arbetar främst med modern Java, Spring Boot, API:er, distribuerade system och frontendramverk som React och Angular. Du får möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, skapa tydliga och användarvänliga gränssnitt, förbättra arbetssätt och bidra med lösningar som håller hög kvalitet i både användarupplevelse och bakomliggande arkitektur.
   

  

**Vem du är**
**Detta är rätt roll för dig om du:**
* Gillar att bygga produkter som löser faktiska kund- och affärsutmaningar.
* Är nyfiken, samarbetsinriktad och bekväm med att arbeta direkt med verksamhetsrepresentanter.
* Trivs i en miljö där utvecklare har inflytande, ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt.
* Balanserar hög teknisk kvalitet med förståelse för verksamhetens behov och regulatoriska krav.


**Din erfarenhet och bakgrund**
* Flera års erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling, med backendkompetens och ett tydligt intresse för frontend.
* Gedigen kunskap om modern Java, Spring Boot och utveckling av robusta backendtjänster.
* Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla API:er, distribuerade system och moderna frontendlösningar med fokus på användbarhet och kvalitet.
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


**Det är meriterande om du även:**
* Har erfarenhet från bank-, finans-, försäkrings- eller pensionsbranschen.
* Har arbetat med molnbaserade plattformar och containerbaserade miljöer.


**Vad vi erbjuder**
**Människor** 
 kommer hit när de vill komma någonstans. För somliga är det att ta sin karriär till nästa nivå. För andra är det att bryta ny mark inom sitt kompetensområde – med andra ord, du tar dig alltid framåt hos oss.
   

  

**Vår kultur** 
 främjar resultat och tillväxt, och vi erbjuder olika möjligheter att utvecklas och lära av duktiga kollegor med olika bakgrund i en levande arbetsmiljö.
   

  

**Hybridmodell** 
 – vi tror på värdet av att föra människor samman och samtidigt omfamnar vi friheten med flexibilitet.
   

  

**Mångfald och inkludering** 
 är naturliga delar i vårt dagliga arbete. Vi vet att en inkluderande arbetsplats är hållbar. Vi tror verkligen på att våra olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter, egenskaper och personlighetsdrag gör oss starkare tillsammans. Varje dag strävar vi efter att hitta nya sätt att förbättra mångfald och inkludering inom vår gemenskap. Ett exempel på det är att vi har skrivit under European Diversity Charters i de länder där vi är verksamma för att visa vårt engagemang och engagera oss med andra för att fortsätta lära och bli bättre.
   

  

 Om detta låter som du, välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  

**Nästa steg**
 Om du vill växa som fullstackutvecklare, kombinera modern backendutveckling med tydliga och användarvänliga gränssnitt och bidra till framtidens digitala rådgivnings- och pensionstjänster vill vi gärna höra från dig. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt men senast 13/09/2026. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta Head of Development JAVA, Hans F Nilsson via mail hans.f.nilsson@nordea.se.
   

  

 Vi utvärderar ansökningar löpande och tekniska uppgifter kan ingå i ansökningsprocessen. Referenstagning kommer att genomföras.
   

  

 För facklig information, kontakta Finansförbundet på finansforbundet@nordea.se eller SACO på saconordea@nordea.com.

title: IT Business and System Analyst
description:
**About Justera Group**
 Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for an experienced D365 BI Domain Lead to support BI and reporting across the D365 transformation programme.
   

  

 The assignment will own the BI demand perspective across Sales, Service, Order to Delivery, and Finance & Procurement, establishing the structure and way of working needed to move from business needs to a clear, prioritized, and solution-oriented BI backlog.
   

  

 You will act as the main BI and reporting contact for the D365 work streams, working closely with business stakeholders, stream leads, architecture, and IT. A key part of the assignment is to proactively identify and structure BI needs, particularly in areas where BI maturity is still developing, and help stakeholders determine the most appropriate solution direction.
   

  

 The role covers traditional reporting, self-service BI, and conversational analytics within the D365 landscape. The focus is on demand intake, requirements shaping, prioritization, initial solution direction, and backlog ownership rather than detailed technical design or hands-on implementation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own the BI demand perspective across the D365 work streams covering Sales, Service, Order to Delivery, and Finance & Procurement.
* Establish a consistent way of working for identifying, understanding, shaping, and prioritizing BI and reporting needs.
* Act as the main BI contact for D365 stream leads and relevant business stakeholders.
* Facilitate structured discussions and workshops to identify current, emerging, and overlooked BI/reporting needs.
* Translate business needs into clear and structured BI requirements suitable for assessment and prioritization.
* Own and maintain the consolidated D365 BI backlog, including priorities and initial solution direction.
* Assess and recommend where and how BI needs should be addressed across D365, Microsoft analytics, or other relevant Scania solutions.
* Collaborate with Domain Leads, Product Owners, architects, and central IT experts to validate solution directions and dependencies.
* Challenge assumptions constructively and guide stakeholders toward appropriate BI and reporting solutions.
* Prepare prioritized requirements for handover to detailed design and implementation.
* Establish the structure, documentation, and ways of working required for transition to the permanent Domain Lead organization.


**Requirements:**
* M.Sc. or equivalent relevant academic background.
* Strong experience in Business Intelligence, reporting, and analytics.
* Broad understanding of different BI, reporting, and analytics approaches and use cases.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, preferably within a major transformation or implementation programme.
* Good understanding of the Microsoft data and analytics ecosystem, including Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* Good understanding of enterprise IT and solution landscapes.
* Ability to understand and credibly navigate technical alternatives without being a hands-on developer.
* Ability to translate business needs into structured BI requirements and practical solution recommendations.


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: System Architect Getinge Solna
description:
**With a passion for life**
 Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
   

  

 Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
   

  

**About This Opportunity**
 Are you eager to make a real-world impact through technology? At Getinge, we invite you to evolve your career as a System Architect, where your knowledge, creativity and drive can help shape the future of healthcare. You will play a key role in harmonizing our digital product offerings with leading interoperability standards, and in designing features and products that directly contribute to saving lives worldwide.
   

  

 In this role, your primary responsibility will be to shape the architecture behind our digital products — recommending solution designs, leading risk analysis within cyber security and safety, and helping drive innovation in medical device interoperability and AI. Working in a team together with other bright minds to develop our future within digitalization.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Collaborate with product management, compliance, sales and other internal or external stakeholders to conduct pre-studies and prototyping regarding new technologies, features and products.
* Recommend solution designs and strategic architectural decisions.
* Handle risk analysis within cyber security and safety, with support from specialized teams.
* Provide technical guidance to development teams on implementing and utilizing interoperability standards.
* Help drive innovation, primarily within medical device interoperability and AI technologies.


 This position is based in Solna, with some occasional travel. Remote work is possible 1–2 days a week.
   

  

**You will bring**
 To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.
   

  

* Engineering degree in computer science, electro, Mechatronics or medical technology, or a related field.
* Minimum three years of experience in a systems architecture, systems engineering, or similar role.
* Experience with requirements and risk management, including functional safety.
* Experience leading investigations into new technologies, features, or products.
* Familiarity with relevant interoperability standards such as HL7 v2, FHIR, and SDC.
* Ability to develop software for demonstration or prototyping purposes, for example in Python or Java.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences, and fluency in Swedish and English.


**Experience in the following areas will be considered a merit:**
* Extensive knowledge of the medical technology domain, from a regulatory, technical and/or user perspective.
* Extensive experience in software development and/or involvement in open-source or collaborative software projects, specifically with embedded systems and Linux.
* Experience with wider technical events, e.g. innovation challenges, hackathons or larger-scale interoperability testing events.


 In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. We believe you are structured, analytical and collaborative, with strong communication skills and the ability to engage confidently with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

 We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest in system architecture, interoperability standards, and AI technologies within medical technology.
   

  

 At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities. We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers.
   

  

 We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.
   

  

**Why join Getinge**
 Getinge offers a job in a safe and informal work environment, where we appreciate close team collaboration. We keep an open dialogue between leaders and employees, as well as between teams. We are focused on developing people, and together we will create a plan for learning and competence development when you start your career with us.
   

  

 We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.
   

  

**Application**
 Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-25
   

  

 We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Hiring Manager Fredrik Ågren at Fredrik.agren@getinge.com or Talent Manager Emma Paulsson at emma.paulsson@getinge.com
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.
   

  

**About Us**
 With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Head of Data, Analytics and AI
description:
**Looking for a workplace for the future?**
 At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future. Are you looking for a workplace where you can make a difference in what matters most – relationships between people? Then you are welcome to Telenor.
   

  

**How You'll Make a Difference With Us**
 Telenor Sweden is on an exciting journey rebuilding a fragmented data landscape into a cloud-native foundation and moving from AI experimentation to adoption across the company.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead our Analytics, Data Management, Automation & AI organisation, consisting of approximately 50 employees and consultants across data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, data platforms, architecture, marketing technology, AI and automation. You will have three leaders reporting to you, own a budget of approximately 90 MSEK, report to the CIO and be part of the IT Management Team.
   

  

 The department has been on a transformation journey for several years. The next step is about turning investments in data, AI and automation into measurable business value. You will play a key role in connecting technology, people and business outcomes while building the capabilities needed for the future.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Rather than list everything you will be responsible for, here is what we want to be true 18 months in:
   

  

* AI and automation solutions are running in production with clear ownership, monitoring and lifecycle management
* Investments in data and AI are followed up based on adoption and business outcomes, with AI, analytics and automation delivering measurable commercial value.
* Data and AI capabilities are broadly adopted across the organisation, supported by strong data governance, responsible AI practices, self-service analytics and increased AI literacy.
* Legacy platforms have been decommissioned and core data assets migrated to our GCP-based data foundation.
* You have continued to develop an engaged, high-performing organisation with the competence and capabilities needed for the future.


**Are you the one we're looking for?**
 We are looking for a strategic and business-oriented technology leader who combines strong leadership with deep knowledge of data, analytics and AI.
   

  

 To be clear, this is a leadership role in a technical domain, not a technical role with people attached. You need enough depth to make sound calls on architecture, investment and risk, but leading people, driving change and connecting technology to business outcomes matters just as much.
   

  

**Five things. If you bring these, we would like to talk to you.**
* You have led a data, analytics or AI organisation and defined enterprise-wide direction, turning strategy into roadmaps, priorities and trade-offs that people can act on, including influencing senior leaders on investments and priorities.
* You have taken data or AI initiatives from proof of concept through to production, adoption and measurable value at scale, including leading the change work required across multiple business functions, leveraging strong business acumen to align technology investments with strategic priorities and serving as a trusted advisor to leaders on data, AI and transformation opportunities.
* You have modernised a complex data landscape, moving from legacy platforms to scalable cloud architecture.
* You know modern cloud data architecture, AI and Generative AI, particularly cloud data and AI environments such as GCP, BigQuery and Vertex AI, well enough to make good calls. You also know what responsible AI requires in practice: governance, transparency, privacy, data quality, model risk management and regulatory compliance.
* You have owned budgets and investment portfolios, including CAPEX and OPEX planning, forecasting, prioritisation and financial follow-up, and led vendor and partner ecosystems, including build, buy or partner decisions and strategic technology partnerships.


 If you recognise yourself in most of this, but not all of it, apply anyway and tell us how you would close the gap.
   

  

 Experience from telecommunications or another data-intensive and regulated industry is an advantage, as is exposure to MLOps, intelligent automation or enterprise-wide AI governance. We also see experience from Nordic or international organisations as valuable. Swedish is not required, as our working language is English, although Swedish language skills would be beneficial for effective stakeholder management and communication across the organisation.
   

  

 Most importantly, you bring a strong business mindset and understand how data, analytics and AI create value. Whether gained through hands-on work with analytics, commercial initiatives or business transformation, you know how to translate customer and business needs into insights, decisions and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**How You Lead**
 You make complexity manageable. You set a clear direction so people know what matters most and why — and you build strong leaders around you who can act on it without waiting for permission.
   

  

 You are as comfortable in a technical discussion as in a business one, and you move easily between them. Complex topics become choices people understand and want to be part of. You question how things are done when it's needed, but you bring people with you rather than leaving them behind.
   

  

 And when priorities compete and everything depends on everything else, you're the one who creates focus. You make the trade-offs, explain the thinking behind them, and keep the organisation moving.
   

  

**Our promise to you**
*We are better together.*
 Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.
   

  

*We support relationships and societies.*
 Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

*We make room for life.*
 Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. Leadership based on trust and flexible working hours helps you balance work and life. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.
   

  

*We invite you to a career in motion.*
 Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.

title: Testare till enheten för it-utveckling
description:
Vill du utvecklas som testare och samtidigt delta i ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag?
   

  

 Som central aktör inom den brottsbekämpande verksamheten befinner sig Åklagarmyndigheten mitt i rättskedjan. Med den allt snabbare digitalisering inom rättsväsendet och med en lagstiftningsprocess i ständig rörelse står myndigheten inför många spännande utmaningar de kommande åren vilket också påverkar, och ökar, kraven på vår it-utvecklingsförmåga. Till enheten för it-utveckling på Åklagarmyndighetens huvudkontor söker vi nu därför en testare med bred kompetens både för test av våra egenutvecklade verksamhetsstöd och av anpassade standardsystem.
   

  

 Du kommer framför allt utföra tester i Cåbra som är myndighetens primära verksamhetssystem dygnet runt, årets alla dagar. Cåbra kommunicerar med ett flertal andra myndigheters verksamhetssystem och det är således inte bara våra egna användare som är beroende av Cåbras funktionalitet utan indirekt även användare på andra myndigheter såsom exempelvis Polismyndigheten och Domstolsverket.
   

  

 Vi har en agil organisation och du kommer tillhöra ett av våra agila team tillsammans med åklagare, utvecklare, kravanalytiker och testare för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för våra användare och andra som berörs av våra it-system.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
 Arbetsuppgifterna består av
   

  

* skriva testfall och utföra manuella tester
* utföra bilaterala tester tillsammans med testare hos andra myndigheter
* sammanställa testresultat, rapportera avvikelser och återrapportera till berörda
* samarbeta med kravanalytiker för att ta fram testbara krav
* tillsammans med övriga testare bidra till förbättringar av nuvarande testprocesser för ett agilt arbetssätt.


**Dina kvaliteter och kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom systemvetenskap eller annan it-inriktning. Alternativt yrkesutbildning inom test eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet som Åklagarmyndigheten finner likvärdig.
* god erfarenhet av att utföra tester i alla delar av testcykeln; enhetstest, integrationstest, systemtest och acceptanstest
* god erfarenhet av att skriva och underhålla manuella testfall samt att planera och utföra manuella tester på egen hand
* erfarenhet av tester med agil metodik
* god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, både i tal och skrift.


 Som person vill vi att du
   

  

* är engagerad, självgående och driven i ditt arbete
* har lätt för att samarbeta, förmåga att skapa goda arbetsrelationer och har ett öppet förhållningssätt gentemot din omgivning
* har lätt att ställa om mellan uppgifter i en föränderlig vardag
* har god förmåga att överblicka och prioritera dina arbetsuppgifter.


 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  

* ISTQB certifiering eller motsvarande
* erfarenhet av SQL och relationsdatabaser
* erfarenhet av Jira och Zephyr som stöd i ditt arbete
* erfarenhet av testautomatisering
* erfarenhet från arbete inom offentlig verksamhet.


 Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning i 6 månader.
   

  

 Inför erbjudande om anställning kan det bli aktuellt för Åklagarmyndigheten att genomföra registerkontroll i misstankeregistret och belastningsregistret. Registerkontrollen genomförs på slutkandidaten.
   

  

 Tester förekommer i rekryteringsprocessen. Vi ser gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan på svenska.
   

  

 Åklagarmyndigheten är en modern arbetsplats som möjliggör distansarbete i hög omfattning, vilket gör att många medarbetare på it-avdelningen till stor del arbetar och träffas virtuellt. Vi ses på kontoret minst en gång i veckan och då i våra fina lokaler centralt vid Karlaplan i Stockholm. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på it-avdelningen här.
   

  

 Åklagarmyndigheten är en beredskapsmyndighet. Vid en anställning kan du komma att krigsplaceras på Åklagarmyndigheten. Läs mer under Jobba hos oss.
   

  

 På grund av arkivbestämmelser sparar vi ansökningar i två år. När du ansöker kommer dina personuppgifter att behandlas enligt offentlighetsprincipen samt dataskyddsförordningen. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss, samtycker du till detta.

title: Sjöviksskolan söker en IT-pedagog
description:
Välkommen till oss
   

  

 Stockholm - vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss - för stockholmarna.
   

  

 Centralt beläget vid Årstabergs station ligger Sjöviksskolan som är en modern F-9-skola. Skolans lokaler stod färdiga år 2020 och är utformad med särskild fokus på att skapa kreativa lärmiljöer med en hög trygghetskänsla. Detta visar sig genom avsaknad av korridorer, att de äldre och yngre eleverna vistats i olika lokaler samt att konsten har en framträdande roll i lokalerna.
   

  

 Sjöviksskolans vision är att vi ska skapa möjligheter för framtiden. Detta gör vi genom att arbeta med våra värdegrundsord - stolta, modiga och tillsammans. Alla elever på Sjöviksskolan ska känna stolthet över den de är. De ska känna sig stolta över sin resa genom skolan, de kunskaper och förmågor som de utvecklar samt den gemenskap som vi tillsammans skapar. Under sin studietid hos oss ska eleverna utveckla mod, mod att vara sig själva, våga prova nya saker och mod att uppfylla sina drömmar. Allt detta gör vi tillsammans. Ingen ska vara ensam på Sjöviksskolan utan alla ska finna gemenskap, i de mindre sammanhangen med dem vi är närmast, i de större sammanhangen, med de vi träffar varje dag och i den stora helheten, alla vi på Sjövik!
   

  

 Vi erbjuder
   

  

* En utvecklande och viktig roll i en framåtblickande skola
* Engagerade kollegor och en positiv arbetsmiljö
* Möjlighet att påverka och forma skolans digitala arbete
* En semestertjänst på heltid med tillsvidareanställning


 Din roll
   

  

 Som IT-pedagog hos oss har du en central roll i skolans digitala utvecklingsarbete. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande, omväxlande och ibland utmanande. Du stöttar pedagoger i att integrera digitala verktyg i undervisningen och bidrar till att höja elevernas digitala kompetens. Du ansvarar också för den lokala IT-supporten och administrationen av såväl hårdvara som tjänster. Som en del av Sjöviksskolans kansli är du en viktig del i vårt gemensamma uppdrag att ge service till den pedagogiska verksamheten i skolan. Kansliet består av sju personer i olika professioner. Vi är en ambitiös grupp med höga förväntningar på varandra.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Handleda och utbilda personal i pedagogisk användning av digitala verktyg
* Delta i det pedagogiska utvecklingsarbetet
* Driva skolans arbete med digitalisering och strategiska IT-frågor
* Samverka med skolans kansli i gemensamma administrativa frågor
* Ansvara för skolans park av digitala enheter, hantering och support av dessa
* Ge support till medarbetare och elever i IT-frågor


 Din kompetens och erfarenhet
   

  

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

* Har en pedagogisk universitetsutbildning eller motsvarande relevant utbildning
* Har erfarenhet av undervisning och pedagogiskt ledarskap
* Har goda kunskaper inom IT och digitala lärverktyg
* Är kommunikativ, strukturerad och har god samarbetsförmåga
* Är lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med kollegor och elever
* Har en god förmåga att uttrycka dig i och göra dig förstådd på svenska i tal och skrift
* Har ett intresse för skolutveckling och digitalisering


 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  

* Erfarenhet av Stockholm stads digitala plattformar och arbetssätt.
* Tidigare har arbetat i rollen som IT-pedagog eller IT-samordnare.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med schemaläggning.

title: IT-Konsult med affärsfokus
description:
***Vill du arbeta i en roll där du kombinerar teknik, verksamhetsförståelse och kunddialog?***




*Vi söker nu en IT-konsult, internt kallad vCIO (Virtual Chief Information Officer), som vill arbeta med att utveckla och strukturera våra kunders IT-miljöer.* 




  





**Om rollen** 




 Som vCIO hos Sharp arbetar du i skärningspunkten mellan teknik, affär och kunddialog. Din uppgift är att hjälpa kunder att fatta rätt beslut kring sin IT – både här och nu och på längre sikt.
 



  





 Du är en rådgivare som förstår kundens verksamhet och kan omsätta behov till konkreta IT‑lösningar. Rollen innebär att du är med tidigt i affären, stöttar sälj i dialoger och lösningsförslag, och sedan fortsätter som en strategisk partner när kunden är på plats.
 



 Du driver utvecklingen av kundernas IT‑miljöer framåt – du ifrågasätter, föreslår förbättringar och säkerställer att lösningarna faktiskt skapar värde.
 



 Internt arbetar du nära både sälj och tekniska team, där du fungerar som en brygga mellan affär och leverans.
 



  





**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden** 



* **Kundutveckling** 
 – Analysera kundens verksamhet och IT-miljö samt identifiera förbättringsområden och tekniska initiativ.
* **Presales** 
 – Stötta sälj i att ta fram tekniskt förankrade lösningsförslag samt delta i kundmöten.
* **Lösning & genomförande** 
 – Bidra till design av lösningar, arkitektur och teknikval samt stötta i implementationsprojekt.
* **Uppföljning & förbättring** 
 – Följa upp levererade lösningar och IT-miljöer över tid samt identifiera behov av justeringar och vidareutveckling.
* **Internt utvecklingsarbete** 
 – Bidra till vidareutveckling av erbjudanden, arbetssätt och kunskapsdelning inom organisationen.



  





**Vi tror att du har:** 



* Erfarenhet som IT‑konsult, arkitekt eller liknande roll
* God teknisk bredd inom exempelvis: Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune & Defender, Serverdrift och nätverk
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära kund och omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar
* Förmåga att översätta teknik till affärsvärde
* Erfarenhet av presales eller lösningsdesign är meriterande
* B-körkort



  





**För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är:** 



* Affärsdriven och har ett intresse för kommersiella lösningar
* Kommunikativ och trygg i dialog med kund
* Analytisk och lösningsorienterad
* Prestigelös och samarbetsinriktad
* Positiv och bidrar till en öppen, inkluderande kultur



  





**Vårt erbjudande** 




 Vi må vara ett stort och globalt bolag – ja! Men här i Norden ser vi oss som ett sammansvetsat lag där alla är välkomna. Våra värdeord –
 *uppriktighet & kreativitet* 
 – har följt med oss sedan 1912 och finns med i allt vi gör. För oss innebär det att vi är inkluderande, ställer upp för varandra, hittar nya vägar och ser möjligheter även i motgångar. Det är vi - alla medarbetare på Sharp – som är vår kultur, det är vi som tillsammans växer och det är vi som är varandras arbetsmiljö!
 



  





 För att vi ska kunna växa tillsammans utbildar vi såväl ledare som medarbetare inom olika områden. Som medarbetare på Sharp är du bland annat en del av
 *Sharp Learning Forum* 
 där vi tillsammans utbildar varandra inom våra olika kompetensområden, allt för att skapa en högre kunskap och förståelse för varandras vardag!
 



  





 Vi skulle kunna prata på i en evighet om varför just du ska jobba hos oss, bland annat om vår tro på vikten av hälsa och balans i vardagen (där vi exempelvis erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag och friskvårdstimme), vårt brinnande engagemang för arbetsmiljö och hållbarhet eller att vi har en AW-grupp som för oss samman med roliga aktiviteter, men vi får pausa här och se fram emot att berätta mer i ett personligt möte!
 



  





**Om Sharp** 




 Sharp erbjuder lösningar för digitala arbetsplatser. Med vår gedigna erfarenhet, lokala förankring och breda kunskap levererar vi helhetslösningar för organisationer, oavsett bransch eller storlek. Det handlar om datorer, digitala möten och säker dokumenthantering till kompletta mötesrum, IT-drift, arbetsplatshantering och betallösningar. Vi säkerställer att företag alltid har rätt förutsättningar, utbildning och verktyg för att öka samarbete, kommunikation och säkerhet.

title: ISAC System Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
 Shape networks that don't just connect — they sense, interpret and respond.
   

  

 Ericsson is building the next generation of intelligent communication systems, and we need an expert to help define it. Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) sits at the intersection of telecommunications, radar and radio-based sensing, signal processing, AI and network architecture — an emerging market. If you have deep ISAC expertise and want to influence how future networks perceive and act on their environment, this is your next challenge.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join the Early System & Concept Evaluation team within our Radio Access Network (RAN) system architecture organization. We analyse future requirements, design system architectures, build prototypes and prepare the concepts behind Ericsson's next generations of solutions. ISAC is a new business segment that adds functions and requirements to existing telecom architectures — and you'll work alongside RAN experts to define how sensing capabilities integrate into future networks.
   

  

**About This Opportunity**
 You'll transform ISAC from an emerging concept into coherent, deployable, commercially relevant system solutions. Working across RAN and radio systems, sensing workflows and measurement control, signal processing, sensor fusion, object detection and tracking, distributed processing, core and management networks, data and APIs, and customer-facing applications, your job is to define how these domains work together as one integrated solution.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Translate customer, business, use-case and regulatory needs into clear system requirements and technical priorities.
* Define ISAC system architectures and the changes required in existing RAN and core network structures.
* Develop system concepts and implementation proposals with RAN experts and other technology teams.
* Analyze interfaces, dependencies, operational requirements and design trade-offs across the full ISAC solution.
* Specify sensing workflow management and sensing measurement control.
* Shape solutions for distributed processing and multi-client exposure of sensing results.
* Identify technical gaps, risks and opportunities early, and drive consistent alignment across teams.
* Contribute to prototypes, technology evaluations and early product concepts, and establish scalable, reusable architectural principles.
* Interact with Product management to set requirements
* Interact with and guide 3GPP delegates


**ISAC competence we're looking for**
* Expert knowledge of Integrated Sensing and Communication, radar or radio-based sensing — ideally including monostatic/bistatic/multistatic sensing geometries and joint communication-and-sensing (JCAS) waveform considerations.
* Sensing systems depth: object detection, tracking, target measurement (range, Doppler, angle) and sensor fusion.
* Signal processing for sensing: detection and estimation, clutter and interference handling, and tracking filters.
* RAN and telecom system architecture, and how sensing functions map onto 5G/6G RAN and core structures.
* Practical experience in one or more of the following: sensing workflow management and measurement control, distributed processing and multi-client exposure of sensing results, data management and API-based system integration, antenna and array understanding and its consequences and link budget and coverage analysis.
* Turning complex business, customer, use-case and regulatory needs into system requirements.
* Strong systems thinking: seeing relationships across technical domains and communicating them clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.


**The challenges you will enjoy**
 This role suits someone who thrives when the solution doesn't exist yet. ISAC introduces new functions across both RAN and core networks, so success depends on understanding the complete system — not just one domain — and continuously weighing interfaces, performance, deployment and operational trade-offs. You'll be comfortable where requirements are evolving, standards are still forming, and technical direction is shaped through collaboration, analysis and experimentation.
   

  

**Why it matters**
 ISAC is a significant evolution of wireless networks: future networks won't only connect people, devices and machines — they'll also sense and describe the world around them, enabling intelligent transportation, industrial automation, robotics, smart infrastructure, security and advanced positioning. Join now and you'll help define a technology area that is still being written — influencing the architectures, concepts and market approach Ericsson takes.
   

  

**Is this you?**
 You're a recognized technical expert who moves confidently between strategy and detail, enjoys interdisciplinary problems, and influences decisions through insight rather than authority. You're comfortable challenging existing approaches, creating clarity in uncertainty, and you want to help define the future of intelligent networks.
   

  

 Join Ericsson and help shape the networks that will not only communicate — but sense, understand and respond to the world around them.
   

  

**Why join Ericsson?**
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?**
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Data Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures.
   

  

 You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries.
   

  

 You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities.
   

  

 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.
   

  

 You’ll be based in Copenhagen or Stockholm as part of our global Data Engineering community. Working in cross-functional Agile teams, you’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI solutions. By partnering with clients from data owners to C-level executives you’ll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist.
   

  

 You will a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI, data engineering, and emerging agentic technologies. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of how data engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some leading AI and data experts in the industry.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Experience in a data-focused role (internships, academic projects)
* Ability to write clean, well-documented code in a modern programming language, with a strong preference for Python and SQL
* Interest in or exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods (streaming vs batch)

title: Mainframe IMS System Programmer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Mainframe IMS System Programmer to support, maintain, and enhance IBM IMS environments within z/OS. The role covers IMS system administration, database and transaction support, performance tuning, troubleshooting, security, disaster recovery, automation, and collaboration with application and infrastructure teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Install, configure, maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot IBM IMS and related products in z/OS environments.
* Manage IMS Control Regions, DBRC, dependent regions, IMSplex components, IMS Connect, databases, transactions, message queues, and related configuration datasets.
* Support IMS database administration, including backup, recovery, image copies, reorganization, DBRC/RECON management, and database integrity.
* Configure and maintain IMS transaction processing environments, including MPRs, BMPs, scheduling, routing, workload management, and high-volume transaction support.
* Support IMS Connect and integration with distributed platforms, TCP/IP, APIs, IBM MQ, CICS, and other enterprise middleware solutions.
* Monitor and tune IMS system, database, transaction, region, and connectivity performance using tools such as OMEGAMON, MainView, and native IMS facilities.
* Perform root-cause analysis for IMS system, database, transaction, connectivity, region, and application issues, including dump, log, trace, and SYSLOG analysis.
* Maintain IMS security and compliance controls, including RACF integration, access troubleshooting, secure communication, audit support, and vulnerability remediation.
* Develop, maintain, and test IMS backup, restart, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Create and maintain JCL, procedures, scripts, automation, technical documentation, implementation plans, and operational standards.
* Follow ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and release processes; participate in major incidents, production support, and on-call rotations as needed.
* Collaborate with application, z/OS, CICS, DB2, MQ, storage, network, security, middleware, operations, and architecture teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in IBM IMS system programming and administration in z/OS environments.
* Strong knowledge of IMS architecture, including Control Regions, DBRC, dependent regions, IMSplex, and IMS Connect.
* Experience with IMS databases, DBRC/RECON management, backup, recovery, reorganization, and recovery utilities.
* Hands-on experience with IMS configuration, maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, performance monitoring, and tuning.
* Strong knowledge of z/OS, JCL, JES, TSO/ISPF, SDSF, SMP/E, APAR/PTF management, and IBM software maintenance.
* Knowledge of IMS transaction processing, message queues, MPRs, BMPs, application regions, IMS Connect, and TCP/IP-based integration.
* Familiarity with OMEGAMON, MainView, RACF, z/OS security concepts, dump analysis, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* IBM IMS certification or equivalent IMS technical training.
* Experience with IMSplex, CSL, ODBM, OM, RM, shared queues, and high-availability architectures.
* Knowledge of IBM MQ, CICS, DB2, OTMA, REXX, JCL automation, and mainframe scripting.
* Experience supporting large-scale production IMS environments, modernization initiatives, API integration, and disaster recovery exercises.

title: Projektkoordinator
description:
Som projektkoordinator tillhör du it-avdelningens enhet för ledningsstöd it. Enheten utgör en administrativ resurs som arbetar med att stötta it-ledningens chefer och projektledare med ett kontinuerligt förbättrings- och utvecklingsarbete för att kunna erbjuda framtidens tekniklösningar för Åklagarmyndighetens samhällsviktiga verksamhet.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
 Du kommer att ingå i en enhet som utgör ett stöd för andra enheter inom it-avdelningen.
   

  

**I Arbetsuppgifterna Ingår Bland Annat Att**
* delta i och koordinera it-avdelningens projekt, behovssammanställningar, uppföljning och riskhantering
* sammanställa status- och riskrapporter samt
* bistå med administrativt stöd i form av t.ex. anteckningar vid olika möten.


 Du kommer även kunna vara med och utveckla rollen som projektkoordinator.
   

  

 I våra projekt och aktiviteter jobbar vi tätt tillsammans med myndighetens övriga organisation, särskilt med andra enheter på it-avdelningen och på huvudkontoret, men även med landets olika åklagarkammare. Vi arbetar ofta med externa parter såsom exempelvis Polismyndigheten och Domstolsverket.
   

  

**Dina kvaliteter och kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* relevant akademisk utbildning eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* väl vitsordad erfarenhet av projektadministration och uppföljning
* ett genuint intresse för digitaliseringsfrågor samt
* goda svenskkunskaper i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av uppföljning och riskhantering inom offentlig verksamhet.
   

  

 Som person vill vi att du
   

  

* är öppen och lyhörd med en god social och kommunikativ förmåga
* är driven och självgående
* är strukturerad, organiserad och har god förmåga att planera och följa upp ditt arbete
* har en god samarbetsförmåga och är van att samarbeta med olika typer av specialistkompetenser, såväl tekniska som verksamhetsmässiga samt
* är flexibel, lösningsorienterad och har en god förmåga att leda andra.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan på svenska.
   

  

 Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning i 6 månader.
   

  

 Tester förekommer i rekryteringsprocessen. Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och därmed sker säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav för denna anställning.
   

  

 Vi är en modern arbetsplats som möjliggör distansarbete, vilket gör att många medarbetare på it-avdelningen både arbetar på kontoret och träffas virtuellt. Vi erbjuder arbete hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan och övriga dagar i våra fina lokaler centralt vid Karlaplan i Stockholm. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på it-avdelningen här.
   

  

 Åklagarmyndigheten är en beredskapsmyndighet. Vid en anställning kan du komma att krigsplaceras på Åklagarmyndigheten. Läs mer under Jobba hos oss.
   

  

 På grund av arkivbestämmelser sparar vi ansökningar i två år. När du ansöker kommer dina personuppgifter att behandlas enligt offentlighetsprincipen samt dataskyddsförordningen. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss, samtycker du till detta.
