 At TEKsystems Global Services, we live in the tech world. We’re out in front of the trends and tools that shape industry and create fresh opportunities. All-in, fully engaged, high energy partnership is how we approach everything – our commitments and our people. Our people are at the centre, fuelling our high-performance and our inclusive culture.
 



 We’re doers, looking for doers who do the right thing. Roll-up your sleeves thought leaders focused on creating what’s possible. Team champions declare success only when everyone achieves their ambitions. Sound like the career experience you’ve been searching for? We’re looking for a Solution Executive to join our team. A practitioner who accelerates outcomes, affects positive change, and moves the business forward.
 



 Let’s partner. Together, we can accomplish amazing things. Here’s what the opportunity supported through our TGS Talent Acquisition Team requires:
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The Solution Executive is a key member of the Solutions team responsible for providing business leadership and strategic technical direction for customers. They will work to build and maintain broad relationships internally and externally, coach, and guide TEKsystems Global Services Sales, Practice & Delivery on strategy and relevant solutions and advise a team of extended partners throughout the sales process. They are responsible for solutioning and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer acceptance and service implementation. The Solution Executive will be the primary driver for identifying, scoping, and creating solutions/proposals that encompass technical approach, best practice, implementation, team structure, pricing, SoW and contracts. They work with all appropriate TEKsystems Global Services teams to support customer interests and will understand how to strongly advocate for their customer and balance that with the business needs of TEKsystems. The Solution Executive is the Solution Owner.
 



 The Solution Executive shows the ability to think strategically and long term about the needs of global businesses, and their financial implications. They show deep understanding of digital transformation of complex legacy IT environments to new native digital environments. The knowledge of Application and Data Modernization as well as Platform and Infrastructure Modernisation, and how to leverage advanced AI/ML to solve complex business challenges will be an advantage. Understanding of the broader AWS, GCP, Azure ecosystem and partner requirements makes them stand out from other Solution Executive peers.
 



 The Solution Executive takes the lead in driving collaboration and high-quality results across Sales, Solution Architects, Commercial, and Technical teams to support our strategic goals and deliver value to our customers. The Solution Executive maintains an individual portfolio of many simultaneous opportunities within the sales/solutioning business cycle including pre-sales strategy, solutioning, contracting, and transition to delivery.
 



**Qualification and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or related field
* Master’s in business administration or equivalent is a plus, but not required
* 15+ years’ experience in Information Technology and/or Professional Services required
* 10+ years’ experience in a professional services organization; 5+ years in client facing presales roles interfacing with business, sales and technology executives.
* Experience and understanding of an IT Consulting service provider environment, ideally in the areas of Application and Data Modernisation. Infrastructure and Platform Modernisation experience is desirable.
* Experience with Cloud, Infrastructure as a Service, Platform as a Service; Micro-services architecture models is required
* Demonstratable IT services presales in developing Application and Data Modernization Solutions across multiple industry verticals including Financial Services and Healthcare and Life Sciences.
* Experience in full DevOps life cycle of modern software development or methodology using Agile/Scrum/Kanban etc. Requirements analysis, design, development, automation, testing and implementation.
* Familiarity with GenAI services
* Understanding of Enterprise Cloud services relating to AWS, GCP and/or Microsoft.
* Certifications – related to AWS and GCP ideally.
* Experience developing effort/cost estimates, service pricing, writing statements of work, and reviewing/contributing to client contractual agreement.
* Experience working with enterprise clients across the UK and Mainland Europe.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with client business, technical, process, resource, and contractual requirements.
* English speaking and business writing a must, Swedish an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) is required; a master’s degree or other relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate effectively at all levels with an organization



  





**Key to Success** 



* Must have outstanding presentation and writing skills with the ability to communicate at all levels within the client and TEKsystems Global Services organization
* Must have strong business and information technology acumen with the ability to communicate capabilities, gather and assess client requirements, and communicate solution and value proposition to clients
* Ability to support the GTM strategy in region.
* Must have strong technical understanding with the ability build credibility with IT and Business Leadership
* Ability to set the strategic direction while also being able to operate at a detailed level.
* Outstanding facilitation, presentation, verbal, and writing skills with the ability to communicate at all levels within the client and organisation.
* Occasional travel will be required.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

 Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.
   

  

 "As market leader within Digital Identity and Security, Thales makes personal digital interaction simple and secure in an increasingly connected society. From secure software to biometrics and encryption, Thales provides technologies and services that enables business and governments to authenticate identities and protect data, enabling its clients to offer trusted digital services to billions of individuals. Located in Älvsjö since 2012, the site houses both a commercial office as well as two productions within Identity & Biometric Solutions, and Banking & Payment Services. Working commercially across all business areas within Digital Identity and Security, Thales has become a trusted partner within various businesses as well as governments throughout the Nordics.
   

  

**Role: Service Delivery Manager**
**Base location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)**
**Security process:** 
 This position requires that you undergo and be approved in accordance with the applicable regulations for security protection. For positions where Thales has requirements for security clearance, this may entail a requirement for local citizenship.
   

  

**Identity & Biometric Solutions (IBS) business line**
 Thales Identity and Biometric Solutions (IBS) Business Line is part of the global Thales Group, which employs more than 80,000 people in 68 countries.
   

  

 Thales delivers identity and biometric solutions to governments, public authorities, and private entities in civil identity and public security. We do this by providing highly secure documents, such as passports, ID cards, driver’s licenses, etc., at the heart of identity schemes. We also provide solutions for verifying people’s identities, for example, when they cross borders and enrolling them in national registers. Both of these are built on our expertise in biometrics.
   

  

 And, as governments go through a digital transformation, we support them by delivering secure, convenient, and feature-proof mobile identity, digital identity wallet, platform, and services. We also address public security and law enforcement challenges by offering the latest in criminal forensics and real-time facial recognition.
   

  

**Description**
 Thales Cybersecurity & Digital & Identity (CDI) provides Customers with technology to assist them in Identity and Biometric Solutions (IBS) business line.
   

  

 Service Delivery Manager (SDM) shall manage the support and maintenance contracts related to Government Solutions (including Software and equipment supplied by Thales as well as third parties). SDM will ensure customer satisfaction in respect of contractual commitments, and the fulfilment of Service level agreements (SLA). SDM will be mainly involved in governance of incident, problem, and change management on the complete solution with contribution to upsell and new opportunities.
   

  

 The installed Biometric and Public Security Solutions with associated software, hardware and peripherals are integrated with the Customers processes. SDM work with the Customer, Thales Internal and External Partner Suppliers and Thales Development/Senior Technical Teams (Level 2 and Level 3 Support) to ensure our response and restoration processes are aligned to contractual SLA and Availability and Reliability are maximised.
   

  

 The role will work closely with different departments at our Älvsjö Office. The Line Manager is located abroad and so is several of the other Service Delivery Managers in the Manager’s team.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Act as the primary customer interface for Support and Maintenance (S&M) contracts.
* Manage customer accounts by providing regular activity reporting, including weekly and monthly updates, steering committee materials, KPI reports, and SLA reports; recommend service improvements; and support contract renewals and new commercial proposals in coordination with Sales.
* Monitor incident resolution, ensure SLA compliance, and manage escalations whenever required.
* Monitor contract financial performance and maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction.
* Manage third-party contracts, communications, and performance monitoring where applicable.
* Coordinate and follow up on actions involving third parties and internal support teams, ensuring alignment with Thales processes.
* Prepare, plan, and manage the execution of changes in coordination with technical teams.
* Coordinate contractual activities such as preventive maintenance operations.
* Provide internal reporting on account activities and profitability; manage the contract using Thales tools in accordance with Thales processes.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* At least five years of experience in service delivery management or project management for IT solutions.
* Strong customer relationship management skills.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish.
* Ability to travel at short notice within Europe.
* Eligibility for security clearance for Swedish customer.
* Experience working with remote teams.
* Experience in government-related activities is a plus.


**What we offer:**
* Competitive compensation package including base salary and performance-based incentives.
* A key role in shaping the company’s presence in a strategically important region.
* Opportunity to work with innovative technologies and cross-border teams.
* Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities.


 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

title: AI Engineer
description:
About
 



 At Uniplay, our vision is simple:
 **Make Corporate Learning Fun.** 




  





 We're building something different — an AI-native company where games, data, and hyper-personalisation redefine how people learn and grow at work. Our product blends games, behavioral data, and AI agents into a living learning experience that adapts to employees and evolves with every organisation.
 



  





 We care less about titles and more about people who create, collaborate, and push limits.
 



  





 The role
 



 AI isn't a feature we bolted on — it's the product. Agent workflows, source grounding, RAG, structured generation, and learning science are how we turn real company material into adaptive, game-based learning.
 



  





 We're looking for an AI Engineer to join the team building that machinery: researching what's possible, building it, evaluating it honestly, and shipping it to customers. It's a hands-on role for someone who moves from paper to prototype to production without needing three planning meetings first.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* **Build AI learning pipelines end to end.** 
 From ingestion of source material to generated, adaptive learning content — research, build, ship, measure, improve, together with the rest of the engineering team.
* **Work with messy, real knowledge sources.** 
 Documents, links, videos, internal company material. Turning that into something useful is the hard part, and it's what the team spends its days on.
* **Build our evaluation infrastructure.** 
 Quality in generated learning content is not a vibe. Help us define how we measure it and make the numbers move.
* **Improve the AI production system.** 
 Prompts, templates, orchestration, model selection, latency, cost, internal tooling. Find the bottlenecks and remove them.
* **Add a strong voice to the roadmap.** 
 You'll have real influence over what we build next — and a direct line to the people making those calls.
* **Work closely with the rest of the team.** 
 Engineers, product, design, and learning experts. You'll review each other's work, pair on hard problems, and share what you learn.



  





 What we're looking for
 


* **Real experience shipping AI systems.** 
 You've built LLM-powered products that ran in production, with real users and real failure modes — not just notebooks and demos.
* **Depth in the modern stack.** 
 RAG, agentic workflows, structured generation, evals, vector databases, knowledge graphs. You know where each one earns its keep and where it doesn't.
* **Your own projects.** 
 You build things because you can't help it. Show us at least one — repo, demo, write-up, product. What you learned matters more than how polished it is.
* **Extreme drive.** 
 You don't wait for permission. You make things happen and bring people along.
* **Fast iteration.** 
 You prototype quickly, kill your own ideas when the data says so, and are comfortable with messy early-stage exploration.
* **Strong engineering.** 
 TypeScript and/or Python. You write code others can build on.
* **Curiosity about how people learn.** 
 The bottleneck to AI value isn't technology — it's human learning and behaviour change. If that thesis interests you, we'll get along.
* **A team player.** 
 You share context, ask for help early, give useful feedback, and would rather the team ship something good than be right on your own.
* **Clear communication in English. Swedish a plus.**



  





 Why Uniplay
 


* Work on AI that turns company knowledge into learning experiences people voluntarily come back to.
* Global from day one — Sweden, Brazil, UK, DACH.
* A small team where your work reaches production in days, not quarters.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, AI specialists, HR experts, and product designers.
* Stockholm-base



  





**Goodbye boring. Hello fun.** 




  





 Apply
 


* https://careers.uniplay.io/jobs/8223234-ai-engineer

title: System- och informationssamordnare till socialkontoret
description:
****I Upplands-Bro kommun är vi cirka 2000 medarbetare som arbetar med att ge våra invånare och besökare bästa möjliga service och upplevelse av kommunen. Hos oss är du med och bygger en kommun där helhetssyn, engagemang och professionalitet genomsyrar organisationen och tillsammans arbetar vi med att utföra det gemensamma samhällsuppdraget.****




**Vill du vara med och utveckla en helt ny roll med ett övergripande ansvar för samordning, utveckling och förvaltning av socialkontorets verksamhetskritiska digitala stöd samt bidra till en strukturerad informationshantering och ett stärkt dataskyddsarbete?**




 Som system- och informationssamordnare har du en central funktion som länken mellan den kommunövergripande IT- och digitaliseringsenheten och socialkontorets systemförvaltning. Du ansvarar för att planera och samordna systemförvaltningen, säkerställer att systemen skapar nytta för verksamheten och stödjer effektiva arbetssätt. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, systemägare, systemförvaltare, leverantörer och andra systemsamordnare inom kommunen. I tjänsten ingår även att ha ett samordningsansvar för socialkontorets informationshantering där arkiv och gallring av akter ingår.
   

  





**Du kommer bland annat att:** 



* Samordna systemförvaltningen av samtliga system inom socialkontoret
* Säkerställa att systemen stödjer verksamhetens processer och behov
* Följa upp avtal och leveranser från systemleverantörer
* Arbeta med dataskyddsfrågor inom socialkontoret och samarbeta med kommunens övergripande informations- och säkerhetsansvarige samt dataskyddsombudet
* Samordna arbetet med att ta fram socialkontorets informationshanteringsplan och följa upp efterlevnaden av den



 I rollen ingår även förvaltningsansvar eller kontaktpersonsansvar för ett antal system, exempelvis lösningar för trygghetslarm och digital tillsyn.
   

  





**Vi söker dig som har:** 



* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, informationsförvaltning, offentlig förvaltning eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
* Erfarenhet av systemförvaltning, verksamhetsutveckling och/eller digitalisering.
* Erfarenhet av projektledning eller arbetsledning.
* God förståelse för hur verksamhetsprocesser, IT-stöd och informationshantering samverkar.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.



**Det är meriterande om du har:** 



* Erfarenhet från kommunal eller annan offentlig verksamhet, gärna inom något av socialtjänstens områden.
* Erfarenhet av systemsamordning.
* Erfarenhet av införande av verksamhetssystem.
* Kunskap om dataskyddslagstiftning, informationssäkerhet eller dokumenthantering är meriterande.



**Vi erbjuder**




 Upplands-Bro kommun har den lilla kommunens fördelar med bland annat korta beslutsvägar och stor möjlighet att vara delaktig i arbetets utveckling. Utgångspunkten för våra uppdrag är den gemensamma arbetsplatsen, där vi tillsammans utvecklar verksamheten och skapar förutsättningar för samarbete. Vi har system som möjliggör arbete på distans i överenskommelse med chef och när verksamheten tillåter. Kommunen arbetar aktivt för att öka jämställdhet och mångfald på arbetsplatserna, varför vi gärna ser sökande som bidrar till detta. Läs mer om kommunen som arbetsgivare här.
   

  





**Om tjänsten**




 Tjänsten är tillsvidare, heltid. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
   

  





**Om rekryteringsprocessen**




 Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan senast
 **29 september 2026** 
 . Du ansöker enkelt genom att bifoga ditt CV, men utan personligt brev. De kandidater som uppfyller samtliga skallkrav (utbildning, kunskap och erfarenhet) kommer att kontaktas för nästa steg i processen. I vissa rekryteringar kan det även bli aktuellt med arbetspsykologiska tester, beroende på rollens karaktär och behov.
   

  





 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under annonseringsperioden, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  





*Alla erbjudanden om annonsering och hjälp i rekryteringsprocessen undanbedes.*




**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**




 I Upplands-Bro strävar vi efter värdigt åldrande, där individens behov sätts främst. Äldreomsorgen handlar om att ge möjlighet till självständighet och valfrihet i boende och vård. Vi sätter höga krav på kvalitet och kontinuerlig uppföljning för att säkerställa en äldrevänlig och värdig miljö.
   

  





**Upplands-Bro kommun är en av Sveriges mest expansiva kommuner där utveckling står i centrum. Vi välkomnar dig till en arbetsplats där ledorden i vårt arbete och förhållningssätt är Helhetssyn, Engagemang och Professionalitet.**

description:

 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

**Job Summary**
 The Solutions Consultant Manager is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineer Manager role, aligning how we lead teams to best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.
   

  

 As our Solutions Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your District Solutions Consulting team. You will work closely with the District Sales Manager and, along with your team, build relationships with your customers with the goal of helping them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. Our customers need guidance on what applications to deploy from our platform.  As the technical leader for your assigned territory, you will guide and develop your team to define innovative technical solutions that secure customers' key business imperatives and maximize the value of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You will champion our industry leadership in on-premises, cloud, and security operations services, establishing Palo Alto Networks as the preferred cybersecurity partner for your customers. You will also nurture talent within your team and provide valuable feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on insights gained from your customer interaction. Your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

* Recruit and hire new Solutions Consultants into the territory, hiring the best talent in the industry
* Responsible for training, mentoring, and reviewing employees on your team, keeping them engaged and successful in their careers
* Support field Solutions Consultant team in complex evaluations, problem-solving and challenging customer environments

* Act as an escalation point to collaborate with pre-sales and post-sales teams for any issues that arise
* Build and maintain relationships with key customers to solidify reference accounts and to assist the account teams with defining plans to drive more business
* Present to customers as our expert in your area at all levels in the customer hierarchy from technician to CIO
* Discuss competitor products in the marketplace and positions ours as the best alternative
* Working with Product Management, Technical Marketing, and R&D to build requirements and product features for our large customers and provide feedback from customers
* 50-75% travel within the region
* Work with your sales counterpart (DSM) to develop a technical strategy that accelerates growth. Identify key verticals, markets, use cases, and solutions to focus on, and devise a comprehensive strategy and engagement model tailored to your region or district.
* Thought leadership and market influence through public speaking, social media (linkedin), press and media
* Driving technical and throught leadership events (Ignite, BigBiteofTech)


**Qualifications**
* Experience as a pre-sales System Engineer Manager
* Experience as a Senior System Engineer/Specialist
* Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of our roadmap and technology development efforts, knowledge of competitor offerings and products
* Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to Palo Alto Networks customer base
* Experience in selling, designing, implementing or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
* Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
* Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
* Quota driven attitude focused on client's best solution by being a trusted advisor
* Fluent English
* Fluent Swedish


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer – .NET, Azure, React and Design Systems
description:
**Assignment Description** 




 We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Developer with strong hands-on backend expertise and solid frontend experience for an assignment within a large enterprise organization.
 



 The consultant will take significant technical responsibility for developing business-critical applications, integrations, and reusable frontend components. The role involves working in an early-stage environment where requirements, architecture, and technology choices may not yet be fully established.
 



 You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, UX/UI designers, product owners, and development teams to translate business needs and designs into scalable, accessible, and maintainable technical solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and develop backend solutions using C#, .NET 8, and Web API.
* Develop integrations across complex system environments, including legacy systems.
* Build and maintain database solutions using Entity Framework Core and MS SQL Server.
* Develop modern frontend applications and reusable components using React and TypeScript.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of the organization’s design system and component library.
* Ensure that frontend components comply with WCAG accessibility standards.
* Perform frontend and backend testing to maintain high code quality.
* Support other development teams in implementing shared components and design-system standards.
* Contribute to architecture and technology decisions during the early stages of development.
* Break down business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Bicep.
* Produce technical and component documentation.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and agile ways of working.



**Mandatory Requirements** 



* 6–8 years of professional software development experience.

title: Project Manager, Healthcare Consultant  - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
**At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with purposeful technology and service offerings that help them in their everyday lives. If that sounds interesting, please keep reading.**
**About Us**
 Through advanced, intuitive technology and services, Tieto Caretech reduces administrative work, improves decision-making, and strengthens safety and quality in health and social care. With the consulting services and Lifecare software portfolio we enable health and social care professionals to focus on what matters most: people.
   

  

 We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can be part of advancing societies through purposeful technology and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people.
   

  

**About The Role**
 At Tieto Caretech, we support healthcare and social care organizations in their digital transformation journeys. We aim to understand our customers challenges and guide them forward by offering the right mix of products, services, and expertise.
   

  

 By combining healthcare knowledge, technology expertise, and consulting capabilities, we work together with our customers to create sustainable solutions that improve healthcare processes, support informed decision-making, and ultimately contribute to better outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals.
   

  

**We are expanding our Consulting team and are looking for two new colleagues. Depending on your experience and background, you will join us at the level that best matches your skills and expertise.**
 As a consultant at Tieto Caretech, you will work closely with customers to understand their needs, challenges, and objectives. Depending on the assignment, you may lead projects, facilitate workshops, gather and analyse requirements, map business processes, or support change and transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Your assignments may be within one or more of our focus areas:**
* Data Management
* Development & Integration
* Application Management


 At the same time, the starting point is always the customer's needs. This means that your role may span several areas and involve both business and technology perspectives to ensure that the chosen solution creates real and lasting value.
   

  

 We welcome candidates with different levels of experience. Whether you are an experienced Project Manager or a Senior Project Manager with a track record of leading larger and more complex engagements, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

**In this role you will**
* Lead and deliver customer projects from initiation to successful implementation
* Collaborate with customers and stakeholders to understand needs, define requirements, and identify the right solutions
* Facilitate workshops, steering committees, and stakeholder dialogues
* Coordinate activities across customers, healthcare professionals, developers, architects, and other specialists
* Support customers in digital transformation and change initiatives
* Build long-term customer relationships and contribute to the development of our consulting service
* For Senior Project Managers, the role also includes leading larger and more complex engagements, advising senior stakeholders, and contributing to the development of project management practices within the organization.


**We are looking for someone with**
* Experience in project management, consulting, business analysis, process development, or similar roles
* Have experience as a nurse, physiotherapist or similar role
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
* A structured and proactive way of working with a focus on delivering results
* Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into practical solutions
* An interest in digitalization and how technology can support healthcare and social care organizations
* Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken


**It would be beneficial if you also**
* Have experience working in a consulting environment
* Have knowledge of healthcare regulations, information security, or healthcare processes
* Have experience within Data Management, Development & Integration, or Application Management
* Hold a project management certification such as PRINCE2, IPMA, PMP, PPS or similar
* Have EHR-kompetens


**AI knowledge requirement**
 AI literacy is expected - able to use approved AI tools effectively and responsibly, write clear prompts, and validate outputs. You undertand how to follow company policies and applicable requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not entering sensitive data into unapproved tools).
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You will work in projects and initiatives that contribute to better healthcare services, improved ways of working, and more efficient use of information and technology.
   

  

 As part of our Consulting team, you will have the opportunity to work with a variety of customers, challenges, and assignments. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning, and we encourage our consultants to develop both professionally and personally.
   

  

 In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
   

  

 Finally, we believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.
   

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Ulriqa Edin [ulriqa.edin@tieto.com].
   

  

*We perform background checks on all final candidates.*
*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*
 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto
   

  

**Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

 - Rapportering och analys i OmniFi
 



 - Hantering av finansiella instrument och corporate actions
 



 - Säkerställa datakvalitet och systemuppsättning
 



 - Utveckla processer, kontroller och arbetssätt

 - God förståelse för obligationer, räntebärande instrument samt mer komplexa och oregelbundna lånestrukturer

 Du är analytisk, noggrann och lösningsorienterad med ett genuint intresse för både finans och system.  Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Product Owner, Purchasing Tools
description:
**Build with us - together with the best colleagues in the industry!**
 At NCC, we are driven to continue developing, whether it's our construction projects or our personal expertise. Every day, we drive the industry's most exciting and complex construction projects forward in close cooperation between our employees, partners and customers. With us, you are a significant employee who contributes to the landmarks that define our cities and communities. Here, our employees take an active role in a corporate culture based on stable values and behaviors for a safe and secure workplace. Our collective expertise and diverse backgrounds make a difference.
   

  

**The Role And Key Responsibilities**
 Purchasing is a top priority at NCC and plays a vital role in winning and delivering profitable projects. We are now looking for a driven and business-minded Product Owner to lead the continued development of our purchasing tools and digital solutions, working closely with users, stakeholders and IT. We are in an exciting phase where we are re-evaluating and replacing our current tools, and you will play a key role in shaping what the future purchasing toolscape at NCC looks like – including how emerging technologies can create new value. You will also play a key role in the larger Digitalization team, contributing to team strategy and helping drive NCC's digital development agenda.
   

  

 As a Product Owner, you take full ownership of our purchasing tools and are responsible for maximizing the value they deliver to the business. You set the direction and roadmap, prioritize the backlog, and work closely with our Digitalization specialists, development team and IT Service Owner to ensure the tools meet both user needs and enterprise requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision and roadmap: Define a clear direction for your tool(s), aligned with NCC's purchasing strategy and priorities.
* Manage the backlog: Capture, prioritize and refine needs from stakeholders and users, ensuring the team focuses on the initiatives that creates the greatest value.
* Drive stakeholder collaboration: Build strong, transparent relationships with business stakeholders, users and IT, and represent their needs in product decisions.
* Lead delivery together with the team: Collaborate on execution, review and accept completed work, and ensure solutions meet quality and business requirements.
* Manage the product lifecycle: Monitor performance, costs and service levels, and continuously identify areas for improvement.
* Facilitate and optimize ongoing agile work within the team to ensure good collaboration and high quality of work.
* Ensure initiatives have clear objectives, expected outcomes and success metrics.
* Monitor product KPIs and use insights to guide prioritization and roadmap decisions.
* Coordinate across teams: Work with other Product Owners to manage dependencies and ensure a coherent tools landscape across purchasing.


**About Purchasing At NCC**
 NCC Purchasing is a network of professionals across the company. We handle everything from project purchasing and supplier base development to strategic sourcing and category management. Collaboration between our teams is key to delivering successful customer projects. You will join the Purchasing Development & Digitalization unit, focused on creating industry-leading purchasing capabilities and driving digital development across the organization. The construction industry is undergoing a digital transformation, and NCC is leading the way. You'll be part of a team shaping the future of purchasing and creating real value for both users and the business.
   

  

**Your Experience And Background**
 Education
   

  

* M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, IT or a related field


**Experience**
* Proven experience as a Product Owner (3+ years), preferably managing internal digital products, tools or services
* Experience working in Scrum or other agile ways of working, with a mindset characterized by quick feedback loops and iterative development
* Track record in leading product development, including defining direction, prioritizing backlogs and managing stakeholders
* Experience working closely with IT, translating business needs into clear requirements
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage both business and technical audiences
* Good understanding of procurement processes and supply chain management is highly valued
* Experience from the construction industry is an advantage
* You are fluent in one of the Nordic languages and in English


**Ready to take the next step?**
 If you're excited about leading the development of digital tools that make a real difference for NCC, we'd love to hear from you. Join us on our journey to build business-leading purchasing capabilities through digitalization, collaboration and continuous improvement. Apply today and help us build what's next.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 You will be based at any of NCC's Office in the Nordics. The role involves travel within the Nordics. However, we embrace flexible ways of working and strive to collaborate digitally whenever possible.
   

  

 In accordance with NCC:s safety culture we conduct background checks on final candidates.
   

  

**NCC Offers**
 NCC strives to be an appealing employer, providing a work environment where people can grow and experience well-being. We offer a wide range of employee benefits. NCC has collective agreements for all employees, providing a solid foundation of security and clear guidelines so that you know what applies to your employment. We also offer excellent opportunities for continued development and a broad range of further education options, allowing for a long career within the company.
   

  

**Contact and information**
 For more information about the position, please contact Emma Papakosta, Head of Purchasing development and Digitalization, +46 70 554 1030. Register your application and CV in English below. Register your application and CV below. Applications are reviewed continuously, so apply as soon as possible, and no later than September 13, 2026
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Solution Architect Engineer for Grid Infrastructure and Datacenter
description:
**Shape the Future of Energy Infrastructure with Schneider Electric**
 At Schneider Electric, we empower everyone to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability for all. Our technologies, software, and services help customers across industries, cities, and critical infrastructure become more efficient, resilient, and sustainable.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong
 **Solution Architect Engineer** 
 to join our Nordic Power Systems team in Sweden. This strategic role focuses on the
 **Infrastructure (Power & Grid)** 
 and
 **Data Center** 
 segments, supporting customers in designing, modernizing, and digitizing their electrical distribution and energy management systems.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect Engineer, you will transform customer requirements into innovative, reliable, and cost-effective technical architectures. Working closely with customers, consultants, utilities, and internal stakeholders, you will help define and promote best-in-class solutions based on Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure™ platform and power distribution portfolio.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Develop Technical Architectures and Solutions
   

  

* Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable, efficient, and low-risk electrical distribution architectures.
* Design comprehensive Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) solutions for infrastructure, utility, grid, and data center applications.
* Leverage Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure™ architecture, software, and digital technologies to create differentiated customer value.


 Drive Technical Influence and Customer Engagement
   

  

* Build strong relationships with customers' engineering and technical teams, consultants, utilities, and key industry stakeholders.
* Influence specifications and project requirements during the early stages of project development.
* Develop technical proposals and reference architectures aligned with customer objectives and industry best practices.
* Promote Schneider Electric's value proposition through innovative and sustainable energy solutions.


 Support Business Growth
   

  

* Partner with Account Managers to qualify opportunities and define winning technical strategies.
* Identify emerging market trends, customer challenges, and new business opportunities.
* Represent Schneider Electric at customer events, industry conferences, technical seminars, demonstrations, and workshops.
* Support the introduction of new solutions and architectures tailored to the Infrastructure, Power & Grid, and Data Center markets.


 Collaborate Across the Organization
   

  

* Lead technical qualification activities for offers, solutions, and reference architectures.
* Work closely with Solution Architects, Technical Leaders, Application Engineers, and segment experts across the organization.
* Contribute to the continuous development of Schneider Electric's technical expertise and customer-facing solutions.


**Essential Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**
* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Solid experience in MV and LV electrical distribution systems and architectures.
* Strong understanding of power system design, protection, control, and energy distribution solutions.
* Proven experience working with infrastructure, utility, grid, industrial, or data center power systems.
* Comprehensive knowledge of Swedish grid requirements, regulations, grid connection processes, and applicable standards is mandatory.
* Ability to engage confidently with customers, consultants, utilities, and technical decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Data Center electrical infrastructure and critical power systems.
* Knowledge of digital power technologies, monitoring systems, SCADA, Energy Management Systems (EMS), or IoT-enabled solutions.
* Familiarity with BIM, CAD, electrical design, planning, and calculation tools.
* Interest in digitalization, AI-driven solutions, and the future of smart electrical networks.


**Why Schneider Electric?**
 Joining Schneider Electric means becoming part of a global leader in energy management and automation. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most innovative and impactful energy projects in Sweden and across the Nordic region.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* A challenging and rewarding role with significant customer impact.
* Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies and industry-leading solutions.
* An international and collaborative working environment.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* A company culture focused on sustainability, innovation, diversity, inclusion, and employee growth.


 Join Us
   

  

 If you are passionate about power systems, grid modernization, and helping customers build the resilient and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Apply today and help us accelerate the digital transformation of energy management and electrical distribution across Sweden.**
 At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.
   

  

 Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits – it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.
   

  

 Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you

title: Business Development Manager - Cloud
description:
**Varför Välja TD SYNNEX**
 Som ett globalt Fortune 500-företag, verksamt i över 100 länder, värdesätter TD SYNNEX sin mångsidiga arbetsstyrka på 24 000 anställda. Som världens största IT-distributör är vårt uppdrag att tillhandahålla förstklassiga teknologilösningar och ge företag och individer möjlighet att navigera i den digitala världen på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
   

  

**Om Rollen**
 Som
 **Business Development Manager för Microsoft Azure** 
 får du en central kommersiell roll i utvecklingen av TD SYNNEX svenska Azure-affär.
   

  

 Du ansvarar för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, rekrytera och aktivera partners samt hjälpa etablerade partners att utveckla och skala sin Azure-affär. Du arbetar marknadsorienterat, prioriterar insatser utifrån affärspotential och bidrar till den övergripande affärsplanen tillsammans med Microsoft, interna specialistteam och TD SYNNEX ledning.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som har erfarenhet av partnerutveckling, kanalförsäljning eller affärsutveckling och som har en god förståelse för Azure och molnaffären. Du behöver inte vara lösningsarkitekt, men du ska kunna föra en inledande lösningsdialog, kvalificera kundens behov och involvera rätt teknisk kompetens när affären kräver det.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är också att identifiera hur TD SYNNEX support-, tjänste- och finansieringserbjudanden kan stärka partnerns lösning och skapa ett större affärsvärde för slutkunden.
   

  

**Vad Du Kommer Att Göra**
* Rekrytera nya återförsäljare och utveckla deras affär tillsammans med TD SYNNEX.
* Aktivera partners som ännu inte har etablerat en skalbar Azure-affär.
* Hjälpa aktiva partners att skapa tillväxt genom nya Azure-lösningar, tjänster och kommersiella paketeringar.
* Utveckla och genomföra den kommersiella planen för Microsoft Azure i Sverige.
* Prioritera partners, affärsmöjligheter och initiativ utifrån potential, lönsamhet och genomförbarhet.
* Driva utvalda strategiska affärer och stötta säljteamet i andra affärsmöjligheter.
* Föra inledande lösningsdialoger, kvalificera behov och samla rätt kommersiella och tekniska kompetenser kring affären.
* Positionera TD SYNNEX befintliga support-, tjänste- och finansieringserbjudanden som en del av partnerns lösning.
* Planera och genomföra partneraktiviteter, exempelvis webbinarier, hackathons, workshops och roadshows.
* Bygga och utveckla starka relationer med Microsoft, återförsäljare och andra viktiga intressenter.
* Följa upp kommersiella resultat, partneraktivering, pipeline och genomförda initiativ.


**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Minst tre års relevant erfarenhet av partnerutveckling, kanalförsäljning, affärsutveckling eller komplex B2B-försäljning inom IT.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med återförsäljare, partners eller andra indirekta försäljningskanaler.
* God förståelse för Microsoft Azure eller en jämförbar molnplattform.
* Förmåga att föra övergripande lösningsdiskussioner och kvalificera behov innan tekniska specialister involveras.
* Förmåga att förstå partnerns och slutkundens verksamhet och omsätta identifierade behov till relevanta kommersiella erbjudanden.
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt ta initiativ och driva aktiviteter från idé till genomförande.
* Ett affärsmässigt och strukturerat arbetssätt samt förmåga att prioritera mellan flera parallella möjligheter.
* Flytande svenska och mycket god engelska i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft CSP, Azure consumption, IT-distribution, supportavtal, managed services eller professional services.
   

  

**Vem Vi Tror Att Du Är**
 Du är förtroendeingivande och trygg i dialogen med partners, kunder och interna kollegor. Du är nyfiken, affärsorienterad och har lätt för att skapa engagemang och få med dig andra.
   

  

 Du väntar inte på att någon annan ska definiera varje aktivitet. Du identifierar möjligheter, tar initiativ och anpassar planen när marknaden eller partnernas behov förändras. Samtidigt har du gott omdöme och förstår när en affär kräver teknisk specialistkompetens. Du är då skicklig på att samla rätt personer och driva arbetet framåt.
   

  

 Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Däremot har du ambitionen, nyfikenheten och lärförmågan som krävs för att snabbt utveckla din kompetens och successivt ta ett större ansvar för Azure-affären.
   

  

 At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
   

  

**What's In It For You?**
* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.


**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**
 At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

title: Sales Director, CRM Solutions
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Director, CRM Sales is responsible for leading a rapid expansion of ServiceNow’s CRM focused product lines in the Central region. This will be achieved through building, leading, mentoring, coaching and developing the team of Sales Executives across ServiceNow’s evolving product portfolio. As a Director, CRM Sales you will lead transformational shifts to create business value for our customers. The ideal candidate must have deep experience in SaaS sales and motivation to build a team to drive revenues and rapidly gain customers within new markets.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
* Lead a team of CRM Account Executives to drive rapid new business sales growth in the EMEA North region
* Build and drive sales strategy in conjunction with Field Sales and Pre-Sales Leadership, Professional Services, Marketing, Alliances & Channels and Sales Operations teams to effectively Go-To-Market including understanding the competitive landscape, presence and strength within the region
* Act as the central conduit to Global Business Unit Sales Leadership teams and Field Sales Leadership
* Actively engage in territory planning, relationship development and opportunity development and driving revenue by assisting Sales Directors, and Field Sales Teams in closing opportunities
* Recruit, coach and mentor team members to drive excellence
* Development of territories and quota for the sales team and effectively communicate to set performance expectations within the team
* Manage and report accurate forecast and pipeline to the business, both locally, within EMEA and with Global business units
* Achievement of annual sales goals on a quarterly and annual basis is required
* Build effective working relationships with Solution Consulting, Product Development, Customer Outcomes, Partner, Marketing and the ServiceNow executive team


**Qualifications**
**In order to be successful in this role, we need someone who has:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* Extensive track record of new business sales success of CRM Solutions including presentation and negotiation skills within industry and at C-Level
* CRM SaaS experience essential, experience of PaaS even better
* Deep and broad experience (4+ years) as a sales leader with prior success as an CRM Sales executive experience
* Prior experience in both direct sales and sales overlay capacities
* Strong collaborator across the disciplines mentioned above
* Strong success in recruiting, coaching and managing an exceptional sales team
* Strong strategic thinking including analytical and financial planning skills to meet and exceed quotas and goals.
* Experienced in planning and organization
* Experienced in public speaking and comfortable presenting to large audiences with credibility
* Track record in using social media to enhance the ServiceNow brand message
* Experienced in driving sales process and drive effective working relationships with Sales Operations
* Experience in one or many of the Product Portfolio outlined preferred but not essential
* Ability to build long term strategic and senior level relationships
* Ability to adapt and work effectively within a rapidly changing and growing environment
* Strong business and financial acumen
* Fluency in English and one of the regional languages, regional travel required


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work. Learn more here.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Customer Success Director
description:
Sapiens International is a global provider of core software for the insurance industry, serving Property & Casualty, Life & Pensions, and Reinsurance carriers worldwide. Our Customer Success team keeps and grows our customers beyond go-live.
 



  





 We are hiring a Customer Success Director to look after a portfolio of our commercial insurance customers through a consistent, playbook-led motion.
 



  





 You will be the named contact for a larger book of accounts, accountable for keeping them healthy and renewable at scale. This is a one-to-few role for people who run a disciplined, repeatable Customer Success motion and work with customers' operational owners day to day, rather than at C-suite level.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Deliver Sapiens' Customer Success motion for your book in line with the defined framework, playbooks, and tier coverage model.
* Be the named Customer Success Manager and maintain strong customer relationships built on credibility, consistency, and value, from go-live onward at a steady cadence.
* Own account health and product adoption across the book; track and report on adoption, usage, and health metrics, and act early where an account starts to slip.
* Run a consistent, standardised review cycle and build templated Customer Success plans that connect each customer's business goals to the value they get from Sapiens.
* Protect the retention floor: identify at-risk accounts early and orchestrate and mediate escalation resolution by pulling in the right internal stakeholders.
* Orchestrate Sales, Support, Delivery, Product, and Enablement so the customer experiences one coordinated relationship, coordinating training and resources as needed.
* Identify expansion (cross-sell and upsell) opportunities aligned to the customer's strategy and pass them to Sales to progress. You own the signal, not the sale.
* Use AI-assisted monitoring and standard health triggers to run a larger book efficiently.



  





**Scope:** 




 You own the customer's success and growth from point of sale onward. You do not carry a sales quota or close deals, run support tickets, or run implementation projects – Sales, Support, and Delivery own those. You protect retention, flag expansion, and escalate on the customer's behalf.
 



  





**Experience Required:** 



* 5+ years in a customer-facing role (Customer Success, account management, consulting, or customer support) managing a portfolio of accounts, including relationship management and issue resolution.
* A track record of building Customer Success plans and delivering measurable retention and account-health outcomes (e.g. gross retention, NPS).
* Experience running a consistent, playbook-led Customer Success motion across many accounts at once.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and challenge stakeholders.
* Commercial and business acumen – able to understand and speak to customers' business drivers.
* Strong prioritisation and reporting skills; able to synthesise and communicate key insights.
* Able to work autonomously with ownership and accountability, with a design-thinking, root-cause approach to problem-solving.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Insurance domain experience (P&C, Life & Pensions, or Reinsurance), or enterprise software serving insurers.
* Familiarity with core insurance platforms (policy administration, claims, or billing).
* Experience with Customer Success tooling and AI-assisted health monitoring.
* Working within a born-in-the-cloud or cloud-native software company.



  





**Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment that embraces individuals from diverse backgrounds.** 




  





 Natalie.Smith@sapiens.com is your contact for any questions. We kindly ask that you apply through our website or LinkedIn.

**Senior QA Engineer**


We are looking for a new team member to join our highly skilled Cloud Development team, where we embrace a Shift Left mindset and build software used in buildings around the world.


We make our own technology and architectural decisions, enjoying both the freedom and responsibility that come with owning our solutions end-to-end. We value clean, simple code and prefer a functional programming style whenever appropriate.

* Create and maintain test reports for feature testing

* Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, reliability, and overall quality processes.

* Several years of experience in QA engineering or software testing for web applications.
* Strong experience in both manual and automated testing.
* Strong experience with Playwright and Typescript.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

title: Erfaren Konsult med tekniskt djup inom Test & Kvalitetssäkring
description:
Vilka är vi?
  
Test Scouts är ett konsultbolag med rötterna i Göteborg – och sedan förra året även i Stockholm. Vi siktar inte på att bli störst, men vi vill gärna bli bäst. Vi är en tight grupp erfarna och juniora specialister som delar ett genuint intresse för test och kvalitet. Hos oss är test inte ett steg i processen, det är hela poängen.Vi vill vara just specialister, inte generalister som råkar testa. Vi teamar gärna upp med verktygsleverantörer och håller oss uppdaterade på marknaden – men vi är verktygsagnostiker. Vårt jobb är att rekommendera rätt lösning för kunden, inte sälja en specifik stack.
  
Stockholmskontoret är ungt och du får vara med och bygga det från grunden – men med ett stabilt och väletablerat bolag i Göteborg i ryggen. Du är inte ensam, men du har stort utrymme att påverka.
  
Vem är du?
  
Du har minst fyra-fem års erfarenhet av test och kvalitet och en tydlig spets inom teknik, med en stark teoretisk basplatta. Du jobbar med modern mjukvaruutveckling och förstår koncept som pipelines, CI/CD och principerna bakom DevOps och Agil utveckling. Du ser test som något mycket större än att bocka av en kravspecifikation. Du frågar "varför", jobbar lika bekvämt med affärs- som systemkrav, och är inte rädd för att gräva i kod, databaser eller loggar när det behövs. Du har förmodligen skaffat dig erfarenhet långt utanför det som stod i din jobbeskrivning. Du är nyfiken, frågvis och kreativ med förmågan att se detaljer likväl som helheten. Du är drivande och självgående, kommunikativ och bra på att bygga relationer på alla nivåer. Du vill bli bättre – och du vill att branschen ska bli bättre.
  
Du gillar, eller är nyfiken på, konsultrollen och vad den innebär, och förstår både vad den ger och kräver av dig. Du vill jobba fokuserat med test och kvalitet - och tycker tanken på ett bolag som bara fokuserar på det är ett plus.
  
  

**Du har förmodligen följande på ditt CV:**  

Det viktigaste för oss just nu är att du antingen har praktisk, flerårig, hands-on, erfarenhet av testautomation och kod, eller har en mycket stark nischprofil inom till exempel implementering av standardsystem – det är där vi ser störst behov på marknaden.
  
Du har antagligen arbetat praktiskt med verktyg och ramverk som Playwright, Selenium, Cypress och Robot Framework. Du har minst grundläggande kunskaper om programmeringsspråk som Python, Java eller JavaScript/TypeScript. Du förstår koncept som CI/CD och DevOps och har jobbat i antingen Jira eller Azure DevOps. Git, Jenkins och Kubernetes är bekanta begrepp. API-testning är något du förstår och har gjort, till exempel med Postman och Bruno, eller likvärdiga verktyg.
  
Har du jobbat med standardsystem är det ett stort plus – det är ett område vi vill växa i och lära oss mer om. Det kan handla om Lumera, SAP, ServiceNow, IFS, Dynamics 365, Salesforce eller liknande ERP- och CRM-plattformar. Vi ser ett växande behov av testare som verkligen förstår dessa system på djupet, inte bara testar runt dem.Vi ser också mycket behov inom bank, finans, försäkring och offentlig sektor – erfarenhet därifrån är ett extra plus.
  
Vad får du hos oss?
  
Du får vara med och bygga något från grunden i Stockholm, tillsammans med kollegor som tar test på allvar. Vi investerar kontinuerligt i kompetensutveckling – genom ett personligt mentorprogram, ett brett bibliotek och kunskapsbank, kurser, konferenser och interna kompetensforum. Du formar din väg, men vi gör mycket tillsammans.Ute hos kund arbetar du verksamhetsnära och förväntas coacha och leda kvalitetsarbetet, inte bara utföra det. Du hjälper kunden att bygga upp, vidareutveckla och implementera arbetssätt och processer som faktiskt håller – på kundens villkor, med din expertis.Vi samarbetar nära med kollegorna i Göteborg och träffas så ofta vi kan för att utbyta lärdomar och bibehålla vårt DNA. Du har din bas hos oss men bidrar med din testkompetens både internt och i uppdrag hos kund.
  
Låter det som rätt match? Hör av dig!
  
Vi intervjuar löpande och annonsen kan komma att stängas i förtid om vi når målen.

title: DevOps-Engineer ﻿
description:
### **Job Description**

*Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.*

### **Din Roll**


Saab Training & Simulation söker nu en driven och lösningsfokuserad DevOps Engineer med fokus på säkerhet till vårt team i Jönköping. I rollen får du en viktig position i att integrera säkerhet genom hela vår utvecklings- och leveranskedja, samtidigt som du stöttar utvecklingsteam och bidrar till att vidareutveckla vår DevOps-infrastruktur.


Du blir en del av ett team på fem personer som arbetar nära utveckling och drift. Teamet ansvarar även för en intern supportinkorg där ni stöttar organisationens utvecklingsteam i frågor kopplade till verktyg, plattformar och arbetssätt.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

* Administrera Enterprise-tjänster som används i den gemensamma utvecklingsprocessen och i våra mjukvarufabriker, exempelvis Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Artifactory och Kubernetes
* Implementera och vidareutveckla DevOps-verktyg, processer och integrationer med fokus på säkerhet
* Identifiera och hantera säkerhetsrelaterade frågor i applikationer och infrastruktur
* Driva, utveckla och underhålla DevOps-infrastrukturen
* Stötta utvecklingsteam i deras arbete med CI/CD-pipelines och molnplattformar

### **Din Profil**


Vi söker någon med erfarenhet från DevOps eller DevSecOps-miljöer. Du har:

* Solid erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande: Azure DevOps, GitHub, Kubernetes, CI/CD-verktyg (t.ex. Azure Pipelines, GitHub workflows), JFrog Artifactory, SonarQube (alt. motsvarande SAST verktyg), Docker eller Podman
* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och kunna minst ett programmeringsspråk
* Förståelse för säkerhet i mjukvaruutveckling och infrastruktur
* Vilja att arbeta nära utvecklingsteam och erbjuda stöd
* Goda kommunikationsförmågor i både Svenska och Engelska
* Ett arbetssätt som är driven, lösningsorienterad och ett naturligt servicetänk


Erfarenhet av säkerhetsfokuserade DevOps är meriterande men inte ett krav.

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*

### **Vad du blir en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.


Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.


Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**About Keyfactor** 





 Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!
 




**Title** 
 : Senior Cloud Engineer
 



**Location** 
 : Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Experience** 
 : Senior
 



**Job Function** 
 : Cloud Operations 
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full-Time
 



**Industry** 
 : Computer and Network Security 
 



**About the position**





 The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and evolves complex cloud infrastructure and automation solutions with a high degree of autonomy. This role owns systems and solutions that have significant impact on service reliability, security posture, and operational scalability. Senior Cloud Engineers act as technical leaders within the team, contributing to standards, mentoring peers, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.
 




**The position can based in our Stockholm, we follow a hybrid work model with excellent flexible working practices. Applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Sweden.**

  
 




**Responsibilities**




**Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**



* Owns and evolves complex Infrastructure as Code solutions across the cloud environment
* Makes independent design decisions within established architectural standards
* Delivers improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, and team efficiency
* Provides technical guidance and review for less senior engineers



**Configuration**



* Designs and maintains complex configuration management solutions
* Defines configuration patterns and best practices used across the environment
* Reviews and guides configuration work performed by other engineers



**Data Center Operations**



* Maintains an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all physical hardware within the data center, such as HSMs, USBs, Smartcards, SSDs and Shock-Proof cases. Informs supervisor when certain materials are running low.
* Maintains detailed records of all data center operation activities, including changes to tamper evident bag numbers, incidents, and access to client materials. Follows proper procedures on strict guidelines for Root Signings, Disaster Recovery, CRLs and CSR signings. Ensures proper asset disposal procedures are followed.
* Is able to follow documented procedures on how to properly handle sophisticated hardware security modules and KVM devices. Can perform configurations of the hardware security module and KVM with supervision from more senior peers.



**Task Automation**



* Designs and builds advanced automation solutions using scripting, APIs, and Azure-native services
* Drives automation initiatives that improve operational consistency and efficiency
* Supports process improvement through tooling and automation



**Networking**



* Designs and implements cloud networking solutions within approved security and compliance constraints
* Applies deep knowledge of networking protocols and standards to support hosted services
* Participates in compliance audits and provides technical input



**Monitoring & Alerting**



* Defines
 

 and improves monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies
* Ensures monitoring logic supports service reliability and rapid incident detection
* Mentors peers on monitoring best practices



**Patch Management**



* Leads patch management strategies and execution
* Resolves escalated patching issues and drives process improvements
* Contributes to the evolution of patching standards and practices



**PKI Knowledge**



* Applies strong understanding of PKI concepts in support of customer and hosted environments
* Performs PKI tasks for custom deployments
* Contributes to strategy and design discussions for hosted PKI services
* Produces technical documentation for PKI designs and processes
* Participates in cross-functional certificate reviews



**Product Knowledge**



* Serves as a subject matter expert on Keyfactor’s hosted products
* Troubleshoots complex product issues across hosted environments
* Participates in strategy and design discussions for new product offerings
* Supports testing of new product versions and provides feedback to product teams
* Interfaces with customers on hosted architecture and security posture when required
