title: Technical Delivery Lead
description:
**Team: Cloud / Engineering - Location: Stockholm**
 Pacera unifies financial close, consolidation and FP&A into one intelligent platform. With AARO, Aico and Mercur, finance teams turn trusted data into AI-driven insight — powering robust, scalable, and smarter decision-making for the Office of the CFO.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Pacera is hiring a Technical Delivery Lead to run the day-to-day flow of work in our Cloud operations team. You'll be the first point of contact for incoming Jira tickets — triaging, prioritizing, and assigning them across the team — and you'll stay close to each ticket through to completion, unblocking engineers and keeping stakeholders informed along the way.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role — part dispatcher, part delivery owner, part hands-on engineer. You'll need a strong technical foundation in infrastructure and cloud systems to make good triage and prioritisation calls, along with the leadership skills to keep a team of engineers focused. Ticket management won't fill your whole week, so you'll also spend meaningful time working hands-on as an engineer.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Handle daily standup where you triage incoming Jira tickets, assess priority and complexity, and assign work to the appropriate team members based on skillset and capacity.
* Track assigned tickets through their full lifecycle — following up on progress, identifying blockers early, and keeping work moving to resolution.
* Own the team's Jira board and workflow: queue health, SLAs, ticket hygiene, and reporting on throughput and backlog trends.
* Communicate status, risks, and timelines to leadership on a regular cadence.
* Help shape and continuously improve the team’s Jira processes for intake, prioritization, and delivery.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Solid hands-on background in infrastructure and cloud technologies.
* Experience working in a virtualized environment (ideally OpenStack and/or VMware), across both Windows and Linux systems, and comfort collaborating with outsourced/managed cloud partners.
* Proven experience leading or coordinating a technical team, including people management or team-lead responsibilities.
* Strong track record working in a SaaS or DevOps environment, with a good understanding of platform operations and reliability practices.
* Deep familiarity with Jira (or similar ticketing/work-management tools) for triage, assignment, and workflow reporting. You should have a strong background as a power user of Jira, configuring ticket layout, workflows, automations and so on.
* Excellent prioritization and organizational skills — comfortable managing a high volume of incoming requests across multiple workstreams.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset — you follow through until tickets are actually resolved, not just assigned.


**Must haves**
 Experience with:
   

  

* Server vitualization
* Managing Linux operating system’s
* Ansible
* Running Java based applications
* Running .NET based applications
* Network infrastructure
* Setting up / managing VPN’s


**Nice to have**
 Experience with:
   

  

* Web Application Firewalls
* Github Actions
* Azure
* Containerization and container environments (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure container apps)


**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to be part of our next phase of growth and expansion, backed by strategic private equity investment
* Competitive compensation and benefits package including pension, flex hours, wellness allowances and more
* Hybrid working options


**About Pacera**
 Pacera is redefining financial operations for the Office of the CFO — powering planning, financial close, consolidation, and reporting through one unified platform, trusted by 700+ organisations and 70,000+ users across more than 140 countries.
   

  

 Our platform brings together three specialised products —
 **Aico by Pacera** 
 ,
 **AARO by Pacera** 
 , and
 **Mercur by Pacera** 
 — giving finance teams the accuracy, control, and confidence they need to run mission-critical operations, without compromise.
   

  

* Aico automates and streamlines financial close processes
* Mercur powers FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, business intelligence, and financial analytics
* AARO delivers consolidation and group reporting solutions


 Each product has a loyal customer base and a strong track record of growth. Built on decades of proven expertise, our platform helps finance and executive leaders automate, govern, and make faster, smarter decisions.
   

  

 We're headquartered in Stockholm, with offices across Sweden, Finland, Latvia, and the UK. And we're driven by the same principles wherever we are: collaboration, continuous learning, flexibility, curiosity, and the drive to win together.
   

  

 Backed by Accel-KKR, a global technology-focused investment firm, the group has ambitious growth plans driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions. We are now strengthening our operations by investing in key roles that support our platform and future scalability.
   

  

**Apply now**
 This is a permanent, full-time position. The role will be based in Stockholm.
   

  

 Our process typically involves an initial conversation with our recruitment team, a hiring manager interview, and a final stage interview including a role specific task.
   

  

 We warmly welcome your application.
   

  

 --

title: Senior Data and AI Platform Engineer till Axfood IT, Stockholm
description:
*I den här rekryteringen samarbetar vi med Ants Tech Recruiters och du behöver därför ansöka via deras hemsida. Ansökningar här kommer inte att behandlas.
 **Ansök här: Platform Engineer***
 Välkommen till Axfood IT, en av matbranschens största IT-avdelningar med nästan 400 teknikspecialister. Det är vi som ser till att Axfood, och alla våra kedjor, kan ligga i framkant vad gäller digital utveckling. Tillsammans utvecklar vi några av Sveriges mest avancerade digitala lösningar inom e-handel, logistik, automation, planering och AI.
   

  

 Det här är rollen för dig som går igång på att bygga verktyg, plattformar och automatiserade flöden som andra utvecklare älskar att använda. För dig som vill skapa stabila, säkra och eleganta system som gör det enkelt för hela organisationen att jobba datadrivet - och där du får vara med och definiera standarden för hur data och AI utvecklas, driftsätts och förvalta
   

  

**Ditt nya team**
 I rollen tillhör du vår avdelning Data & AI Center och teamet som arbetar med data- & AI-plattformar. Du kommer att arbeta nära flera andra kompetenta Platform Engineers, Arkitekter och Data Engineers och nära nya teamet AI Center, som är en del av Axfoods fortsatta satsning på egenutvecklad AI.
   

  

 Våra Data- & AI-plattformar är avgörande för att Axfood ska fatta välgrundade beslut och driva affärsframgångar och vi söker nu dig som vill vara med att utveckla våra plattformar för att möta framtida behov av data & AI. Tillsammans utvecklar vi dessa plattformar som driver allt från sortimentsoptimering till ruttplanering och integrerad realtidsanalys.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Data & AI Platform Engineer har du en central roll i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla Axfoods data- och AI-plattformar i AWS. Du bygger moderna, skalbara och säkra plattformar som stödjer affärskritiska system och möjliggör Axfoods fortsatta satsning inom Data och AI, med fokus på automation, serverless-arkitektur och kostnadseffektivitet.
   

  

 Du arbetar med att utveckla och optimera data lakehouse-förmågor, skapa strukturer för hur data publiceras och konsumeras, samt säkerställa stabil drift, prestanda och tillgänglighet genom kontinuerlig förbättring och förvaltning. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med arkitekter, Data/ML Engineers och andra utvecklare för att bygga robusta och långsiktiga plattformslösningar, där hög grad av automatisering och self-service är en central del av arbetssättet.
   

  

**Tech Stack:**
* Python, SQL
* Cloud Plattform: AWS
* Compute: Fully Serverless (Lambda/ECS Fargate & DuckDB och Glue & Spark, SQS)
* Storage: Data Lakehouse (Apache Iceberg / S3Tables), DynamoDB
* Orkestreringsverktyg: Airflow
* Accessverktyg: AD, IAM, Lakeformation
* DevOps: Docker, AWS CDK & Bitbucket pipelines
* Engineering Practices: IaC, CI/CD, linting, testning, PR Reviews, interna demos


**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 Du drivs av att bygga stabila och skalbara plattformar som andra team kan lita på och utveckla vidare på. Du har en god förståelse för moderna moln- och dataplattformar samt erfarenhet av automation, driftkvalitet och Infrastructure as Code.
   

  

 Du har förmåga att designa hållbara system och strukturer, och erfarenhet av att arbeta med livscykelhantering och versionering av data, kod och modeller. Du trivs i en miljö där du får bidra till struktur, förbättring och långsiktiga lösningar.
   

  

 Som person är du strukturerad, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad, med hög kvalitetsmedvetenhet och god samarbetsförmåga.
   

  

**Varför du kommer att trivas här**
 Du får vara med och bygga och forma Axfoods data- och AI-plattformar och bidra till en strategisk satsning med stort affärsvärde. Här finns ett stort tekniskt mandat att påverka plattformens riktning, standarder och arbetssätt.
   

  

 Vi skriver kod som dokumenteras, testas, granskas och ägs av teamet. Vi värdesätter läsbarhet, stabilitet och hög utvecklarvänlighet över snabbhet.
   

  

 Du arbetar tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor i en miljö där modern engineering, kvalitet och långsiktighet står i fokus. Teamet präglas av ett öppet klimat, hög tillit och ett gemensamt engagemang för att bygga robusta lösningar som gör verklig skillnad.
   

  

**Ansökningsprocessen**
 Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att söka jobb hos oss. Om du inte har ett CV redo räcker det med att du länkar en väl ifylld LinkedIn-profil. I din ansökan får du svara på de frågor vi behöver svar på i den här delen av processen, och personligt brev är därför inte obligatoriskt.

title: Data Center Facilities Technician, Mechanical
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of Mechanical/HVAC experience in an industrial or commercial environment.
* Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.
* Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in maintenance of mechanical/cooling distribution systems or construction/technical environment or a related field.
* Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
* Knowledge of mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Chillers, Air handling units, pumps and CRAC/CRAH units).
* Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
* Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).  

  

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

  


As a Mechanical Technician, you'll ensure 24/7 reliability of our physical infrastructure. Your core duties involve operating, monitoring, and supporting mechanical systems critical to data center performance, including: water pumps and treatment systems, chillers, HVAC and advanced control and monitoring systems. You'll regularly inspect, maintain, and repair these systems. Google commits to your professional growth, offering access to certifications and limitless opportunities to realize your full potential in this rapidly evolving field.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Sweden: kr680000 - kr695000 (SEK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and mechanical system components.
* Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
* Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, HVAC and control and monitoring systems.
* Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
* Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new mechanical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

title: Senior/Lead Data Scientist -Credit & Finance Model Validation
description:
**Klarna, briefly**


At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.


This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.


**About the role**


Klarna runs more than 200 predictive and AI/LLM models across credit scoring, fraud detection, AML/CTF, finance, and operations — and five people are responsible for independently challenging every one of them. You'd be the sixth, joining model risk within Risk Control to own model risk policy and governance and to review and challenge the models built by teams across the business.


The team, led by Edward McAvoy, has depth in software engineering and model development, but limited experience in credit risk and underwriting, and in provisioning, impairment, and IFRS9 modelling for finance. That's the specific gap this position closes: you'll bring hands-on model-building experience in those areas and use it to independently challenge models built by the first line.


Given the ratio of models to reviewers, you won't have time to check every model with equal depth. You'll need to identify which parts of a model carry the most risk and concentrate your challenge there, and you'll help build the code base and AI tooling that lets the team scale its coverage rather than working through the backlog line by line.


**What you'll do**


* You'll independently review and challenge predictive and AI/LLM models built by the first line, across credit scoring, fraud detection, AML/CTF, finance (including impairments), and operations.
* You'll work directly with model developers and business users to pinpoint control weaknesses in how models are built and used, and follow through until they're fixed.
* You'll extend the team's code base and AI tooling so more of Klarna's models can be challenged, and challenged more deeply, without adding headcount.
* You'll help decide which models and model risks get the team's limited validation time, prioritizing by risk rather than working through the queue in order.
* You'll draw on your own experience building models to test whether a model's assumptions, data, and methodology hold up, not just whether its documentation does.

**Who you are**


* You've hands-on experience building predictive models for credit risk or underwriting — you've sat on the first line, not just reviewed someone else's work from the second.
* You understand provisioning, impairment, and IFRS9 modelling well enough to assess how a finance model estimates losses, not just how it's coded.
* You're proficient in Python and SQL for building, running, and interrogating models.
* You can work independently with model developers and business stakeholders, challenge their assumptions, and push back on weak controls even when that's an uncomfortable conversation.
* You can prioritize which risks in a model matter most, rather than trying to check everything with equal depth.

**Bonus points for**


* You've validated or independently challenged models before, ideally from a second-line risk function.
* You have hands-on experience with PySpark for distributed data processing.
* You've worked with cloud platforms such as AWS.

**Things you should know before applying**


* This position is open in both Stockholm and London; you'll work from whichever location you're hired into.
* Depending on your experience, this position will be leveled as Senior Data Scientist or Lead Data Scientist.
* Validation windows for individual models are tight, so you'll need to focus your challenge on a model's riskiest aspects rather than reviewing it end to end.
* Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
* Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
* Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.

title: Risk, Compliance & Homologation Specialist
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your role**


As a Risk, Compliance & Homologation Specialist you will be responsible for strengthening the organization's regulatory and cyber resilience within the telecom security domain through compliance management, security risk analysis, and end-to-end support of homologation, type approval, and product security certification activities.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*


* Interpreting and operationalizing telecom security regulations, directives, and standards — including NIS2, the EU Cybersecurity Act and European certification framework, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), the Radio Equipment Directive (RED) cybersecurity requirements, 3GPP/GSMA NESAS-SCAS, and ISO/IEC 27001
* Conducting systematic security and compliance risk analyses across network products, infrastructure, cloud-native platforms, and 5G core environments, identifying gaps, quantifying and prioritizing risk, and defining risk treatment and remediation plans
* Coordinating and supporting homologation, type approval, and product security certification, including preparing technical and conformity documentation, liaising with accredited test laboratories, certification bodies, and regulators, and steering products through NESAS/SCAS, RED (EN 18031), Common Criteria/EUCC, and applicable national approval schemes.
* Building and maintaining compliance evidence, control mappings, and certification artefacts, and preparing the organization for internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and customer assessments
* Establishing and maintaining compliance, risk, and homologation methodologies, standards, and reporting frameworks, producing risk and compliance status reporting for management, and driving continuous improvement as regulations, certification schemes, and the telecom threat landscape evolve.


**Your profile**
  

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Min 8-10 years of experience in cybersecurity testing, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security assessment, or cybersecurity operations environments.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, risk management principles and security controls
* Experience with vulnerability assessment and security testing tools, including platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Nessus, Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Microsoft Defender, or similar

title: Senior Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of data center infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This is a customer-facing role that requires strong technical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Your activities will include (but not limited to):  

  

* Build relationships with internal teams and customers along with innovating effective solutions to meet issues & problems as they arise
* Conducting site assessments at various facilities to proactively prepare for the onsite installation of AWS equipment
* Installing/expanding/provisioning AWS infrastructure at the third-party premises, data center, and/or non-traditional environment
* Troubleshooting hardware, network installations & configurations and performing network testing, break/fix, rack installations and/or decommissioning and solving complex problems
* Proactively identifying and implementing strategies that prevent support issues and/or further enhance the customer experience
* Process and track purchase orders for data center hardware components
* Monitor spare parts inventory levels and initiate replenishment orders
* Maintain accurate records in internal ordering databases
* Execute asset transfers across global locations
* Track order approvals and provide timely updates to stakeholders
* Identify and report shipment issues, including delays, cancellations, and expedited requests
* Manage shipment label distribution for new equipment and returns
* Coordinate with global teams to ensure timely delivery and resolution of issue
* Conduct day-to-day business, both internally and with external customers
* Required travel up to 25% on average. You will be required to travel between locations to install, service, and retrieve AWS equipment.
* Physical ability to push and/or pull heavy objects into position (regularly lift up to 18kg and participate in team lifts of 30 kg)
* May lead or participate in efforts to develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and tools that improve operational efficiencies
* May lead larger projects that require cross-functional alignment and support, including large-DC installations, global-reaching business initiatives, and/or development of mechanisms to support growth to ensure compliance with global group standards.
* May be required to work at height to maintain AWS infrastructure equipment while adhering to AWS health & safety guidelines.
* Most of all, you will have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

  

About the team  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Knowledge of fundamentals of hardware, networking, security, databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows).
* 2+ years of leading large complex programs experience.
* A valid (EU) driving license is required as Data Centers may not have any public transportation available nearby.
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree, or 4+ years of relevant technical position experience.
* Experience working in a customer-facing environment.
* CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications.
* Knowledge of power, cooling, cabling, networking hardware, inventory management, and automation.
* Proficiency in network operating systems (Cisco IOS, NX-OS, Junos).

title: Doctoral Student in Automatic Control with focus on Datacenter Control
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition.

**Doctoral student in Automatic Control with focus on Datacenter Control**
==========================================================================

**Lund University, The Faculty of Engineering, Department**
===========================================================

**Description of the workplace**
--------------------------------


Automatic Control is an exciting and broad subject, covering both advanced mathematics and hands-on engineering. Historically, it has been instrumental in many areas, from the early development of telecommunications to the space race. Today, driven by the need to engineer ever larger systems, Automatic Control is more relevant than ever.


The department of Automatic control has a stimulating and international environment with PhD students, postdocs, and teachers coming from all corners of the world. Research and teaching are conducted in an open and progressive atmosphere with collaborations both within academia and with industry, nationally as well as internationally. A PhD degree from the Department of Automatic control gives you the perfect base for an exciting career, be it in academia or industry.


Lund University and the Department of Automatic Control welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality and diversity as a strength and an asset. For more information on being a doctoral student at the department, please have a look at our research videos: Research | Department of Automatic Control (lth.se).

**Being a doctoral student**
----------------------------

As a doctoral student, you are both admitted as a student and employed at Lund University.


As a doctoral student, you will be trained in a scientific approach. In short, you will be trained to think critically and analytically, to solve problems independently using the right methods, and to develop an awareness of research ethics. In addition, you will have the opportunity to work on projects, to develop your leadership and pedagogical skills. Throughout your studies, you will be guided by supervisors. Doctoral studies end with a thesis and a doctoral degree.


More about being a doctoral student at LTH on lth.se. https://www.lth.se/english/study-at-lth/phd-studies/


AEGIS — Adaptive Grid-Interactive Edge Datacenter Fleets is a European Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) research and training network. It is funded by the EU and trains 15 PhD students from 2026 to 2030. The main host for this position is Department of Automatic Control at Lund University. As part of the program you will spend two 3-months visits with partners in the network: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (Switzerland) and Elisa (Finland). Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellowships are among the most respected PhD positions in Europe. The position is only open to applicants that have not lived, studied, or worked in Sweden for more than 12 months in the 36 months before applying.


More information about the project is available at the website https://aegis-dn.eu

**Subject and project description**
-----------------------------------


The AEGIS project sits where two fast-growing fields meet: datacentres and AI infrastructure on one side, energy and power systems on the other. Few people today can work across both, so the skills you build here are scarce and in high demand. Specifically there is a gap between a high-level goal like “cut carbon now” and the low-level controls of a site’s cooling, batteries, and compute hardware. In this project you close that gap.


You will build a control layer that takes “intents” and translates them into a coordinated set of actions across the site’s physical assets. The models close the loop and tune themselves online using both classical control, AI, and reinforcement learning.


In the project you will work on:


Designing an intent language that captures carbon, flexibility, and cost. Breaking high-level intents down into control actions. Tuning power-performance and thermal models online.


What you will deliver:


Control software that turns intents into commands, with measured latency. Practical control systems using real-world data from experiments. A telemetry system that reports headroom and runs without breaking service-level limits in test scenarios.

**Work duties**
---------------


You will primarily devote yourself to your doctoral programme, which includes participation in research projects as well as third cycle courses, seminars and conferences.


The PhD position consists of three main aspects, and the work duties include:

* research project, including authoring papers and traveling to conferences, seminars etc.
* postgraduate courses, given locally, nationally and internationally (90 ECTS credits)
* teaching (no more than 20%), including lab supervision and exam responsibilities. This part may also include departmental services, such as working with equality and diversity, arranging events etc

**Qualifications**
------------------

To be eligible for admission and employment as a doctoral student, you must fulfil the requirements below.

### **Admission requirements**

A person meets the general admission requirements for third-cycle courses and study programmes if the applicant:

* has been awarded a second-cycle qualification, *or*
* has satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second cycle, *or*
* has acquired substantial equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad.


A person meets the specific admission requirements for third cycle studies in Automatic Control if the applicant has:

* knowledge corresponding to course FRTF05 (previously FRT010) Automatic Control, Basic Course and a second cycle specialisation of relevance to the subject, and

an MSc in engineering or corresponding qualification  
* 

The standard MSCA eligibility criteria also apply:


No doctoral degree. At the date of recruitment you must not yet hold a PhD. Mobility rule. You must not have lived or done your main activity (work or studies) in Sweden for more than 12 months in the 36 months just before you are recruited. Short stays such as holidays do not count.

### **Additional requirements**


In order to complete the doctoral programme in question, the following are also required:

* Very good oral and written proficiency in English.
* Good language-analytical ability.
* Curiosity about research and teaching in general, and motivation for the particular research project.
* Creativity with good ability for cooperation and networking.
* Good ability to work independently and to formulate and tackle research problems.
* Good written and oral communication skills.
* Strong mathematical knowledge as demonstrated through university transcripts.

### **Other qualifications****(advantages)**


For the doctoral programme in question, the following are considered as other qualifications:


Strong foundations in

* Machine learning and reinformement learning.
* Cloud computing and cloud technology.
* Low-level programming and Linux kernel experience.


are meriting.


Consideration will be given to good collaborative skills, drive and independence, and how the applicant,through experience and skills, is deemed to have the abilities necessary for successfully completing the third cycle programme.

**We offer**
------------


Lund University is a public authority which means that employees get particular benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension scheme.


More about working at Lund University on lu.se. https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/about-university/work-lund-university

### **About the employment**

The employment is afixed-term employment at full time, starting as soon as possible or March 1, 2027, at the latest. Third cycle studies at LTH consist of full-time studies for 4 years. In the case of teaching and other departmental duties, the employment is extended accordingly. Doctoral studentships are regulated in the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100), chapter 5, 1-7 §§.


More about terms of employment for doctoral students on Lund University’s Staffpages. https://www.staff.lu.se/research-and-education/research-support/doctoral-education/terms-employment-doctoral-students

### **Other**


We intend to offer employment to 1 PhD student. A doctoral student will receive a competitive monthly salary of 35 900 SEK with yearly raise.


Those applicants who will be called for interview, might be asked to perform a small test to demonstrate basic competence.

### **How to apply**


Applications shall be written in English and include:

* CV and a cover letter stating the reasons why you are interested in the doctoral programme/employment and in what way the research project corresponds to your interests and educational background.
* Copies of issued study certificates and/or awarded degree certificates. These must confirm that you meet the general and specific admission requirements for the doctoral programme and show that you have the subject knowledge required for the doctoral programme project.
* Other documents you wish to be considered (grade transcripts, contact information for your references, letters of recommendation, etc.)


We welcome your application.


LTH is Lund University’s Faculty of Engineering. At LTH we educate people, build knowledge for the future and work hard for the development of society. We create space for brilliant research and inspire creative advancements in technology, architecture and design. We have nearly 12,000 students. Every year, our researchers – many of whom work in world-leading profile areas – publish around 100 theses and 2 000 scientific findings. In addition, a number of research results and degree projects are transformed into innovations. Together we explore and create – to benefit the world.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

title: Project Manager Infrastructure
description:
The Infrastructure unit at Epiroc IT is responsible for the global planning and delivery of hosting environments (cloud and on-prem), connectivity (WAN, LAN, cloud) and desktop environments for the modern workplace. We have projects of variable size and duration within all these areas. Many projects are aimed at integrating the infrastructure of newly acquired companies, others are aiming at improving, or transforming from something existing, to something new in the continuous striving for modernization, automation and digitalization. In addition, there will also be maintenance projects such as performing decommissioning activities or upgrades.

  

**Join our team**
  

With us you will get a work environment where you are invited to a great team, eager to embrace your unique blend of experience, competence and skill. We look forward to your creative ideas for how we can continue to evolve our unit, to even better serve the Epiroc business going forward. If you enjoy an international atmosphere, have interest in digital IT development and want to take part in driving our company vision to develop towards a sustainable mining industry for people and nature, you are likely to thrive with us!

  

**Your Mission**
  

As Project Manager Infrastructure, you will play a key role in driving strategic transformation initiatives within Epiroc IT Infrastructure. You will lead and coordinate two major projects that are critical to our continued development: the transformation of our Service Management platform and enhancements within the End-User Management domain.

  

This role combines project leadership, change management, and technical expertise. You will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering projects from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment between business needs, technical requirements, and organizational change. As a subject matter expert, you are expected to provide direction and guidance to project teams, leveraging your knowledge and experience to support successful project outcomes. You will collaborate with stakeholders across the organization and work closely with a global team committed to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and innovation.

  

**Your Profile**
  

To succeed in this role, you have a strong track record of leading complex IT infrastructure projects and thrive in environments where change and transformation are central to success.

  

**We believe you have:**
  

* At least 5 years of experience in Project Management roles.
* Solid hands-on experience working with ServiceNow, defining processes matching how to work with ServiceNow out of the box functionalities from an IT infrastructure perspective.
* Strong expertise within the Endpoint Management domain, including experience driving transformation and process changes.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune is considered a strong advantage.
* Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
  

As a person, you are proactive, self-driven, and results oriented. You do not wait for information or direction but actively seek out what is needed to move projects forward. You enjoy taking ownership and leading initiatives through all phases, from planning and execution to successful delivery.
  

You are a collaborative and skilled communicator who builds strong relationships across teams and functions. By combining your technical expertise with your ability to engage and influence others, you create momentum and deliver lasting results.

  

**Location**
  

This position can be based in Örebro, Stockholm, or any Epiroc site in Sweden. Limited travel is expected as part of the role.

  

**Application and contact information**
  

Please submit your CV and cover letter in English. We look forward to receiving your application.


We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-23. Please, we are aware that we only accept applications through the career site.

  

For questions about the position, please contact:
  

Hiring Manager, Maria Jacobsson, maria.jacobsson@epiroc.com.
  

Recruitment specialist, Maria Tedsjö, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com

  

**Why Epiroc?**
  

By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.

  

To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:
  

* Global career opportunities
* Learning & Development programs
* Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
* Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Community involvement
  

**It all starts with people.** The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.


All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Content Creator till Folket för Orkla
description:
**OM OSS**


Vill du arbeta i ett entreprenörsdrivet företag med motiverande och engagerade kollegor som vill ha kul på jobbet? Vill du vara del av ett kreativt team där varje medarbetare är en viktig del av helheten?


Folkets affärsidé bygger på att skapa dedikerade team som fungerar som kundens egen byrå. Till vårt team som jobbar dedikerat till Orkla söker vi nu en Content Creator.


Folket sitter centralt mitt på Götgatsbacken på Södermalm i Stockholm och delar kontor med våra syskonbyråer, Tillsammans och Kompis. Totalt är vi cirka 120 medarbetare i hela gruppen. Teamet fördelar sin arbetstid mellan Folkets kontor och Orklas huvudkontor i Solna.

**OM ROLLEN**


Till vårt dedikerade team för Orkla söker vi nu en Content Creator som ska skapa och producera visuellt innehåll för några av Orklas välkända varumärken inom Care, bland annat L300, Grumme, LdB och Bliw.


I rollen arbetar du hands-on med att skapa rörligt och statiskt innehåll för flera olika kanaler och användningsområden. Det omfattar bland annat produktbilder för webb, innehåll för sociala och andra digitala kanaler, OLV, display samt material för butik. Du kommer både att skapa nytt innehåll från grunden och anpassa befintligt kampanj- och varumärkesmaterial till olika kanaler, format och behov. I rollen kan det även förekomm att publicera och uppdatera innehåll på webbsidor. Du ansvarar också för att färdigställa och leverera material till bland annat mediabyrå och andra externa partners. Rollen kräver att du kan växla mellan olika typer av produktion och leverera med samma höga kvalitet oavsett kanal.


Du behöver därför vara lika bekväm med att filma och fotografera enklare content som att själv redigera, formge och färdigställa material i Adobe Creative Cloud. Du behöver inte vara specialistfotograf, men du har ett bra visuellt öga och känner dig trygg med att fotografera produkter och skapa enklare foto- och filmproduktioner.


Även om rollen inte har sin spets inom copy är text en naturlig del av contentproduktionen. Du behöver känna dig bekväm med att formulera och anpassa enklare texter för exempelvis annonser, webb och sociala kanaler.


AI är en naturlig del av arbetet och du förväntas kunna använda AI-verktyg för att utveckla idéer, skapa och bearbeta visuellt innehåll samt effektivisera den kreativa processen.


Du blir en del av ett dedikerat team som arbetar nära Orklas marknadsorganisation och övriga specialister inom Folket. I rollen kommer du även att samarbeta med externa byråer och partners inom exempelvis event, sampling och influencer marketing. Du behöver därför vara bekväm med att koordinera och kravställa i produktioner där flera olika parter är involverade.

**OM DIG**


Du är en kreativ doer som tycker lika mycket om att komma på hur ett innehåll ska se ut som att faktiskt producera det. Du har ett starkt visuellt öga och god förståelse för hur innehåll fungerar i olika kanaler samt är van att anpassa innehåll efter kanal, målgrupp och varumärke.


Du trivs med en kombination av kreativt skapande och löpande produktion. Ena dagen kan du filma och klippa ett social-first content för L300, nästa dag fotografera produkter eller anpassa befintligt kampanjmaterial till nya format. Du trivs med att arbeta både högt och lågt – från mer kvalificerad kreativ produktion till löpande adaptioner, leveranser och praktisk koordinering.


Eftersom du kommer att arbeta med flera varumärken behöver du vara trygg i att arbeta inom olika grafiska identiteter och tonaliteter. Du är noggrann och strukturerad, samtidigt som du kan arbeta snabbt och lösningsorienterat när många leveranser pågår parallellt.


Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av skönhet, hudvård eller närliggande konsumentvarumärken och förstår hur man skapar visuellt innehåll som både bygger varumärke och driver engagemang och försäljning.  

  

Som person är du prestigelös, nyfiken och samarbetsorienterad. Du gillar att arbeta nära kollegor, kund och externa partners och bidrar med positiv energi och nya idéer.

**KOMPETENSER OCH ERFARENHETER**

* Minst 3 års erfarenhet som Content Creator, Visual Content Creator eller i en liknande roll på byrå, inhouse, mediehus eller produktionsbolag.
* Erfarenhet av att skapa innehåll för skönhet, hudvård eller närliggande konsumentvarumärken.
* Van att skapa både rörligt och statiskt innehåll för flera olika kanaler, exempelvis sociala medier, OLV, display, webb, digital annonsering och butik.
* Van att självständigt filma och fotografera enklare innehåll och produktbilder, med både kamera och mobil.
* Mycket god erfarenhet av redigering och efterbearbetning av foto och rörligt material.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt Photoshop, Premiere Pro och After Effects.
* Van att anpassa befintligt kampanj- och varumärkesmaterial till olika kanaler, format och målgrupper.
* Van att färdigställa material enligt specifikation och leverera till exempelvis mediabyrå.
* Erfarenhet av AI-verktyg för bild- och contentproduktion och ett aktivt intresse för hur AI kan användas för att effektivisera och utveckla den kreativa processen.
* God förståelse för varumärken och vana att arbeta utifrån grafiska identiteter och guidelines.
* Van att samarbeta med och koordinera externa byråer och partners.
* Relevant utbildning inom exempelvis content creation, grafisk design, foto, film eller motsvarande erfarenhet.

**MERITERANDE**

* Erfarenhet av retail, FMCG eller butikskommunikation.
* Erfarenhet av event, sampling eller influencer marketing.
* Förmåga att formulera och anpassa enklare texter för olika kanaler samt grundläggande förståelse för SEO.
* Kunskaper i Illustrator och InDesign.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i CMS, exempelvis WordPress.
**OM ORKLA**


Orkla Care Sverige erbjuder produkter inom hälsa och välbefinnande, inom hem och personlig hygien och inom sårvård. Vi marknadsför och säljer flera av Sveriges mest älskade varumärken, exempelvis Grumme, Family Fresh, Jordan, Pharbio och Salvequick. Vi har en ambitiös hållbarhetsagenda med fokus på hälsa och välbefinnande, ansvarsfulla inköp, reducering av energikonsumtion och att bygga cirkulära affärsmodeller.

**ANSÖKAN OCH KONTAKT**


Anställningen är heltid med start i oktober. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. För frågor angående tjänsten, kontakta Felicia Norberg, felicia.norberg@folketsthlm.se.

description:

As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description** **What You'll Drive**


As a Technical Presales Architect at IFS, you will help enterprise customers define, design, and adopt modern business platforms powered by IFS Cloud, Industrial AI, and emerging technologies.


You will act as the trusted technical advisor throughout the customer journey, helping organizations understand how architecture, security, deployment models, integration strategies, and AI capabilities combine to deliver long-term business value.


You will bridge business outcomes with technical execution, guiding customers through complex decisions around cloud transformation, enterprise architecture, AI adoption, platform strategy, and digital modernization.

**You Will**

* Lead technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops with customers and partners.
* Design solution architectures that align business requirements with IFS Cloud capabilities and industry best practices.
* Advise customers on platform architecture, integration patterns, security frameworks, identity management, and deployment models.
* Guide customers through deployment options including SaaS, private cloud, hybrid cloud, and regulated industry environments.
* Demonstrate how AI, automation, intelligent agents, and emerging technologies can improve productivity, decision-making, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* Apply AI tools and modern development techniques, including AI-assisted development and coding, to accelerate innovation, prototyping, and customer value realization.
* Engage confidently with security, compliance, data governance, and enterprise risk stakeholders to address customer concerns and accelerate decision-making.
* Partner with executive stakeholders, enterprise architects, IT leaders, and business leaders to evaluate technology strategies and transformation roadmaps.
* Act as the technical lead in strategic sales cycles, shaping technical win strategies and differentiating IFS against competing platforms.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Consulting, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and AI teams to develop winning solution strategies and influence future product innovation.
* Lead technical responses for strategic opportunities, including architecture reviews, security discussions, RFPs, proof-of-concepts, and executive presentations.
* Stay at the forefront of cloud technologies, security trends, AI capabilities, and enterprise platform innovation.

**What You Bring**


You are a technically curious and customer-focused architect who can engage equally well with developers, architects, and executive stakeholders. You are comfortable navigating emerging technologies, particularly AI, while maintaining a strong foundation in enterprise architecture, security, and cloud platforms.


The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Technical Solution Architect, the curiosity of an AI innovator, and the commercial acumen of a trusted presales advisor. They are comfortable discussing enterprise architecture and security with a CIO in the morning, demonstrating AI-driven business scenarios in the afternoon, and building a prototype with AI-assisted coding tools in the evening.

 **Qualifications** **Must Have**

* 5+ years of experience in Presales, Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Technical Consulting, or other customer-facing technology roles.
* Proven experience designing, positioning, and presenting complex enterprise software solutions.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, cloud platforms, integration strategies, APIs, security concepts, and modern application architectures.
* Experience discussing security topics including identity and access management, data protection, governance, compliance, and secure architecture practices.
* Knowledge of deployment models including SaaS, private cloud, hybrid cloud, and multi-region architectures.
* Strong understanding of AI technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI, AI orchestration frameworks, intelligent automation, and practical enterprise AI use cases.
* Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve productivity, accelerate solution design, create prototypes, automate tasks, and develop technical assets.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value for technical, business, and executive audiences.
* Excellent communication, presentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with IFS Cloud, ERP, EAM, FSM, Service Management, Enterprise Asset Management, or other enterprise business applications.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development environments such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Replit, Lovable, Bolt, or similar platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, cloud security architectures, and enterprise governance models.
* Experience building proof-of-concepts, integrations, technical accelerators, or customer-facing prototypes using modern development tools and APIs.
* Understanding of agentic AI architectures, AI orchestration platforms, vector databases, and enterprise AI design patterns.
* Experience working within Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense, Energy & Utilities, Construction & Engineering, Telecommunications, Service Industries, or other asset-intensive industries.
* Relevant certifications such as Azure, AWS, TOGAF, CISSP, Security+, AI certifications, or equivalent credentials.

  

**Additional Information** ***IFS Fact***  

*IFS develops and delivers enterprise software for customers around the world who manufacture and distribute goods, build and maintain assets, and manage service-focused operations. The industry expertise of our people and solutions, together with a commitment to delivering value to every one of our customers, has made IFS a recognized leader and the most recommended supplier in our sector. Our team of 6,000 employees and growing ecosystem of partners support more than 10,000 customers around the world challenge the status quo and realize their competitive advantage. Learn more about how our enterprise software solutions can help your business today at* *ifs.com**.*
